paper.title: GlyphAnchor: Enhancing Visual Text Rendering via Position-Anchored Glyph Priors
paper.abstract: Rendering accurate text remains difficult for image generation and editing models, especially when the target contains long, complex, and densely arranged text or rare characters. Existing approaches either improve native text rendering through stronger backbones and data-centric training without explicit glyph priors, or incorporate glyph priors through specialized designs that remain insufficiently accurate and robust under challenging scenarios. We introduce GlyphAnchor, a novel text-renderin

summary.core_problem: 如何提高图像生成和编辑模型中复杂、密集或罕见文本的渲染准确性？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过位置锚定的字形先验来增强视觉文本渲染的方法，并提供了一个新的基准测试，有助于改善多模态生成模型中的文本处理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 GlyphAnchor，为文本到图像和图像编辑扩散 Transformer 模型提供轻量级字形补丁条件。这些条件通过模型原生的位置编码锚定到目标图像。训练过程包括阶段性监督微调和文本感知的后训练。
summary.experiments: 提出了 InfoTextBench 基准测试，用于评估生成和编辑任务中富文本的视觉文本渲染效果。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the rendering accuracy of complex, dense, or rare text in image generation and editing models?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method to enhance visual text rendering via position-anchored glyph priors and introduces a new benchmark, contributing to better text handling in multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces GlyphAnchor, providing lightweight glyph patch conditions for text-to-image and image-editing diffusion transformer models. These conditions are anchored to the target image via the model's native positional encoding. Training involves staged supervised finetuning and text-aware post-training.
summary_en.experiments: Introduced the InfoTextBench benchmark to evaluate text-rich visual text rendering in both generation and editing tasks.

recommendation.zh: 图像生成中的文本渲染优化，对多模态生成有一定参考价值，但偏向具体任务的 condition 设计，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Optimization of text rendering in image generation, has some reference value for multimodal generation, but leans towards task-specific condition design, keep as literature reference.

paper.title: ReNFT: Repairing Mode Collapse in Reward Post-Training via Internal Probability-Mass Recalibration
paper.abstract: Reward post-training of diffusion generators inevitably concentrates probability mass on a few reward-favored modes, a mode collapse that erases within-prompt diversity. Existing methods for mitigating collapse rely on external signals or interfaces, augmenting the reward with perceptual objectives, adjusting reference regularization, or modifying the text encoder, but none repairs an adapter that has already collapsed while preserving the acquired reward. We observe that online post-training pr

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散生成器经过 reward post-training 后，概率质量集中到少数高奖励模式，导致同一 prompt 下多样性下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练动态分析与修复方法。虽然对象是图像扩散模型而非 LLM，但“奖励优化主要重分配预训练已有能力，而不是学习新内容”这个判断对理解 RLHF/RLVR 中的模式收缩有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReNFT，用内部 probability-mass recalibration 修复已经高奖励、低多样性的 adapter。方法先用 unconditional probes 找到 prompt-independent bias 最容易暴露的 anti-hub prompts，再通过两条 policy-dominated mixed routes 生成用于校准的样本，目标是在不丢失已获得 reward 的情况下恢复被压制的生成模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露扩散模型类型、参数规模、训练数据、奖励模型、baseline 或定量提升。可确认的是评估关注高奖励保持和 within-prompt diversity 恢复，并针对已经 collapse 的 adapter 做修复，而不是重新训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses mode collapse in diffusion generators after reward post-training, where probability mass concentrates on a few reward-favored modes and within-prompt diversity drops.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis and repair method for post-training dynamics in generative models. Although the target is image diffusion rather than LLMs, the claim that reward optimization mostly reallocates pretrained capabilities rather than learning new content is relevant to reasoning about RLHF/RLVR-induced mode shrinkage.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReNFT repairs a high-reward, low-diversity adapter through internal probability-mass recalibration. It first uses unconditional probes to identify anti-hub prompts where prompt-independent bias is easiest to expose, then uses two policy-dominated mixed routes to generate calibration signals, aiming to recover suppressed modes while preserving the acquired reward.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the diffusion backbone, parameter scale, training data, reward model, baselines, or quantitative gains. The evaluation appears to focus on retaining high reward while recovering within-prompt diversity for already-collapsed adapters.

recommendation.zh: 可只看 collapse 诊断部分；“抑制而非遗忘”的说法值得拿 LLM RL 检查，但图像扩散 setup 不能直接外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the collapse diagnosis; the suppression-not-erasure claim is worth testing in LLM RL, but the diffusion setup should not be transferred blindly.

paper.title: Denoising as Projection: Constrained Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used not only for sampling from learned data distributions, but also for generating samples that optimize task-specific objectives. A common approach is to guide the reverse diffusion process using gradients of an external objective. However, when the data distribution is supported on a structured feasible set, such as a manifold or a constraint set, gradient guidance can move samples away from the learned data geometry. In this paper, we study a simple projecte

summary.core_problem: 在使用梯度引导扩散模型进行约束优化时，如何防止样本偏离学习到的数据流形（几何结构）？
summary.importance: 从理论上分析了扩散模型中的去噪操作可以视为对数据几何的近似投影，为梯度引导扩散模型在约束优化中的应用提供了理论基础和一种新的更新规则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种投影梯度引导的扩散更新方法，将目标梯度结合到去噪步骤内部。该方法在推理时仅使用预训练的去噪器和梯度评估。作者将其分析为在学习到的可行几何上进行约束优化的不精确投影梯度方法。
summary.experiments: 理论分析覆盖了线性子空间、一般流形和具有非空内部的约束集三种情况。实验验证了该方法在保持样本位于数据流形上的有效性。
summary.authors_note: MIT Asuman Ozdaglar 团队工作，偏向优化理论与扩散模型的结合。

summary_en.core_problem: How to prevent samples from drifting away from the learned data manifold (geometry) when using gradient-guided diffusion models for constrained optimization?
summary_en.importance: Theoretically analyzes that the denoising operation in diffusion models can act as an approximate projection onto the data geometry, providing a theoretical foundation and a novel update rule for gradient-guided diffusion in constrained optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a projected-gradient-guided diffusion update that incorporates the objective gradient inside the denoising step. It requires only a pretrained denoiser and gradient evaluations at inference time. The method is analyzed as an inexact projected-gradient method for constrained optimization over learned feasible geometries.
summary_en.experiments: Theoretical analysis covers linear subspaces, general manifolds, and constraint sets with non-empty interiors. Experiments validate its effectiveness in keeping samples on the data manifold.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Asuman Ozdaglar's team at MIT, focusing on the intersection of optimization theory and diffusion models.

recommendation.zh: 将 Diffusion 的去噪步骤形式化为流形投影，为 gradient guidance 提供了坚实的优化理论解释，对研究 Diffusion LM 的可控生成和 steering 有理论启发。
recommendation.en: Formalizes the Diffusion denoising step as a manifold projection, providing a solid optimization theory explanation for gradient guidance. Theoretically inspiring for controllable generation and steering in Diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Representation Learning in Diffusion and Flow-based Model: An Application Aspect
paper.abstract: Diffusion models and flow-based models have recently become the dominant paradigms in generative modeling, largely due to their ability to learn rich, multi-level visual representations through large-scale training. This creates a bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning: improving representation learning enhances generation quality, while the learned representations can be leveraged for broader understanding tasks. This survey systematically explores this

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型和基于流的模型在表示学习和生成任务中的相互作用及应用现状如何？
summary.importance: 提供了一份系统性的综述，探讨了生成模型与表示学习之间的双向关系，并提出了一个三层渐进式框架来组织现有工作。
summary.technical_approach: 从三个角度分类现有工作：利用表示学习提升生成能力、利用生成模型提取表示用于感知任务、以及迈向通用统一应用。系统分类了在图像分类、密集视觉预测等下游任务中的代表性方法。
summary.experiments: 无具体实验，为综述文章。
summary.authors_note: 北京邮电大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: What is the current state of interplay and applications between representation learning and generative tasks in diffusion and flow-based models?
summary_en.importance: Provides a systematic survey exploring the bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning, proposing a three-tier progressive framework to organize existing works.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes existing works from three perspectives: using representation learning to improve generation, exploiting generative models for representation extraction in perception tasks, and moving towards general-purpose unified applications. Systematically categorizes representative methods across downstream tasks like image classification and dense visual prediction.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experiments; this is a survey paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

recommendation.zh: 关于扩散模型和流模型中表示学习的综述，主要侧重视觉领域，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: A survey on representation learning in diffusion and flow models, primarily focusing on the visual domain; useful as a literature reference.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: Generalization, memorization, and overfitting for diffusion models trained in the lazy high-dimensional regime
paper.abstract: Modern score-based generative models have achieved remarkable empirical success in high-dimensional tasks such as image, audio, and video synthesis. These models reduce distribution learning to a sequence of regression problems that, if solved exactly on finite data, would ultimately reproduce the training samples. Their ability to generalize must therefore arise from the implicit or explicit regularization during training. In this work, we develop a generative counterpart to the theory of benig

summary.core_problem: 解释扩散模型在有限训练数据上为何没有简单记忆训练样本，而是在过参数化、高维 lazy-training 条件下仍能泛化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析。它把监督学习中的 benign overfitting 和算法正则化思路迁移到 score-based generative model，分析 denoising score matching 的风险轨迹。对 diffusion LM 或生成式预训练有间接参考价值，但不直接给出 LLM 训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 在带 inner-product kernel 的向量值 RKHS 中研究 denoising score matching，并在 n 与 d 同阶的 proportional high-dimensional regime 下推导 gradient flow 训练的精确 risk trajectory。重点是训练动态如何在不同估计器形态之间切换。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述的是理论推导而非大规模实验。核心结果是风险轨迹出现三个阶段，由性质不同的估计器控制；可见阶段包括能泛化的 spectral estimator 和纯噪声相关阶段，但摘要截断，未提供完整阶段名称和数值验证细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why diffusion models trained on finite data can generalize instead of simply reproducing the training samples in an overparameterized high-dimensional regime.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is theoretical. It transfers ideas from benign overfitting and algorithmic regularization in supervised learning to score-based generative modeling. The relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, mainly through training dynamics and regularization in generative objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work studies denoising score matching in a vector-valued RKHS with an inner-product kernel. In the proportional high-dimensional regime where sample size and dimension scale together, it derives exact risk trajectories under gradient-flow training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents theoretical results rather than large-scale empirical training. It reports three phases in the risk trajectory, governed by qualitatively distinct estimators, including a spectral estimator that generalizes and a pure-noise-related phase, though the provided abstract is truncated.

recommendation.zh: 理论对象离 LLM 较远；若关心 diffusion 目标的隐式正则化，看风险三阶段即可。
recommendation.en: The model class is far from LLMs; read only the risk-trajectory result if you care about implicit regularization in diffusion objectives.

paper.title: One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion
paper.abstract: One implicit DDIM inversion step is the cheapest probe of whether a pretrained diffusion model encodes local manifold geometry. It is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, $x-G(x)=\nabla\Psi_t(x)$, strongly convex at the Bayes limit with modulus exactly $e^{-h_t}$ for the step's log-SNR gap $h_t$ $-$ for every data law, schedule and point, with no manifold, reach or unimodality hypothesis. Three consequences must be kept apart. (i) The solution is unique at the Bayes limit; a seco

summary.core_problem: 如何理论分析和验证扩散模型逆向过程（如DDIM inversion）的几何性质和稳定性？
summary.importance: 通过将单步逆向过程建模为凸优化问题，为理解扩散模型的流形几何和逆向求解器的失败模式提供了严格的理论框架。
summary.technical_approach: 证明了单步隐式DDIM逆向是显式势函数的平稳条件，该势函数在贝叶斯极限下是强凸的。利用这一性质分析了逆向解的唯一性、模型误差的证书以及求解器（如Picard迭代）的稳定性条件。
summary.experiments: 纯理论分析，未提供大规模经验实验结果，主要通过数学推导建立扩散逆向过程的凸性界限和收敛条件。

summary_en.core_problem: How to theoretically analyze and verify the geometric properties and stability of the diffusion model inversion process (e.g., DDIM inversion)?
summary_en.importance: Provides a rigorous theoretical framework for understanding the manifold geometry of diffusion models and the failure modes of inversion solvers by modeling a single inversion step as a convex optimization problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proves that one implicit DDIM inversion step is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, which is strongly convex at the Bayes limit. Uses this property to analyze the uniqueness of the inversion solution, certificates of model error, and stability conditions for solvers like Picard iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Purely theoretical analysis establishing convexity bounds and convergence conditions for diffusion inversion processes, without large-scale empirical experiments.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型逆向过程的纯理论分析，对理解Diffusion LM的底层机制有一定参考价值，但偏向连续扩散理论，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure theoretical analysis of diffusion inversion; offers some reference value for understanding the underlying mechanisms of Diffusion LMs, but leans towards continuous diffusion theory. Skip the main text.

paper.title: Is Multimodal Speculative Decoding Ready for Diffusion-Based Parallel Drafting? A Survey and Empirical Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by allowing a lightweight drafter to propose future tokens while a target model verifies them in parallel. Its lossless guarantee has motivated a line of work that pushes the drafter itself toward parallel generation. The most recent paradigm is block-parallel generative drafting, including diffusion-based methods such as DFlash and DSpark, achieving up to 3.6x speedup on common daily chatting tasks. While this transition is well studied

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型（MLLM）的推测解码（Speculative Decoding）中，基于扩散模型的块级并行草稿（block-parallel drafting，即 L2 级别）是否有效，以及其在多模态场景下的性能瓶颈是什么。
summary.importance: 首次系统性地将多模态推测解码的草稿生成策略分为 L0（自回归）、L1（多头/多 token 预测）和 L2（块级并行），并实证分析了 L2 级别（如 DFlash/DSpark）在多模态模型上的适用性。揭示了多模态条件注入带来的额外开销与草稿质量之间的权衡，为未来多模态推测解码的设计指明了方向。
summary.technical_approach: 文章没有提出新的模型架构，而是建立了一个统一的分类法（L0-L2），并基于此对现有的扩散式并行草稿方法（DFlash/DSpark）在不同规模和架构的多模态模型上进行了控制变量的实证研究。核心在于分析视觉信息如何影响草稿与目标模型的一致性（draft-target agreement）以及端到端的效率。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，直接将针对纯文本模型（如 Qwen3）训练的 L2 草稿器迁移到多模态模型上，草稿与目标模型的一致性很低。但在更新的多模态变体上，同样的块级并行草稿范式能实现更强的一致性。这说明多模态本身不是根本障碍，关键在于多模态信息的表示、对齐和利用方式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中关于 L0-L2 分类法的定义，以及实验部分关于多模态条件注入瓶颈的分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether block-parallel drafting (L2 level) based on diffusion models is effective in speculative decoding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), and what the performance bottlenecks are in multimodal scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It systematically categorizes drafting strategies in multimodal speculative decoding into L0 (autoregressive), L1 (multi-head/multi-token prediction), and L2 (block-parallel) for the first time. It empirically analyzes the applicability of L2 methods (e.g., DFlash/DSpark) on multimodal models, revealing the trade-off between the extra overhead of multimodal conditioning and draft quality, pointing out directions for future multimodal speculative decoding design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper does not propose a new model architecture but establishes a unified taxonomy (L0-L2). Based on this, it conducts controlled empirical studies of existing diffusion-based parallel drafting methods (DFlash/DSpark) across multimodal models of different scales and architectures. The core lies in analyzing how visual information affects draft-target agreement and end-to-end efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that directly transferring an L2 drafter trained on text-only models (like Qwen3) to multimodal models results in limited draft-target agreement. However, the same block-parallel drafting paradigm achieves much stronger alignment on newer multimodal variants. This indicates that multimodality itself is not the fundamental obstacle; the key lies in how multimodal information is represented, aligned, and utilized.
summary_en.reading_guide: It is recommended to focus on the definition of the L0-L2 taxonomy in the Introduction and the analysis of multimodal conditioning bottlenecks in the experimental section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 Diffusion-based drafting 在多模态推测解码中的应用瓶颈，对关注 VLM 推理加速和非自回归生成结合的研究员有启发，建议扫读实证分析部分。
recommendation.en: Explores bottlenecks of diffusion-based drafting in multimodal speculative decoding. Inspiring for researchers focusing on VLM inference acceleration and non-autoregressive generation. Skim the empirical analysis.

paper.title: Diffusion Models for High-Dimensional Clustered Data: Intrinsic-Dimension Adaptivity via Bayesian Classification
paper.abstract: The empirical success of diffusion models in generative modelling has motivated theoretical work, including quantitative error bounds and qualitative analyses that characterise the different phases of denoising. We bring these two areas together by studying the adaptivity of diffusion models to the structured geometry of multimodal high-dimensional data that consists of multiple clusters in $\mathbb{R}^D$, each with its own low-dimensional structure, and inter-cluster separation depending on $D$

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：当数据分布是高维空间中的多簇结构，且每个簇各自只占据较低内在维度时，DDPM 的误差和采样动力学到底由环境维度 D 决定，还是能自适应到每个簇的 intrinsic dimension。作者把问题放在高维 Gaussian mixture 的可解析框架里，既想解释去噪过程何时从“跨簇探索”转为“锁定某一簇”，也想把这种相变式行为和已有的 DDPM 误差上界接起来，给出更细的维度依赖结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于可立刻迁移到 LLM recipe，而在于它提供了一类很清楚的建模范式分析：生成模型在多模态、高维、低维流形并存的数据上，误差不一定跟 ambient dimension 线性绑定，而可能由局部几何决定。这个结论对 diffusion LM、离散扩散、以及多模态 token 空间建模都有启发，因为这些方向都在面对“高维表示 + 多簇语义结构”的同类问题。贡献量级偏理论解释，不是训练方法层面的新 recipe；更像是在回答 diffusion 为什么可能对 structured data 有维度适应性，以及这种适应性依赖什么条件。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者沿用并扩展了 Biroli 等人对 mixture 数据上去噪动力学的分析框架，但把每个簇进一步设成具有低维结构的 Gaussian component。核心技术点有两个。第一，作者把 score 写成 cluster-wise score 的 posterior-weighted average，于是去噪过程可以解释成一个随时间演化的 Bayesian classifier：在高噪声阶段，后验较平，样本在簇之间探索；当信噪比升到某个阈值后，后验迅速集中，轨迹以高概率“承诺”到单一簇。文中给出的阈值量级是 SNR 达到 Θ(log(KD)/D)。第二，在误差分析上，作者把去噪过程按这个 cluster commitment 时间点切成前后两段：前段处理跨簇混合带来的误差，后段在单簇内分析局部低维结构。这样可以把 KL 误差上界从依赖环境维度 D，改写成主要依赖各簇最大 intrinsic dimension，并只保留对 D 的对数因子依赖。论文的关键区别在于，它不是只分析单流形或单高斯，也不是只给出定性三阶段图景，而是把“多簇相变动力学”和“KL 误差维度缩减”放进同一个严格证明框架。代价也很明显：假设较强，主要建立在 GMM、簇间分离、正则性条件和可控的离散化误差之上。
summary.experiments: 这篇稿件的重点是理论，不是大规模经验实验。全文给出的主要结果是定理、命题和相图式数值示意，而不是预训练规模 benchmark。关键结论包括：1）当簇数 K 随 D 多项式增长时，只要满足分离条件，去噪轨迹仍会在 SNR≈Θ(log(KD)/D) 附近完成簇选择；2）在适当正则条件下，DDPM 的 KL 误差上界对维度的主导项与最大簇内在维度线性相关，而不是与环境维度 D 线性相关；3）这种分析把早期跨簇探索和后期簇内恢复分开处理，因此能解释为什么多模态并不必然破坏低维适应性。若从阅读收益看，数值部分主要用于验证相变位置和理论量级，而不是展示某个模型在标准生成任务上的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议把精力放在三处。第一是引言后半段和 Section 3.1，那里最清楚地说明了“cluster commitment 阈值”和“KL 维度适应性”之间的逻辑关系。第二是 mixture score 的分解公式，以及把 denoising 解释成 Bayesian classification 的那部分，这是全文最有信息量的机制视角。第三是主定理的假设条件：每个簇的协方差结构、簇间分离如何随 D 缩放、K 可以如何增长、离散化误差如何进入最终上界。泛读时可以先不深究所有证明细节，但要看清楚作者到底在哪些地方用了 Gaussian 假设；否则很容易高估结论的普适性。预计 45-60 分钟可以抓住主线，若要判断能否迁移到 diffusion LM 或离散 token 空间，需要再细读证明中的几何条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: for diffusion models trained on high-dimensional multimodal data where each cluster has its own low-dimensional structure, does the denoising error scale with the ambient dimension D, or can it adapt to the intrinsic dimension of each cluster? The authors study this in a tractable Gaussian-mixture setting and connect two threads that are often separate: phase-transition-style denoising dynamics across clusters, and quantitative DDPM error bounds.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly conceptual and theoretical. It does not propose a new training recipe for foundation models, but it sharpens the picture of why diffusion can behave better than naive ambient-dimension bounds suggest on structured data. That matters for diffusion LM, discrete diffusion, and multimodal token modeling, where the data geometry is also clustered and locally low-dimensional. The contribution is best read as a mechanism paper: when and why diffusion can become intrinsic-dimension adaptive despite multimodality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis extends prior work on diffusion over mixture distributions by giving each cluster its own low-dimensional Gaussian structure. The first key step is to express the mixture score as a posterior-weighted average of cluster-wise scores. This turns denoising into a dynamical Bayesian classifier: at high noise, posterior mass is spread across clusters and the trajectory explores; once the signal-to-noise ratio crosses a threshold, the posterior concentrates and the trajectory commits to a single cluster with high probability. The threshold is shown to occur at SNR of order Theta(log(KD)/D). The second key step is to split the reverse process at this commitment time. Before commitment, the analysis handles inter-cluster ambiguity; after commitment, it studies denoising within one cluster and exploits its low intrinsic dimension. This yields KL error bounds whose dominant dimensional dependence is linear in the maximum intrinsic dimension across clusters, with only logarithmic dependence on D. Relative to prior single-manifold or purely qualitative mixture analyses, the novelty is the joint treatment of multimodal phase transition and intrinsic-dimension-sensitive KL bounds. The limitation is also clear: the framework relies on strong assumptions, especially Gaussian components, separation conditions, and regularity needed to control discretization error.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is theory-first rather than benchmark-driven. The main results are theorems, propositions, and supporting numerical illustrations rather than large-scale empirical training runs. The central findings are: 1) even when the number of clusters K grows polynomially with D, the reverse trajectory still commits to one cluster around an SNR threshold of order Theta(log(KD)/D), provided separation assumptions hold; 2) under suitable regularity conditions, the KL error bound scales with the largest cluster intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension; 3) separating the reverse process into pre-commitment and post-commitment phases explains how multimodality and intrinsic-dimension adaptivity can coexist. The empirical figures mainly validate the predicted phase transition and scaling regime, not downstream generative quality gains on standard datasets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the section that explains the link between cluster commitment and KL adaptivity. That is the conceptual center of the paper. Then read the score decomposition carefully: the Bayesian-classifier interpretation of denoising is the most useful mechanism-level insight. After that, inspect the assumptions behind the main theorem: covariance structure within each cluster, how separation scales with D, how large K is allowed to be, and where discretization enters the final bound. It is fine to skim some proofs on a first pass, but do not skip the places where the Gaussian assumption is used; otherwise the result can look more general than it is. A first pass takes about an hour. A second pass is needed if the goal is to judge transferability to diffusion language modeling or discrete token spaces.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型的纯理论分析，将去噪过程解释为动态贝叶斯分类器，对理解 Diffusion 机制有一定启发，但偏统计理论。
recommendation.en: Pure theoretical analysis of diffusion models, interpreting denoising as a dynamical Bayesian classifier. Offers some insights into Diffusion mechanisms but leans heavily towards statistical theory.

paper.title: Optimize Your Sampling: Tuned Diffusion Sampling with Bayesian Optimization
paper.abstract: Sampling from a diffusion model typically requires many forward passes through a large neural network, making generation computationally expensive. While much work has focused on efficient solvers and samplers, comparatively little attention has been paid to selecting the sampling timesteps themselves. A recent line of work optimizes theoretically derived surrogates for sample quality rather than the quality metric itself. We propose Optimizing Your Sampling (OYS), which instead treats timestep

summary.core_problem: 如何为扩散模型选择最优的采样时间步（timesteps）以在有限步数内最大化生成质量？
summary.importance: 提出了一种黑盒优化方法来搜索扩散模型的采样时间步，挑战了依赖理论推导替代指标的传统做法，对理解扩散模型的采样动态有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OYS (Optimizing Your Sampling)，将时间步选择视为黑盒优化问题，直接使用贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）最大化目标质量指标，无需额外训练。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成、图像修复等任务上，OYS 优于默认调度和 Align Your Steps (AYS) 方法，适用于 Euler 和 DPM-Solver++ 等多种采样器，甚至适用于蒸馏模型。
summary.authors_note: Cornell University, Kilian Q. Weinberger 团队

summary_en.core_problem: How to select the optimal sampling timesteps for diffusion models to maximize generation quality within a limited number of steps?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a black-box optimization method to search for sampling timesteps in diffusion models, challenging the traditional practice of relying on theoretically derived surrogate metrics, providing some inspiration for understanding the sampling dynamics of diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OYS (Optimizing Your Sampling), which treats timestep selection as a black-box optimization problem, directly maximizing the target quality metric using Bayesian optimization, requiring no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: On text-to-image generation and inpainting tasks, OYS outperforms default schedules and Align Your Steps (AYS), and is applicable to various samplers like Euler and DPM-Solver++, even distilled models.
summary_en.authors_note: Cornell University, Kilian Q. Weinberger's team

recommendation.zh: 用贝叶斯优化直接搜 Diffusion 采样 timestep，比推导 surrogate loss 效果好，做 Diffusion LM 推理优化的可以参考其思路。
recommendation.en: Uses Bayesian optimization to directly search Diffusion sampling timesteps, outperforming theoretically derived surrogate losses; useful reference for those working on Diffusion LM inference optimization.

paper.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text represe

summary.core_problem: 如何提升文本到图像扩散模型中概念擦除（Concept Erasure）方法对抗性提示的鲁棒性，同时不影响正常生成质量且不增加推理开销？
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级的文本编码器对齐框架，将概念擦除转化为文本表示空间的域对齐问题，为多模态生成模型的安全性（Safety）提供了一种高效的后训练（Post-training）干预手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TEA（Text Encoder Alignment）框架，冻结生成主干网络，仅微调文本编码器。通过训练判别器区分包含概念的提示和安全锚点提示的 token 级表示，并更新文本编码器使这两种表示难以区分，从而实现概念擦除。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像扩散模型上进行了实验，证明了该方法在对抗性提示下的鲁棒性，且零推理开销，仅需少量训练数据。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the robustness of concept erasure methods in text-to-image diffusion models against adversarial prompts without degrading benign generation quality or introducing inference overhead?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight text encoder alignment framework that formulates concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space, providing an efficient post-training intervention for the safety of multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the TEA (Text Encoder Alignment) framework, freezing the generative backbone and only fine-tuning the text encoder. It trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from safe anchor prompts, and updates the text encoder to make them indistinguishable, achieving concept erasure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on text-to-image diffusion models demonstrated robustness against adversarial prompts with zero inference overhead and minimal training data requirements.

recommendation.zh: 通过对齐文本编码器表示空间来实现概念擦除，思路干净，对多模态安全对齐（Safety Alignment）有启发，可关注其域对齐的 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Achieves concept erasure by aligning the text encoder representation space; a clean approach inspiring for multimodal safety alignment, worth noting its domain alignment loss design.

paper.title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
paper.abstract: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. Thi

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 diffusion / flow matching 自回归生成中，训练目标和采样日程过于固定，推理过程难以根据当前样本状态自适应的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法创新。它不直接研究语言模型，但“去掉噪声条件、把 denoising field 学习与采样策略解耦”的思路，对 diffusion LM 或统一 AR+diffusion 建模有旁路启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Equilibrium Forcing，一种不显式输入噪声等级的 denoising generative framework。方法将 denoising field 的学习与推理采样解耦，使推理阶段可以根据生成样本的反馈做闭环更新，而不是沿用固定噪声 schedule。
summary.experiments: 作者在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成 benchmark 上评估，与标准带噪声等级条件的 diffusion / flow matching 视频方法比较；摘要称视频质量和时间一致性更好，并提供了关于去噪声条件为何带来 data-dependent inference 的分析，但未给出参数量、训练数据规模和具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: Yilun Du 以 energy-based models 与生成建模相关工作知名；Rose Yu 团队长期做时空建模和视频生成相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a limitation of autoregressive video generation with diffusion or flow matching: rigid objectives and static sampling schedules make inference hard to adapt to the sample being generated.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution in multimodal generation. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the idea of removing noise-level conditioning and decoupling field learning from sampling is relevant to researchers thinking about diffusion LMs or AR-diffusion unified modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Equilibrium Forcing is a noise-unconditional denoising framework. It learns the denoising field without explicit noise-level input and separates that learning problem from the inference algorithm, enabling closed-loop sampling that reacts to feedback from the generated sample.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on challenging autoregressive video-generation benchmarks against standard noise-level-conditional diffusion and flow-matching baselines. The abstract reports better visual quality and temporal consistency, plus analysis of why noise-unconditional modeling enables data-dependent inference, but it does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Yilun Du is known for work on energy-based models and generative modeling; Rose Yu's group has a track record in spatiotemporal modeling and video generation.

recommendation.zh: 不必全读；看方法图和闭环采样分析即可，重点判断这套无噪声条件设计能否迁移到离散 diffusion LM。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the method diagram and closed-loop sampling analysis, mainly to judge whether noise-unconditional design transfers to discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Adversarial Learning of Classifier-Free Guidance Schedules
paper.abstract: Modern text-to-image diffusion models rely on classifier-free guidance (CFG) to achieve high image fidelity and text alignment. However, CFG typically applies a static, global scale across all timesteps, samples, and conditions -- a choice that is generally suboptimal and can introduce artifacts, as different states may benefit from different levels of guidance. While time-varying schedules are known to improve quality, designing them by hand is non-trivial and application-dependent. In this pap

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像扩散/流匹配模型中，classifier-free guidance（CFG）通常使用固定全局guidance weight，忽略不同时间步、条件和当前噪声样本对引导强度的不同需求；论文研究如何自动学习依赖时间、条件和样本状态的CFG调度，而不是手工设计常量或时变表。
summary.importance: 这是一篇生成模型采样方法论文，核心对象是图像diffusion/flow matching的CFG，不是LLM基座预训练本身。对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但有两点值得留意：其一，它把“训练时给出条件/无条件模型，采样时如何动态混合两个预测”转化为密度比估计和对抗训练问题，这一思路对离散扩散LM、masked LM或统一多模态模型中的guided decoding有概念参考价值；其二，它延续了最近把采样策略从静态超参数改为自适应、可学习策略的趋势，这和语言模型中自适应temperature、长度惩罚、verifier-guided decoding属于同一类问题。但总体上它更偏图像生成推理控制，不属于必须跟踪的预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以flow matching为主要形式化对象，把guidance schedule建模为时间t、条件c和当前噪声样本x_t的函数，而不是全局常数。理论约束从之前工作中较强的self-consistency退回到较弱的marginal consistency：希望guided采样轨迹在每个时间步的边际分布尽量匹配真实数据加噪后的边际分布。实现上不用MMD或能量距离，而是采用对抗框架：训练一个判别器估计真实样本与CFG引导样本之间随时间变化的log-density ratio，再优化guidance调度器，使引导轨迹在各时间步的边际更接近真实边际。这样得到的guidance weight可以同时依赖时间、prompt和当前latent state，相比常数CFG和手工时变schedule更细粒度。
summary.experiments: 实验在标准T2I基准上对比常数CFG、手工时变CFG以及先前的learned guidance基线。论文报告在样本质量（FID）和文本对齐指标上同时优于这些基线，说明只要求marginal consistency的对抗式密度比学习，比之前追求self-consistency但对齐受限的方法更有效。论文没有把方法改成生成模型自身的训练目标，也没有讨论对大模型scaling的影响；主要收益集中在采样阶段的调度自适应。消融重点显示时间、条件和样本依赖三者都有贡献，常数或纯时间依赖的schedule不足以同时兼顾保真度和prompt adherence。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看引言和方法部分如何从marginal consistency推到density ratio/GAN形式，以及实验部分与静态CFG、手工schedule、Galashov等先前learned schedule的对比。若不做图像diffusion，不必细抠flow matching推导。预计阅读时间20–30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Classifier-free guidance in text-to-image diffusion and flow-matching models typically uses a fixed global guidance weight, even though different timesteps, prompts, and noisy states likely require different amounts of guidance. The paper studies how to learn a CFG schedule that depends on time, conditioning, and the current noisy sample rather than relying on hand-tuned constants or hand-designed time-varying schedules.
summary_en.importance: This is a sampling-methods paper for image diffusion/flow matching rather than a core LLM pretraining paper. Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but two ideas are worth noting. First, it reframes the sampling-time mixture of conditional and unconditional predictions as a density-ratio estimation and adversarial learning problem, which is conceptually relevant to guided decoding in discrete diffusion LMs, masked LMs, or unified multimodal models. Second, it continues the broader trend of turning static sampling hyperparameters into adaptive, learned policies, parallel to adaptive temperature, length penalties, or verifier-guided decoding in language models. Even so, the paper is primarily about image-generation inference control and is not central to the pretraining research stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper is formalized mainly in flow matching and models the guidance schedule as a function of timestep t, conditioning c, and current noisy state x_t, instead of a global scalar. It weakens the requirement from the stronger self-consistency objective used in prior learned-guidance work to a marginal-consistency condition: the guided sampling trajectory should match the true noised-data marginals at each timestep. Rather than using MMD or energy-distance kernels, the authors adopt an adversarial framework: a discriminator is trained to estimate the time-dependent log-density ratio between real samples and classifier-free guided samples, while the guidance scheduler is optimized to make guided marginals closer to the true marginals at all timesteps. The resulting guidance weight is therefore adaptive to time, prompt, and latent state, making it more expressive than constant CFG or manually designed schedules.
summary_en.experiments: On standard text-to-image benchmarks, the method is compared against constant CFG, hand-designed dynamic CFG schedules, and prior learned-guidance baselines. The paper reports improvements in both sample quality, measured by FID, and text-alignment metrics, indicating that adversarial density-ratio learning under the weaker marginal-consistency objective can outperform earlier self-consistency-based methods that improved distribution match but lagged in prompt adherence. The method is a sampling-time improvement rather than a change to generative-model training, and the paper does not study scaling effects on large models. Ablations suggest that time, conditioning, and sample dependence all contribute; constant or purely time-dependent schedules are insufficient to balance fidelity and prompt adherence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction and method sections for the move from marginal consistency to a density-ratio/GAN objective, and on the experimental comparison with static CFG, hand-tuned schedules, and prior learned schedules such as Galashov et al. Readers outside image diffusion can skip much of the flow-matching derivation. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散领域核心作者团队提出用对抗训练学习自适应CFG调度，方法可迁移至MDLM/LLaDA等文本扩散模型，重点看密度比估计建模
recommendation.en: Core diffusion researchers propose learning adaptive CFG schedules via adversarial training; method transfers to discrete diffusion LMs (MDLM/LLaDA) — focus on the density ratio estimation formulation.

paper.title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training provides a direct way to align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific rewards. However, current RL algorithms for diffusion models remain fragmented: reverse-trajectory methods rely on discretized likelihood ratios, whereas forward-matching methods train on reward-labeled noising versions of the rollout samples. This paper shows that these seemingly different losses arise from a single path-space principle. Starting from the regularize

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型RL后训练算法看似分裂：反向轨迹方法依赖离散似然比，前向匹配方法在带奖励噪声样本上训练，缺少统一解释。
summary.importance: 理论统一贡献，说明两类方法来自同一路径空间原则，差异主要是方差缩减；对理解扩散模型RL目标和后续迁移到扩散语言模型有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从正则化扩散RL目标出发，在采样SDE之间做重要性采样，得到轨迹空间策略梯度估计；证明其中包含Flow-GRPO类更新的Itô积分，并导出等价的方差缩减value-gradient形式，恢复AWM和DiffusionNFT的前向匹配结构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验规模；重点是目标函数推导、方差分析和不同算法族之间的等价关系。

summary_en.core_problem: RL post-training algorithms for diffusion models appear fragmented: reverse-trajectory methods use discretized likelihood ratios, while forward-matching methods train on reward-labeled noised samples.
summary_en.importance: A theoretical unification showing that both families derive from one path-space principle and differ mainly in variance reduction; relevant for understanding diffusion RL and possible transfer to diffusion language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starts from a regularized diffusion-RL objective, uses importance sampling between sampling SDEs to derive a trajectory-space policy-gradient estimator, shows it contains the Itô integral behind Flow-GRPO, and derives an equivalent variance-reduced value-gradient form recovering AWM and DiffusionNFT.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report full experimental scale; the main contribution is objective derivation, variance analysis, and equivalence between algorithm families.

recommendation.zh: 统一视角值得知道，但对象是图像扩散RL而非文本扩散LM；看推导和方差解释即可，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: A useful unification, but it targets image diffusion RL rather than text diffusion LMs; read the derivation and variance story, not the experiments.

paper.title: GeoFlow: Efficient Driving Video Generation via Geometry-Aligned Priors
paper.abstract: Generative models like Diffusion Models and Flow Matching have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in synthesizing high-fidelity driving videos, but are severely constrained by high inference latency due to the requirement of extensive sampling steps. We argue that this inefficiency stems from the prevailing reliance on a standard Gaussian source distribution, where consecutive frames are initialized as independent Gaussian noise. This paradigm disregards the rich spatiotemporal correlations in

summary.core_problem: 驾驶视频生成中的 diffusion/flow 模型采样慢，原因之一是相邻帧从独立高斯噪声开始，浪费了已有帧中的几何和时序结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成中的采样源分布改造和几何先验注入。它不是通用多模态预训练工作，但“不要从完全无结构噪声重建确定性结构”这个判断对视频生成和统一生成模型有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: GeoFlow 不再使用标准独立高斯噪声作为 source distribution，而是利用多视角几何和空间自适应噪声注入，构造与历史帧几何对齐的初始化，从而减少重复生成静态场景结构并改善时序一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练集、采样步数减少比例、baseline 或定量提升；实验应围绕驾驶视频生成质量、几何一致性和推理延迟展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses slow sampling in diffusion or flow-based driving video generation, arguing that independent Gaussian initialization ignores strong temporal and geometric correlations across frames.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a geometry-aware source distribution for video generation. It is not a general foundation-model pretraining paper, but the claim that deterministic scene structure should not be repeatedly regenerated from unstructured noise is relevant to efficient video generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeoFlow replaces standard Gaussian noise with geometry-aligned priors built from multi-view geometry and spatially adaptive noise injection, initializing future frames in a way that preserves scene structure and reduces redundant generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, number of sampling steps, baselines, or quantitative gains; evaluation likely covers driving-video quality, geometric consistency, and inference latency.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和方法图即可；source distribution 的改法有迁移味道，但驾驶域几何假设太强。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure only; the source-distribution idea is portable, but the driving-geometry assumptions are narrow.

paper.title: Probing and steering biology across Boltz-1s trunk-diffusion boundary
paper.abstract: AlphaFold3-class structure predictors pair a representational trunk, which processes sequence and context, with a diffusion module, which generates atomic coordinates. How biological information changes as it crosses this architectural boundary remains poorly understood. We analyze per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module of Boltz-1 using linear probes, sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and causal interventions. From the trunk, both geometry (secondary structure, disorder

summary.core_problem: 分析 AlphaFold3 类结构预测模型中，表示 trunk 到 diffusion 坐标生成模块的边界上，生物信息如何保留、衰减和可控干预。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析：用 probes、SAE 和 causal interventions 研究 Boltz-1 的 Pairformer trunk 与 diffusion module。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对“表示编码器 + diffusion 解码器”这类混合架构有旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 trunk 和 diffusion module 抽取 per-residue activations，用线性探针检测几何属性和序列化学属性的可解码性，用 sparse autoencoders 分析特征，再在最终 trunk single representation 上沿可解码方向做干预，观察 diffusion 生成结构的变化。
summary.experiments: 研究对象是 Boltz-1。摘要称 trunk 中二级结构、无序区、氨基酸身份、信号肽和二硫键注释都可线性解码；进入 diffusion module 后，二级结构基本保留，而序列化学信息显著衰减。沿 helix/coil 方向干预可剂量依赖地改变预测结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how biological information is preserved, weakened, or made steerable across the boundary between the representational trunk and diffusion coordinate generator in an AlphaFold3-class model.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mechanistic analysis of Boltz-1 using probes, sparse autoencoders, and causal interventions. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant as evidence about encoder-plus-diffusion hybrid architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extract per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module, train linear probes for geometry and sequence-chemistry attributes, use sparse autoencoders for feature analysis, and intervene on the final trunk single representation along decodable directions.
summary_en.experiments: The model studied is Boltz-1. The abstract reports that secondary structure, disorder, amino-acid identity, signal peptides, and disulfide annotations are linearly decodable from the trunk; after the diffusion boundary, secondary structure is largely preserved while sequence chemistry is strongly attenuated. Helix and coil directions can steer predicted structures in a dose-dependent way.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文；只看 trunk-diffusion 边界的信息衰减结果，可作为多模态 diffusion 解码器设计的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper; read only the trunk-to-diffusion information attenuation result as weak evidence for multimodal diffusion-decoder design.

paper.title: Diff-VF: Training-free High-quality Long Video Generation via Diffusion Model
paper.abstract: Recently, diffusion models have made great progress in video generation. However, most existing video diffusion models are trained with short videos, and degrade when extrapolated to long videos, struggling to maintain long-range temporal coherence while retaining diverse motions. To generate consistent, high-quality and dynamic long videos, we propose Diff-VF, a training-free, plug-and-play and model-agnostic framework that converts existing short-video diffusion backbones into long-video gener

summary.core_problem: 解决短视频 diffusion backbone 外推到长视频时出现的长程时序不一致、窗口断裂和运动多样性下降问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成侧的 sampling 框架，不是语言模型预训练；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于观察 training-free temporal stitching 如何利用现有生成模型的先验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diff-VF，一个无需训练、即插即用、模型无关的长视频生成框架。它结合 Hybrid Noise Initialization 约束全局语义，Weighted Window Sampling 平滑跨窗口边界，Temporal Extended Sampling 用随 timestep 变化的融合建立长程依赖；还用 Skip Residual Guidance 扩展到长视频增强。
summary.experiments: 基于现有短视频 diffusion 模型做长视频生成与增强评测，并提到使用 VBench 等视频生成评测。摘要未给出 backbone、参数量、视频长度和具体提升数值；核心报告是相对已有长视频扩展方案能改善一致性、质量和动态性。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注存在 Cohere 相关 notable 信息，但无法仅从给定作者列表确认具体团队归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of short-video diffusion backbones when extrapolated to long videos, especially long-range temporal inconsistency, window discontinuities, and reduced motion diversity.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling framework for multimodal generation rather than language-model pretraining. Its relevance is mainly as a case study in exploiting pretrained generative priors without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diff-VF is a training-free, plug-and-play, model-agnostic framework. It combines Hybrid Noise Initialization for global semantics, Weighted Window Sampling for cross-window continuity, and Temporal Extended Sampling with timestep-varying fusion for long-range dependencies. Skip Residual Guidance extends the method to long-video enhancement.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on long-video generation and enhancement using existing short-video diffusion backbones, with VBench mentioned in the abstract. The abstract does not provide backbone sizes, generated lengths, or exact gains; it claims improved consistency, quality, and motion dynamics over prior extensions.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks Cohere as a notable institution, but the provided author information alone is insufficient to confirm exact affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫一眼采样设计：不是预训练突破，但 HNI/WWS/TES 是长程生成里低成本利用模型先验的实用套路。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick skim for the sampling design: not a pretraining advance, but HNI/WWS/TES are practical ways to reuse short-video priors for long generation.

paper.title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
paper.abstract: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout m

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型偏好对齐依赖终端稀疏奖励，存在多步去噪过程中的时间信用分配难题，标准策略梯度方法rollout计算成本高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出从中间潜在变量估计终端奖励的机制，解决扩散对齐的信用分配问题，同时提供训练和推理阶段的对齐策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出潜在奖励寄存器（Latent Reward Registers），在冻结的Diffusion Transformer输入序列前添加可学习的无位置寄存器token，从中间噪声潜在变量直接估计终端偏好，不改变生成器的隐藏状态或速度场；基于稠密可微奖励信号，提出训练阶段的奖励梯度在策略蒸馏（RG-OPD）和推理阶段的奖励引导采样（RGS）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和量化对比结果，仅说明方法可有效引导扩散生成对齐人类偏好。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion model preference alignment relies on sparse terminal rewards, creating a severe temporal credit assignment challenge across multi-step denoising, and standard policy gradient methods have high rollout computational cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a mechanism to estimate terminal reward from intermediate latents, solving credit assignment in diffusion alignment, with both training and inference alignment strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Latent Reward Registers: prepend learnable position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer, directly estimating terminal preference from intermediate noisy latents without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. Based on dense differentiable reward signals, introduce Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) for training and Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) for inference.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model size, dataset, or quantitative comparison results, only stating the method effectively guides diffusion generation to align with human preferences.

recommendation.zh: 扩散生成对齐的方法创新，寄存器token读取奖励的思路可借鉴到LLM多步对齐，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Methodological innovation in diffusion generation alignment; the register token reward reading idea is transferable to LLM multi-step alignment, read method section only.

paper.title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
paper.abstract: Long-form and real-time talking-head generation remains challenging due to a latency-quality trade-off: inefficient multi-step diffusion prohibits streaming generation, whereas real-time autoregressive approaches suffer from error accumulation and identity drift. To address this drawback, we propose LeapTalk, a novel framework that achieves stable and real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scaling to arbitrarily long videos. At the heart of our approach lies a single-step

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频和实时说话人头部生成中存在的延迟-质量权衡问题（多步扩散太慢，自回归容易累积误差）。
summary.importance: 提出 LeapTalk 框架，通过单步前向传递实现稳定、实时的说话人头部生成，并能扩展到任意长度的视频。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是单步桥接蒸馏方案。引入基于布朗桥的数据到数据传输公式，以持久参考为锚点，减轻身份漂移。同时，探索异构蒸馏框架，将预训练扩散教师模型的知识平滑转移到学生桥接模型。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验数据，但声称实现了单步实时生成并解决了身份漂移问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the latency-quality trade-off in long-form and real-time talking-head generation (multi-step diffusion is too slow, autoregressive accumulates errors).
summary_en.importance: Proposes the LeapTalk framework for stable, real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scalable to arbitrarily long videos.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core is a single-step bridge distillation scheme. Introduces a data-to-data transport formulation based on a Brownian bridge, anchored by a persistent reference to mitigate identity drift. Explores a heterogeneous distillation framework to transfer knowledge from a pre-trained diffusion teacher to the student bridge model.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data in the abstract, but claims to achieve single-step real-time generation and solve identity drift.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成领域的单步蒸馏工作，利用布朗桥解决长视频生成的身份漂移问题，对多模态生成研究者有一定参考价值，预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Single-step distillation work in video generation using Brownian bridge to solve identity drift; useful for multimodal generation researchers, pretraining researchers can skip.

paper.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
paper.abstract: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible orbit structure can become a learnable input and affect both training and generation because the realized loss and its gradient depend on the concrete pseudorandom values consumed at each optimization step. A small multilayer perceptron predicts the next value of an orbit from its recent history, meas

summary.core_problem: 研究扩散模型训练和采样中使用的伪随机数流是否只是可互换噪声，还是会被模型利用并影响生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型训练动态和数值随机性分析。它不直接改进 LLM 预训练，但对大规模训练的随机源、复现性、finite-precision 行为有提醒意义：所谓随机输入在硬件上是确定性轨道，可能进入优化信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把伪随机序列视为可观测轨道。先用小型 MLP 根据近期历史预测下一个伪随机值，衡量序列可预测性；再构造 diffusion probe，用在线随机张量替代真实图像，同时保留扩散架构和训练目标，测试模型是否能利用轨道结构。实验还控制边缘统计并筛除明显的动力系统和有限精度失败。
summary.experiments: 实验在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上比较不同伪随机轨道。即使控制边缘分布并排除明显坏轨道，不同轨道仍带来明显不同的 diffusion loss 和生成质量；序列可预测性指标与生成质量指标之间存在强 rank correlation。摘要未给出模型规模和具体相关系数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether pseudorandom streams used by diffusion models are interchangeable noise sources or deterministic inputs that can affect training and generation.
summary_en.importance: It is a training-dynamics and numerical-randomness study for generative models. The direct LLM relevance is limited, but the result is a useful warning for large-scale training reproducibility and finite-precision assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat pseudorandom streams as deterministic numerical orbits. A small MLP predicts the next value from recent history to measure sequence predictability, while a diffusion probe replaces images with online random tensors and checks whether the architecture and loss can exploit orbit structure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show that different pseudorandom orbits lead to different diffusion losses and generation quality, even after controlling marginal statistics and filtering obvious failures. Predictability and diffusion-probe measures are strongly rank-correlated with quality.

recommendation.zh: 结论别外推到 LLM，但 PRNG 作为隐式输入的 setup 值得看；大训练复现问题又多一个弱信号。
recommendation.en: Do not overgeneralize to LLMs, but the PRNG-as-input setup is worth noting as another weak signal for reproducibility failures.

paper.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
paper.abstract: We study empirical scaling properties for text conditioning in visual generation. Such properties have rarely been measured because diffusion loss does not scale with the number of tokens in natural-language prompts. Surprisingly, we find that the converged diffusion loss scales with the amount of structured language in the prompt. To quantify structured language, we adapt two complementary measures: a white-box likelihood metric (GPG) and a black-box attribute metric (ED). Across controlled tra

summary.core_problem: 研究视觉生成中自然语言条件信号的规模性质：提示词里的结构化语言如何影响扩散模型的收敛损失和生成可控性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 scaling 分析加训练数据构造方法。它把文本条件的“信息量”从主观 prompt 质量转成可测量变量，并给出扩散损失随结构化语言变化的经验规律，对多模态预训练的数据标注和条件建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用两个互补指标量化 structured language：白盒 likelihood 指标 GPG 和黑盒 attribute 指标 ED。作者在受控训练中测量收敛 diffusion loss 与这些指标的关系，并据此构造带语义与几何标注的结构化 prompt 来提升 diffusability；同时通过 SFT、cold-start 和 verifier-gated on-policy distillation 训练 prompter 来提升 promptability。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明进行了 controlled training runs，发现收敛 diffusion loss 随 GPG 近似线性下降、随 ED 呈幂律关系。基于这些规律构建的系统超过了所评估的开源模型，但摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、benchmark 名称和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies scaling properties of natural-language conditioning in visual generation: how structured language in prompts affects converged diffusion loss and controllability.
summary_en.importance: This is a scaling-analysis contribution coupled with a data-construction recipe. It turns prompt informativeness into measurable variables and reports empirical laws linking structured language to diffusion loss, which is relevant for multimodal pretraining data annotation and conditioning design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors quantify structured language with two complementary metrics: a white-box likelihood metric, GPG, and a black-box attribute metric, ED. Controlled training runs are used to measure their relation to converged diffusion loss. The observed laws guide construction of semantically and geometrically annotated prompts to improve diffusability, and a prompter is trained via SFT, cold-start, and verifier-gated on-policy distillation to improve promptability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports controlled training runs where converged diffusion loss decreases approximately linearly with GPG and follows a power law with ED. The resulting system outperforms evaluated open-weight models, but the provided abstract does not specify model sizes, training-data scale, benchmark names, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 scaling setup 和指标定义；它把 prompt 结构化程度接到 diffusion loss 上，可能改变多模态数据标注的优先级。
recommendation.en: Read the scaling setup and metric definitions; linking prompt structure to diffusion loss may shift priorities for multimodal data annotation.

paper.title: Amortized Moment Matching for Visual Generation
paper.abstract: We propose amortized moment matching, utilizing neural networks to learn data moments as distributional training signals. By casting diffusion denoisers through polynomial projections, we establish a general framework for moment amortization, revealing that an $n$-th degree projection explicitly identifies data moments up to order $n+1$. Derived from the tractable affine case, we instantiate the Amortized Fréchet Distance (AMFD) loss. Unlike FD-loss which relies on explicit marginal moment calcu

summary.core_problem: 为视觉生成模型提供一种可扩展的分布匹配训练信号，避免显式计算高维边际矩带来的不稳定和成本问题。
summary.importance: 这是图像生成训练目标的改进。对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但它把 diffusion denoiser、moment matching 和 post-training objective 连起来，对研究非 AR 生成目标的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 amortized moment matching，用神经网络学习数据矩作为分布训练信号；通过 polynomial projections 重写 diffusion denoiser，说明 n 阶投影可识别最高 n+1 阶数据矩。基于可解析 affine case 构造 Amortized Fréchet Distance loss，并用 alternating、matrix-free optimization 动态学习条件矩。
summary.experiments: 在全局表征特征上将 AMFD 作为视觉生成 post-training objective。摘要报告其训练动态比 exact statistical matching 更稳，显著超过 FD baseline 的 FDr^6 指标，并在 ImageNet one-step generation 上取得更好结果；未给出模型参数量和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks a scalable distribution-matching signal for visual generation without explicitly computing high-dimensional marginal moments.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a visual generation objective paper. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the link between denoisers, moment matching, and post-training objectives is useful for researchers tracking non-autoregressive generative losses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose amortized moment matching, where neural networks learn data moments as training signals. They cast diffusion denoisers through polynomial projections and show that an n-degree projection identifies data moments up to order n+1. The resulting Amortized Fréchet Distance loss uses alternating, matrix-free optimization to learn conditional moments dynamically.
summary_en.experiments: Using global representation features, AMFD is applied as a post-training objective for visual generation. The abstract reports more robust training than exact statistical matching, a large gain over the FD baseline on FDr^6, and stronger one-step ImageNet generation, but does not list model size or full numerical tables.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；若关心 diffusion/flow 语言建模，只看 AMFD 推导和高维矩匹配为何更稳。
recommendation.en: Do not read end to end; if you work on diffusion or flow LMs, inspect the AMFD derivation and the stability argument.

paper.title: Physics-Grounded Fluid Video Generation with a Simulation Dataset and Dual-Stream Optical-Flow Supervision
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling content but routinely violate elementary physics when the subject involves fluids: liquid columns break apart in mid-air, container water levels fail to rise as liquid is poured in, and splashes disperse without regard to momentum or gravity. We attribute this gap to the fact that large-scale video-text corpora contain almost no explicit motion supervision, so models learn to imitate fluid appearance rather than dynamics. We address this with t

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型在生成流体视频时经常违反基本物理规律（如液体悬空断裂、水位不升），如何让模型学习到真实的流体动力学？
summary.importance: 指出了大规模视频-文本语料库缺乏显式运动监督的问题，并提供了一个结合物理模拟和真实视频的数据集，以及一种双流光流监督架构，提升了视频生成的物理真实性。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 构建了一个包含 MPM 模拟视频和真实倾倒视频的物理模拟流体数据集。2. 提出了一种基于预训练扩散 Transformer 的双流图像到视频架构，通过轻量级光流解码器和基于物理的损失函数（如不可压缩性和动量守恒）来增强标准 RGB 解码器。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1,638 个模拟视频和 2,320 个真实视频。在 1,515 个真实视频基准和 18 个 prompt 的泛化基准上进行了测试，验证了双流光流监督在提升物理真实性方面的有效性。

summary_en.core_problem: Video diffusion models frequently violate basic physics when generating fluid videos (e.g., liquid breaking in mid-air, water levels not rising). How can models learn realistic fluid dynamics?
summary_en.importance: Identifies the lack of explicit motion supervision in large-scale video-text corpora and provides a dataset combining physics simulations and real videos, along with a dual-stream optical-flow supervision architecture to improve the physical realism of video generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Built a physics-simulation fluid dataset containing MPM-simulated and real pouring videos. 2. Proposed a dual-stream image-to-video architecture based on a pretrained diffusion transformer, augmenting the standard RGB decoder with a lightweight optical-flow decoder and physics-based loss functions (e.g., incompressibility and momentum conservation).
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes 1,638 simulated videos and 2,320 real videos. Evaluated on a 1,515 real-video benchmark and an 18-prompt generalization benchmark, validating the effectiveness of dual-stream optical-flow supervision in enhancing physical realism.

recommendation.zh: 通过引入物理模拟数据和光流监督来改善视频生成的物理规律，对于做 Video Generation 的同学有一定参考价值，但与 LLM 基座预训练关系不大。
recommendation.en: Improves physical realism in video generation by introducing physics simulation data and optical flow supervision. Useful for video generation researchers, but less relevant to LLM foundation pretraining.

paper.title: TILT: Improving Compositional Generation in Diffusion Models with a Model-Intrinsic Reward
paper.abstract: Recent advances in powerful text-to-image generation models have made it increasingly important to develop test-time methods that modify the sampling trajectory to produce images more faithful to complex compositional prompts. We present TILT, a training-free framework for compositional text-to-image generation via test-time reward alignment. We interpret compositional failures as overlap modes between joint and single-concept distributions, and define a reward that favors samples where all conc

summary.core_problem: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在复杂组合提示下的生成保真度差，现有测试时改进方法多依赖外部监督或独立奖励模型，部署成本高且泛化性有限。
summary.importance: 生成方法创新，提出训练无关的测试时组合生成优化框架，首次利用扩散模型自身的概念分布特性定义内在奖励，无需外部监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TILT框架，将组合生成失败解释为联合概念分布与单概念分布的重叠模式，定义倾向于所有概念同时存在的模型内在奖励，构建KL约束的优化目标，推导得到闭式倾斜目标分布与扩散采样引导步骤，并设计两种引导策略及混合平衡方案。
summary.experiments: 原摘要实验部分截断，仅提及混合引导策略在组合生成任务上取得更优性能，具体量化指标未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-image diffusion models have poor generation fidelity under complex compositional prompts; existing test-time improvement methods mostly rely on external supervision or independent reward models, with high deployment cost and limited generalization.
summary_en.importance: Generation methodological innovation, proposes a training-free test-time compositional generation optimization framework, first defines intrinsic reward using the diffusion model's own concept distribution characteristics without external supervision signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents TILT framework, interprets compositional failures as overlap modes between joint concept distributions and single-concept distributions, defines a model-intrinsic reward favoring samples with all concepts jointly present, constructs a KL-constrained optimization objective to derive a closed-form tilted target distribution and guided diffusion sampling steps, and designs two guidance strategies plus a hybrid balancing scheme.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated; only confirms the hybrid guidance strategy achieves stronger performance on compositional generation tasks, specific quantitative metrics are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 扩散图像生成的测试时内在奖励方法，对扩散LM的推理对齐设计有弱迁移启发，仅看核心方法逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: Test-time intrinsic reward method for diffusion image generation, has weak transfer inspiration for diffusion LM inference alignment design, only read core method logic section.

paper.title: Inference-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models via Progressive Seed Pruning
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching models dominate conditional image generation, yet inference-time scaling for these models is far less developed than for autoregressive language models. Because final quality is highly sensitive to the initial noise seed, many approaches spend extra compute on seed search or resampling under a black-box reward, but typically maintaining a constant memory footprint throughout inference. We show that relaxing this constraint enables an underexplored inference-time scali

summary.core_problem: 研究扩散和 flow-matching 图像生成中，如何在固定推理计算预算下更有效地利用多 seed 搜索提升生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 inference-time scaling 方法：它把额外计算从完整采样后的重排序，改为早期大规模探索和逐步剪枝；对 LLM test-time compute 分配有类比意义，但任务仍是图像生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Progressive Seed Pruning，在去噪早期并行展开更多初始噪声 seed，用中间去噪结果打分，然后逐步淘汰低分轨迹，只让少数候选完成完整去噪；核心假设是中间状态已包含足够的质量信号，可用于早停式资源分配。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 diffusion 和 flow-matching backbone 上，PSP 在固定模型评估次数下稳定提升 reward-guided selection 的结果；未给出具体 backbone、奖励模型、分辨率、计算预算或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate a fixed inference compute budget for diffusion and flow-matching image generation when output quality is highly seed-dependent.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time scaling strategy: instead of fully denoising many samples and reranking them, it explores many seeds early and prunes aggressively. The analogy to LLM test-time compute allocation is useful, but the empirical setting is image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Progressive Seed Pruning runs many candidate noise seeds for a small number of denoising steps, scores intermediate estimates, and progressively narrows the candidate pool so only promising trajectories are fully denoised under the same total number of model evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent gains for reward-guided selection across diffusion and flow-matching backbones at fixed compute, but does not provide exact backbones, reward models, resolutions, budgets, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和剪枝曲线即可；它是 diffusion 版 test-time compute allocation，结论可迁移但证据不在语言模型上。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and pruning curves; it is diffusion-style test-time compute allocation, but the evidence is not from language models.

paper.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and

summary.core_problem: 传统扩散模型剪枝方法基于均匀重建误差或权重大小排序参数，未考虑语义区域重要性，高压缩比下会过度剪枝语义重要区域参数，导致感知质量下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出training-free的重要性感知剪枝框架，将空间重要性图融入剪枝目标，提升高压缩比下的生成感知质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Importance-Aware OBS Pruning；从条件信号或模型注意力提取空间重要性图，将其融入OBS剪枝目标函数，得到感知对齐的参数排序，优先保留语义重要区域参数，无需额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验在MS-COCO数据集上开展；基线为基于权重大小、均匀重建误差的传统剪枝方法；高压缩比下传统方法出现可见生成退化时，所提方法仍能一致保留主体保真度与结构正确性。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional diffusion model pruning methods rank parameters based on uniform reconstruction error or weight magnitude, ignoring semantic region importance, leading to over-pruning of parameters in semantically salient regions and degraded perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free importance-aware pruning framework that incorporates spatial importance maps into the pruning objective, improving perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Importance-Aware OBS Pruning; extracts spatial importance maps from conditioning signals or model attention; integrates them into the OBS pruning objective to obtain perception-aligned parameter rankings, prioritizing parameters in semantically salient regions without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset; baselines include conventional pruning methods based on weight magnitude and uniform reconstruction error; the proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation.

recommendation.zh: 图像扩散的重要性感知剪枝思路可借鉴到LLM参数重要性排序，仅看§3重要性图构建与§4压缩比-质量曲线即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: The importance-aware parameter ranking idea for diffusion pruning can be borrowed for LLM parameter importance estimation; only read §3 for importance map construction and §4 for compression-quality curves, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Analytic Distribution of Classifier-Free Guidance for Schedule Design
paper.abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the default mechanism for conditional generation in diffusion models, but the distribution sampled by its deterministic guided dynamics is not captured by the usual product-distribution heuristic $p_0^ωq_0^{1-ω}$. We analyze CFG through the probability flow ODE and derive exact analytic path-integral representations of the induced distributions for both constant and time-dependent guidance. The resulting formulas show that CFG modifies $p_{t_0}$ by an exponentia

summary.core_problem: 现有Classifier-Free Guidance（CFG）的采样分布缺乏精确解析刻画，常用的乘积分布启发式不准确，导致引导调度设计无理论依据。
summary.importance: 扩散模型引导机制的理论分析工作，推导了CFG分布的精确解析形式，提出了更优的引导调度方法。
summary.technical_approach: 通过概率流ODE分析CFG，推导常数和时变引导下诱导分布的精确路径积分表示，发现CFG通过指数路径积分项修正分布，时变权重通过ω(t)-1进入修正项，据此提出DG-CFG调度平衡各时间步贡献，考虑信号强度和低噪声分数误差放大。
summary.experiments: 在带解析分数的玩具模型上验证了分布推导的正确性，在Stable Diffusion 1.5上DG-CFG取得优于默认CFG的生成效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The sampled distribution of Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) lacks precise analytic characterization, and the commonly used product-of-distributions heuristic is inaccurate, leading to unprincipled guidance schedule design.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis of diffusion model guidance mechanism, derives exact analytic form of CFG-induced distributions and proposes an improved guidance schedule.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyze CFG via probability flow ODE, derive exact path-integral representations of induced distributions for both constant and time-dependent guidance, show CFG modifies distributions via an exponential path integral correction with time-dependent weight entering as ω(t)-1, then propose DG-CFG schedule that balances timestep contributions accounting for signal strength and low-noise score error amplification.
summary_en.experiments: Verify derived distributions on a toy model with analytic scores, DG-CFG outperforms default CFG on Stable Diffusion 1.5 generation tasks.

recommendation.zh: CFG机制的通用理论分析，对做离散扩散LM采样的团队有参考价值，跳过图像实验，只看推导和DG-CFG设计。
recommendation.en: General theoretical analysis of CFG, useful for teams working on discrete diffusion LM sampling; skip image experiments, focus on derivation and DG-CFG design.

paper.title: DiFA: Inference-Time Forward-Process Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: The prevailing inference framework for diffusion models formulates generation fundamentally as a problem of numerical integration. This perspective casts the model as an exact estimator, neglecting the inherent statistical uncertainty of the denoising process. In this work, we propose Forward-Process Aligned Diffusion prediction (\textbf{DiFA}), a training-free framework that reframes inference-time data prediction refinement as a sequential state estimation problem. Rather than reusing past out

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型推理框架将生成视为数值积分问题，忽略去噪过程的统计不确定性，导致生成质量受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出一种免训练的推理时预测精炼框架 DiFA，将扩散生成重新建模为序列状态估计问题。
summary.technical_approach: 受卡尔曼滤波启发，把反向轨迹上的迭代数据预测视为相关观测，按结构一致性与噪声水平兼容性聚合历史预测形成前向对齐的时序共识；引入偏差引导机制自适应保留残差细节以对抗过平滑。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务上验证 DiFA 可在不重新训练的情况下提升扩散模型生成质量，具体指标与 baseline 未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current diffusion inference frameworks treat generation as numerical integration and ignore the statistical uncertainty of the denoising process, limiting sample quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution; proposes DiFA, a training-free inference-time prediction refinement framework that reframes diffusion generation as sequential state estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Kalman filtering, treats iterative predictions along the reverse trajectory as correlated observations and aggregates them by structural consistency and noise-level compatibility to form a forward-aligned temporal consensus; introduces a deviation guidance mechanism to adaptively preserve residual details and counter over-smoothing.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validated on image generation tasks, showing quality improvements without retraining; specific metrics and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 扩散推理时优化的小创新，对做多模态生成的人有参考，对 LLM 预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A minor diffusion inference-time optimization, relevant to multimodal generation researchers but of limited value to LLM pretraining researchers; abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: Spatial Transport of Integration Error in Generative ODEs
paper.abstract: A trained flow or diffusion model is usually run with only a handful of solver steps, and the integration error this leaves behind is unevenly distributed across the image. We ask where that error is injected and how it reaches the endpoint, and answer with a signed source-and-transport accounting of few-step integration error, tested to first order. A perturbation experiment on five models at 256^2 resolution shows the learned dynamics spread local disturbances widely: near the start of samplin

summary.core_problem: 揭示flow/diffusion生成模型少步ODE采样时积分误差的空间传输规律，解释生成结果中误差的分布来源
summary.importance: 基础生成模型的机制分析贡献，修正了少步采样误差局部性的普遍直觉，对扩散/流模型的采样器设计、训练优化有参考意义
summary.technical_approach: 提出带符号的源-传输误差核算框架，通过一阶扰动实验、线性化动力学传播单步截断残差，在5个256²分辨率图像模型上验证规律，设计结构破坏型null实验验证机制
summary.experiments: 采样初期局部扰动仅不到10%的终点响应留在源位置；线性化传播的截断残差可重构余弦相似度0.81-0.87的终点误差方向与区域结构；区域误差主要来自外部传输而非本地注入

summary_en.core_problem: Characterize the spatial transport of integration error from few-step ODE sampling in flow/diffusion generative models, and explain the source of error distribution in generated outputs.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis contribution for fundamental generative modeling, correcting common intuition about local truncation error in few-step sampling, with implications for sampler design and training optimization for diffusion/flow models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose a signed source-and-transport error accounting framework; conduct first-order perturbation experiments, propagate one-step truncation residuals through linearized model dynamics, run validation across five 256² resolution image models, and design structure-destroying null experiments to verify the mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Less than 10% of endpoint response from early-sampling local perturbations remains at the source; propagated signed truncation residuals reconstruct endpoint error direction and regional structure with cosine similarity 0.81-0.87; regional error is dominated by transported contributions rather than local injection.

recommendation.zh: 流模型误差传播的反常识分析，做Flow/扩散LM的看摘要结论即可，图像实验细节无需读
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive analysis of error transport in flow models; flow/diffusion LM researchers only need the abstract conclusion, skip image-specific experiments.

paper.title: Toward a mechanistic understanding of inference in visual cortex and diffusion models
paper.abstract: We describe a model of perceptual inference in primary visual cortex (V1) equivalent to a minimal diffusion model whose function can be readily understood from its parameters. The model is based on sparse coding with a non-factorial prior over latent variables in the form of an unconstrained, pairwise interaction matrix, extending standard sparse coding inference to a general recurrent dynamical system. We efficiently train these recurrent dynamics using a denoising score-matching objective and

summary.core_problem: 解释视觉皮层推理和扩散模型去噪之间的机制联系，并构建一个可从参数直接理解的最小扩散式模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可解释生成建模。它不直接研究语言模型，但把 sparse coding、recurrent dynamics 和 denoising score matching 连起来，对理解扩散式生成模型的归纳偏置有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 sparse coding 出发，引入非因子化 latent prior，用无约束 pairwise interaction matrix 表示潜变量间相互作用，将标准 sparse coding inference 扩展成通用 recurrent dynamical system。训练使用 denoising score-matching objective，并通过 implicit differentiation 高效优化 recurrent dynamics。训练后分析 interaction matrix 与 V1 superficial layers 中连接相似 orientation tuning 神经元的水平连接结构之间的对应关系。
summary.experiments: 模型在自然图像上训练，用于极端模糊条件下的图像去噪和特征恢复。摘要称其能恢复 extended contours 等结构，并在 generalization regime 中接近标准黑盒 diffusion architecture 的行为，但未提供具体模型规模、数据集名称、数值指标或 baseline 表格。
summary.authors_note: Bruno A. Olshausen 是稀疏编码与初级视觉皮层计算模型的代表性研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It seeks a mechanistic link between perceptual inference in visual cortex and denoising in diffusion models through a minimal, interpretable model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mechanistic analysis and interpretable generative modeling. It is not a language-model paper, but it connects sparse coding, recurrent dynamics, and denoising score matching in a way that can inform how diffusion-style generative models encode inductive bias.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model starts from sparse coding and adds a non-factorial latent prior represented by an unconstrained pairwise interaction matrix. This turns standard sparse-coding inference into a general recurrent dynamical system. The dynamics are trained with a denoising score-matching objective and optimized efficiently via implicit differentiation.
