The learned interaction matrix is then compared to horizontal connections in superficial V1 layers linking neurons with similar orientation tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The model is trained on natural images and evaluated on denoising under extreme ambiguity. The abstract reports recovery of structures such as extended contours and behavior close to standard black-box diffusion architectures in a generalization regime, but it does not expose exact model sizes, dataset names, metrics, or full baseline tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Bruno A. Olshausen is a well-known researcher in sparse coding and computational models of primary visual cortex.

recommendation.zh: 不直接服务 LLM，但 score-matching 训练出的可解释 recurrent prior 值得扫；只看模型设定和连接矩阵分析。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for LLMs, but the interpretable recurrent prior trained by score matching is worth a skim; read the model setup and interaction-matrix analysis.

paper.title: Diffusion models recover accurate mixture weights despite score function insensitivity
paper.abstract: Score-based generative models exhibit a puzzling behavior: they often appear to cover all modes of a target multimodal distribution and yet may fail to learn the correct relative mode amplitudes, which can be interpreted as mixture weights. We resolve this apparent paradox by relating the diffusion score matching (DSM) loss to the error in estimating mixture weights from generated samples. We show that, even when the target score is insensitive to mixture weights, generated samples can recover t

summary.core_problem: 解释 score-based diffusion model 为什么在目标 score 对 mixture weight 不敏感时，仍可能从生成样本中恢复正确的混合权重。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型理论分析。它对 diffusion LM 或离散 diffusion 不是直接方法贡献，但对理解 score matching 信号中哪些噪声层携带分布参数有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 diffusion score matching loss 与从生成样本估计 mixture weight 的误差联系起来，提出 diffusion score sensitivity index，衡量 DSM loss 对目标分布参数变化的敏感性。核心观点是：即使低噪声或目标 score 本身对权重不敏感，中间噪声层的 score 仍可能包含足够的权重信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论结果，特别是任意维 Gaussian mixture 中 mixture weight 估计误差与 DSSI 控制量同阶。未给出大规模神经网络训练、图像生成或语言生成实验的具体模型规模和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains how score-based diffusion models can recover accurate mixture weights from samples even when the target score appears insensitive to those weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical analysis of generative modeling. It is not a direct contribution to diffusion language modeling, but it is relevant to understanding which noise levels carry learnable distributional information.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors relate the diffusion score matching loss to the error of estimating mixture weights from generated samples. They introduce the diffusion score sensitivity index, which measures how much the DSM loss varies under changes in a target parameter. The key mechanism is that intermediate noise levels can encode mixture-weight information even when the target score itself is insensitive.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on theory, especially Gaussian mixtures in arbitrary dimension, where mixture-weight estimation errors are shown to be of the same order as quantities controlled by DSSI. No large-scale neural diffusion, image, or language experiments are specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 可扫一眼 DSSI 定义；它是理论清障，不会直接改变训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: If you work on diffusion LMs, skim the DSSI definition; this is theory cleanup, not something that changes the training recipe directly.

paper.title: Hierarchical Denoising For Multi-Step Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Video models are evolving into vision foundation models, yet they still lack human-like multi-step reasoning. Streaming autoregressive diffusion models are efficient but limited in reasoning, while bidirectional diffusion enables global revision with high inference costs due to dense frame-level denoising. Both paradigms struggle to achieve logical consistency and low-latency streaming for complex reasoning tasks. We propose HDR (Hierarchical Denoising for Visual Reasoning), a unified framework

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型在“多步视觉推理”和“低延迟流式生成”之间存在张力：因果流式自回归扩散效率高但承诺过早、难以全局修订；双向扩散支持全局一致性但要对整段序列做密集去噪，推理成本高、不适合流式输出。
summary.importance: 对多模态生成建模和视频作为 world model 的研究有直接启发。论文抓住了一个很实际的矛盾：推理需要保留高层假设并反复修订，流式部署则要求局部因果、低延迟增量输出。HDR 尝试在二者之间引入显式的层次化中间规划空间，这与文本/多模态模型中“先规划后生成”“粗到细推理”的思路相通，也对视频 diffusion LM、具身世界模型、长轨迹一致性建模有参考意义。不过论文目前更像方法论文与推理 benchmark 结合，预训练层面的通用性与规模化证据还比较有限。
summary.technical_approach: HDR 在流式自回归扩散框架中引入树状层次 latent 结构，在真正逐帧流式输出前先做 coarse-to-fine 多层级推理。核心设计有两点。第一是 hierarchy-matched denoising schedule：不对所有层级做同等强度去噪，而是让更粗的层级保留更高噪声，以维持多个全局规划假设；更细的层级则接收更强去噪，把高层计划实例化为具体视觉状态。第二是 SHAP（Sparse Hierarchical Attention Pattern）：每个 token 只与局部上下文和父层级上下文通信，不做稠密的全时序/全层级注意力，从而在保留多尺度信息流的同时降低流式推理开销。整体上，它相当于在 causal streaming diffusion 里加了一个显式的“规划层/计划树”，让高层可以在不完全承诺像素级细节的情况下持续修订，再向下逐层细化。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了一个分层多步视频推理 benchmark，覆盖迷宫导航、汉诺塔、一笔画、滑块拼图、推箱子、倒水六类任务，并包含 OOD 情形。相比流式 AR diffusion 与双向 diffusion 基线，HDR 在最终任务成功率上整体从 34.22 提升到 60.29，相对提升 76.2%；平均进度分从 76.00 提升到 89.56。流式效率上，HDR 每个 latent 约 0.70 s，比双向扩散快 54.2 倍。数据效率方面，只用 2% 数据训练时，HDR 仍保留全数据设置下 82.9% 的成功率，而双向扩散仅保留 52.0%。论文还给出真实机器人迷宫实验，说明层次化推理能力可迁移到物理交互。需要注意这些结果主要来自受控推理任务，不是大规模开放域视频生成或通用多模态预训练评测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读引言、方法总览和实验表格，预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 对三种范式的对比，以及层级去噪调度和 SHAP 注意力模式的设计动机，不必一开始陷入实现细节。若关心视频 diffusion 推理机制，可重点关注“为什么粗层高噪声有助于保留多个规划假设”这一点；若关心工程部署，则看 SHAP 如何限制注意力连通域。后续值得追问的是：层次 latent 如何预训练得到、层级数和树结构如何选择、该机制能否扩展到开放域长视频和音视频联合建模，以及 coarse plan 的修订是否会破坏已输出帧的因果一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation models face a tension between multi-step visual reasoning and low-latency streaming: streaming autoregressive diffusion is efficient but commits too early and struggles with global revision, while bidirectional diffusion supports global consistency but requires dense denoising over fixed sequences, making it expensive and poorly suited to streaming deployment.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to multimodal generative modeling and video-as-world-model research. It identifies a practical trade-off: reasoning requires maintaining and revising high-level hypotheses, while streaming deployment demands local causal, low-latency incremental output. HDR inserts an explicit hierarchical intermediate planning space between these two regimes. This connects to broader ideas such as plan-then-generate and coarse-to-fine reasoning in language and multimodal models, and may inform video diffusion LMs, embodied world models, and long-horizon consistency modeling. That said, the evidence is currently limited to controlled reasoning tasks rather than large-scale open-domain pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HDR integrates a tree-structured latent hierarchy into a streaming autoregressive diffusion process and performs coarse-to-fine reasoning before streaming output. There are two core designs. First, a hierarchy-matched denoising schedule: coarser layers are kept at higher noise levels so they can preserve multiple global plans, while finer layers receive stronger denoising to instantiate those plans into concrete visual states. Second, SHAP (Sparse Hierarchical Attention Pattern): each token communicates only with fixed local context and parent-level context, avoiding dense full-sequence or full-hierarchy attention while preserving multi-scale information flow. Conceptually, this adds an explicit planning tree inside causal streaming diffusion, allowing high-level decisions to be revised before they are fully committed to frame-level details.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces a level-stratified multi-step video reasoning benchmark with OOD settings across six tasks: maze navigation, Tower of Hanoi, one-line drawing, sliding puzzle, Sokoban, and water pouring. HDR improves overall task success score from 34.22 to 60.29, a 76.2% relative gain, and raises average progress score from 76.00 to 89.56. During streaming it achieves 0.70 s per latent, reported as 54.2× faster than bidirectional diffusion. In data-efficiency ablations, with only 2% training data HDR retains 82.9% of its full-data success score, compared with 52.0% for bidirectional diffusion. Real-world robot maze experiments suggest transfer to physical interaction. These results are from controlled reasoning environments rather than large-scale open-domain video or general multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, method overview, and result tables; estimated reading time 20–30 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the contrast between paradigms, and on the motivation behind the hierarchy-matched denoising schedule and SHAP attention pattern. Readers interested in diffusion-based reasoning should pay attention to why higher noise at coarse layers helps preserve multiple plans; readers interested in deployment should look at how SHAP constrains attention connectivity. Open questions worth tracking: how the hierarchical latents are pretrained, how tree depth and structure are chosen, whether the mechanism scales to open-domain long video and audio-visual modeling, and how revision at coarse levels interacts with causal consistency of already streamed frames.

recommendation.zh: 读架构和 attention pattern 即可；“层级 latent 做规划”方向对 latent reasoning 有用，但评测若靠视频观感会很脏。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and attention pattern; hierarchical latents for planning are relevant to latent reasoning, but video-quality-heavy evaluation can be noisy.

paper.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for

summary.core_problem: 同一文本提示下，文生图扩散模型往往只覆盖少数视觉模式；论文要提高一组生成样本对预定义语义类别的覆盖度，尤其是人物提示中的人口属性多样性。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向生成多样性的强化学习目标，而不是新的基础模型架构。它把“多样性”从样本级平均得分改成组级模式覆盖，对理解生成模型后训练中的信用分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 multi-axis max@K。对同一 prompt 生成 K 个样本，并对每个目标类别计算分数；目标函数先在样本维度对每个类别取最大值，再对类别求和。这样只有当某个样本提高了某一类别的组内最大覆盖时，它才在该类别上获得正向权重，避免所有样本被推向同一个高分模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到先在合成任务上验证信用分配机制，再用于 diffusion-based T2I 模型的训练；核心对比应是常规奖励聚合或单样本奖励下的模式覆盖、多样性和 prompt alignment。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo 是东京大学松尾研究室负责人，团队长期做深度学习、LLM 应用和生成模型相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses mode under-coverage in text-to-image diffusion models, where multiple samples from the same prompt often represent only a narrow set of visually distinct semantic modes.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an RL objective for diversity-oriented generative model alignment. It is not a foundation-model pretraining result, but the group-level credit assignment idea is relevant to reward design for generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed multi-axis max@K objective generates a group of K samples per prompt, scores each sample against multiple target categories, takes the maximum score over samples for each category, and then sums those category-wise maxima. A sample receives positive credit only when it improves the group maximum for a category.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a synthetic validation of the credit-assignment mechanism and experiments on diffusion-based T2I models. It implies comparisons against standard reward aggregation or per-sample reward baselines, but does not provide model size, training scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo leads the Matsuo Lab at the University of Tokyo, a group known for work on deep learning, LLM applications, and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；只看目标函数定义，作为“组级奖励避免模式坍缩”的一个小型可复用 trick。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining; inspect the objective as a compact example of group-level reward design against mode collapse.

paper.title: The Seriality Gap in Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: When one ball strikes another, then another, video models should predict the consequences of each bounce. In controlled experiments on multi-ball hard-sphere dynamics, we find that the performance of standard bidirectional video diffusion degrades as the causal chain lengthens, even when provided more denoising steps. In a length-matched single-ball control, where ball-ball interactions are absent, the degradation largely disappears, isolating dependent-event structure rather than video length a

summary.core_problem: 解释视频扩散模型为什么在需要长因果链的预测任务上明显退化，以及这种退化是否来自视频长度还是来自串行计算不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析加理论澄清。它不是 LLM 论文，但对任何试图用并行去噪替代自回归串行生成的建模范式都有直接启发，尤其是 diffusion LM、any-order LM 和 world model。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多球硬碰撞控制环境中构造长度可控的因果链，对比标准双向视频扩散与单球长度匹配控制任务，隔离“事件依赖深度”与“序列长度”两个因素；再通过干预实验考察增加有效串行计算的手段，如自回归/分块生成和增加网络深度，并给出一个理论结论：在确定性视频预测中，去噪步数本身不提供可随任务增长而扩展的串行计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量和数据规模，但实验设计很干净：多球碰撞任务中，随着因果链变长，标准视频扩散性能下降；单球长度匹配对照中这种下降基本消失。增加自回归或 blockwise 生成、增加架构深度，都能不成比例地改善性能，支持“seriality gap”假说。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why video diffusion models degrade on prediction tasks with long causal chains, and whether the failure comes from sequence length or from insufficient serial computation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis paper with a useful theoretical correction. It is not an LLM paper, but it directly informs any attempt to replace autoregressive serial generation with parallel denoising, including diffusion LMs, any-order LMs, and world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build controlled multi-ball hard-sphere environments with adjustable causal-chain length, compare standard bidirectional video diffusion against a length-matched single-ball control to isolate dependent-event structure from raw video length, and run interventions that increase effective serial computation, such as autoregressive/blockwise generation and greater architectural depth. They further argue theoretically that, for deterministic video prediction, denoising steps do not provide scalable serial compute.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size or dataset scale, but the setup is clean: performance of standard video diffusion worsens as causal chains lengthen, while the degradation largely disappears in a single-ball length-matched control. Methods that add effective serial computation improve performance disproportionately, supporting the proposed seriality-gap hypothesis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你看 diffusion LM 的 prior：去噪步数不等于可扩展串行计算，先看控制实验和理论段，再决定是否在文本域复现。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on diffusion-style sequence modeling: denoising steps are not scalable serial compute; read the controlled experiments and theory, then decide whether to replicate in text.

paper.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
paper.abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by e

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中误差逐步累积、导致结构漂移和画质退化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法创新。它把长时序生成的稳定性问题形式化为可逆性约束问题，对 AR 生成和世界模型的误差传播有一定参考价值，但主要仍是视频生成范畴。
summary.technical_approach: Cycle-World 引入反向预测模型，在训练阶段通过 reverse-prediction cycle consistency 约束正向生成器，使生成序列能够被反向模型重建；推理阶段复用冻结的反向模型，对正向生成过程施加一致性约束，从而压制时间漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 或数值结果。实验主张面向长时视频合成，改善自回归 diffusion video model 的漂移、结构崩塌和视觉退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者中包括 Dacheng Tao，他在计算机视觉、生成模型和机器学习方向有长期代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation in autoregressive diffusion-based long-video generation, where small prediction errors compound into temporal drift and visual collapse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level advance for video generation. It is relevant to researchers thinking about sequential generative drift and world-model stability, but it is not directly about language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cycle-World adds a reverse-prediction model and enforces cycle consistency between forward generation and backward prediction. During training, the reverse model injects a reversibility constraint into the forward generator; during inference, the frozen reverse model is reused to constrain generation and reduce drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. The claimed evaluation setting is long-horizon video synthesis, with improvements in temporal consistency and reduced structural degradation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dacheng Tao, a well-known researcher in computer vision, generative modeling, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看可逆性约束怎样压住长时漂移；它对 AR 误差传播有类比价值，但不必按 LLM 方法读。
recommendation.en: Skim the reversibility constraint for long-horizon drift control; it has analogies to AR error propagation, but it is not an LLM method paper.

paper.title: ReGen: Hierarchical Multi-Prompt Representation Generation for Efficient Waveform Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) has been investigated to accelerate diffusion training, but we observe that regularizing intermediate representations in diffusion Transformers (DiT) may implicitly entangle latents and limit generative capacity. To address this issue, we propose ReGen, a hierarchical multi-prompt representation generation framework that jointly estimates multiple vector fields for both representations and data within a single diffusion model. We further introduce generalized flow

summary.core_problem: 解决单阶段 waveform diffusion 在高压缩音频 latent 上训练效率、生成质量和表征对齐之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是音频生成方法改进。它讨论了 REPA 式中间表征正则可能限制生成能力的问题，并提出面向 waveform diffusion 的多向量场生成框架；对语音/音频统一建模有间接参考，但不是语音 LM 或 LLM 预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReGen，即 hierarchical multi-prompt representation generation：在一个 diffusion model 内同时估计表征空间和数据空间的多个 vector field。论文还提出 generalized flow matching，用于改进 conditional flow matching 的泛化。方法应用在 neural audio codec 和 Wave-VAE 等低帧率音频 latent 上，并扩展为 ReGenVoice 文本转语音模型。
summary.experiments: 在 12.5 Hz 高压缩 latent 的单阶段 waveform diffusion 上验证，报告生成质量明显改善；ReGenVoice 在小数据集下取得较好的语音可懂度 WER 和说话人相似度 SIM。摘要未提供模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off between training efficiency, representation alignment, and generative capacity in single-stage waveform diffusion models over highly compressed audio latents.
summary_en.importance: It is a method contribution for audio generation. The main signal for pretraining researchers is the claim that intermediate representation regularization can hurt generative capacity, but the work is not a speech language model or a general LLM pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes ReGen, a hierarchical multi-prompt representation generation framework that jointly estimates multiple vector fields for both representations and data within one diffusion model. It also introduces generalized flow matching as an extension of conditional flow matching, and applies the framework to neural audio codec and Wave-VAE latents, with a TTS variant named ReGenVoice.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on single-stage waveform diffusion with highly compressed 12.5 Hz latent representations, where the abstract claims improved waveform generation quality. ReGenVoice reportedly achieves strong WER and speaker-similarity results using a small dataset, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 音频 diffusion 的表征正则反例值得记下；只看 REPA 失效分析和 GFM 定义即可。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as an audio-diffusion counterexample to representation regularization; read the REPA failure analysis and GFM definition.

paper.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
paper.abstract: We propose OPSD-V, an on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. Existing few-step AR video generators can produce long videos with low latency, but still suffer from error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics during long autoregressive rollout. OPSD-V reduces long-horizon degradation while preserving the original few-step inference path. The key idea is to introduce real long-video data as temporal context during training and

summary.core_problem: 解决少步自回归视频扩散模型在长视频滚动生成时误差累积、运动动态变弱的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成后训练方法：把训练过程对齐到推理时的自回归轨迹，并用更干净的教师缓存提供逐去噪状态监督。它对研究长程生成中的 exposure bias 和 cache drift 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OPSD-V，即 on-policy self-distillation。学生模型按真实推理路径生成每个视频块，并条件化在自己先前生成的 KV cache 上；教师在相同学生访问到的去噪状态上评估，但使用更干净的 AR-consistent temporal cache，其中旧历史可由真实长视频上下文替换，从而给出 dense denoising-level corrective targets。推理路径不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于 few-step AR video diffusion models，并引入真实长视频作为训练时 temporal context；声称减少长程退化并保持低延迟推理路径。未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体视频长度、基线和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics in few-step autoregressive video diffusion models during long-horizon rollout.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training method for video generation: align training with inference-time autoregressive trajectories and use a cleaner teacher cache for dense correction. It is relevant as a signal on exposure bias and cache drift in long-horizon generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPSD-V performs on-policy self-distillation. The student follows the exact inference rollout, generating each chunk conditioned on its own previously generated KV cache. The teacher is evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states, but uses a cleaner AR-consistent temporal cache where older history may be replaced by real-video context, producing dense denoising-level targets without changing inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for few-step AR video diffusion models and uses real long-video data as temporal context. It claims reduced long-horizon degradation while preserving low-latency inference, but does not report model size, dataset size, rollout length, baselines, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练-推理轨迹对齐这一点；它是视频生成论文，但 cache drift 设定可类比长程 AR LM。
recommendation.en: Skim only the train-inference trajectory alignment; it is a video paper, but the cache-drift setup maps cleanly to long-horizon AR LMs.

paper.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
paper.abstract: Score matching controls average error under the forward marginals, but a discretized reverse-time sampler evaluates the learned score along its own trajectory. We show that small forward-marginal error does not guarantee numerical stability. We construct a single smooth score field with arbitrarily small forward-marginal $L^2$ error. The learned reverse-time process is nonexplosive, has moments of every order, and can be arbitrarily close to the exact reverse-time process in path-space total var

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 score-based diffusion 采样中的一个稳定性盲区：训练时常用的 forward marginal 加权 score error 很小，并不能保证反向采样器的数值稳定。核心点在于，训练误差是在前向扩散分布的典型区域上度量的，而离散化的反向 Euler–Maruyama 采样轨迹可能进入训练分布几乎不覆盖的区域。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 和统一多模态预训练有间接但清晰的启发。它提醒我们，单一的分布加权 score loss 只能约束“数据流形附近”的平均误差，不能自动约束采样器在 off-trajectory 区域的行为。对于离散 token diffusion、masked diffusion LM、图像/文本联合 diffusion 预训练，这意味着训练 loss 很低不等于采样动力学稳定，尤其在长链采样、低温采样、classifier-free guidance 或复杂调度下更明显。贡献主要是理论反例和一个简单稳定化解释，不是新的模型 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造了一个平滑 score 场，在远离前向边缘分布高概率区域的位置加入 inward superlinear perturbation。由于该区域在 forward marginal 下概率极低，L2 score error 可以做得任意小；同时连续时间 learned reverse process 仍然 nonexplosive，具有任意阶矩，并且可在 path-space total variation 上接近精确反向过程。问题出现在显式 Euler–Maruyama 离散化：少量数值轨迹会进入远端扰动区，之后显式更新触发超线性放大。概率很小，但放大幅度足以让任意正阶矩发散。因此 endpoint 可以弱收敛，甚至概率收敛，但所有 Wasserstein-Wp 距离都发散。论文还指出，两个 score 场可以有相同且任意小的 on-path error，但一个离散链有一致矩界，另一个失去所有正阶矩；该现象也可扩展到多维、probability-flow ODE，以及固定有限 GELU 网络架构。正向结果是：若数据支持集位于已知有界闭凸集 C，将 learned denoiser 投影到 C 后再形成 score。投影不会增加逐点 denoiser 或 score error，同时让 Euler 更新的确定性部分拉回有界集合，从而得到 grid-uniform moment bounds。对图像 diffusion 来说，这对应于预测 x0 后做 clipping，论文给出了稳定性层面的解释。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论论文，核心结果是构造性反例和定理，而不是经验实验。关键结论包括：可以令 forward-marginal L2 score error 任意小；learned continuous-time reverse process 与 exact reverse process 的 path-space TV 距离任意小；learned process nonexplosive 且拥有任意阶矩；但其 Euler–Maruyama endpoint 虽然在概率意义下收敛，任意 p ≥ 1 的正阶矩均发散，因此 Wp 全部发散。论文还给出对固定有限 GELU 架构内 denoiser 的对应构造，以及 bounded convex support 下 denoiser projection 带来的矩稳定性保证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对反例机制的解释、Setup 中 VE diffusion 与 denoiser parameterization 的定义，以及关于 blind spot 的构造思路。若关心 diffusion 采样理论，需要细读主定理证明中“远端低质量区域 + 超线性显式更新放大”的概率与矩权衡。最后的 projection/clipping 正向结果值得单独看，因为它把图像 diffusion 中常见的 x0 clipping 和数值稳定性连接起来。对 LLM 预训练研究员而言，不必深挖所有测度论细节，但应吸收一个结论：loss 的分布加权方式决定了它能证什么，也决定了它证不了什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a stability gap in score-based diffusion sampling: small score error under the forward marginals does not certify numerical stability of the discretized reverse-time sampler. The learned score is evaluated during training on typical forward-noising states, while an Euler–Maruyama sampler follows its own trajectory and can visit regions that the training loss barely weights.
summary_en.importance: The result is most useful as a warning for diffusion language models and unified multimodal pretraining with diffusion-style objectives. A low distribution-weighted score loss controls average accuracy near the forward process, but it does not control off-trajectory behavior of the sampler. This matters for long sampling chains, aggressive schedules, guidance, and hybrid AR-diffusion systems where numerical trajectories can drift away from the training distribution. The contribution is mainly a theoretical counterexample plus a simple stabilization principle, not a new training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The construction places a smooth inward superlinear perturbation in a remote region with negligible mass under the forward marginals. This keeps the on-path L2 score error arbitrarily small. It also keeps the learned continuous-time reverse process nonexplosive, with moments of all orders, and arbitrarily close to the exact reverse process in path-space total variation. The failure appears after explicit Euler–Maruyama discretization. Rare numerical trajectories can enter the remote perturbed region, and the explicit updates then repeatedly amplify their magnitude. The probability of such events is tiny, but the amplification dominates the probability cost, so all positive moments of the endpoint diverge. Weak convergence, and even convergence in probability, can coexist with divergence in every Wasserstein-Wp distance. The paper also shows that the same issue can occur in arbitrary dimension, for probability-flow ODEs, and even within a fixed finite GELU architecture. A positive result is obtained for bounded data: if the data support is contained in a known closed convex set, projecting the learned denoiser onto that set before forming the score yields grid-uniform moment bounds. For image diffusion, this gives a stability interpretation of clipping the predicted clean sample.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is theoretical rather than empirical. The main results are constructive guarantees: arbitrarily small forward-marginal L2 score error; arbitrarily small path-space total variation distance between the learned and exact continuous-time reverse processes; nonexplosion and finite moments of all orders for the learned continuous-time process; but divergence of every positive endpoint moment for the Euler–Maruyama discretization. Consequently, all Wasserstein-Wp distances with p ≥ 1 diverge, despite weak convergence. The paper also proves a stabilizing moment bound for denoiser projection under bounded convex data support.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Read the Introduction for the mechanism, the Setup for the VE diffusion and denoiser parameterization, and the main counterexample section for the probability-versus-amplification tradeoff. The projection result is worth reading separately because it connects a common image diffusion heuristic, predicted-x0 clipping, to numerical stability. The main lesson is that a scalar training loss weighted by the forward marginals has limited certification power; it does not automatically constrain sampler behavior in low-density regions.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 采样时应读反例；它改变的是“低 score loss 足以保稳定”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Diffusion-LM work should read the counterexample; it breaks the default assumption that low score loss is enough for stable sampling.

paper.title: D2PO: Optimizing Diffusion Samplers via Dynamic Preference
paper.abstract: We propose D2PO (Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization), a principled framework for optimizing diffusion sampling policies with respect to timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance (CFG) weights. Our work is motivated by a fundamental limitation of existing student-teacher regression frameworks; low-NFE student samplers are trained to mimic high-NFEteachers, often sacrificing high-frequency texture fidelity while preserving coarse global structures, thereby misaligning the sampler with pe

summary.core_problem: 优化低步数 diffusion sampler 的 timestep schedule 和 classifier-free guidance 权重，避免单纯模仿高步数 teacher 时损失高频纹理质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是扩散生成采样器的偏好优化方法。它把 DPO 思路迁移到 diffusion sampler，对多模态生成和 preference-based optimization 有参考价值，但不是文本 Diffusion LM 或 LLM 预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 D2PO，即 Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization。方法把采样策略建模为 energy-based model，将偏好比较转化为能量差；同时从预训练 score network 直接构造能量形式，使偏好信号可以用于 timestep 与 CFG 动态策略优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露使用的数据集、基础 diffusion 模型、NFE 设置、评价指标或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 是 student-teacher regression 低 NFE sampler，以及高 NFE teacher 模仿范式。
summary.authors_note: Bohyung Han 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；输入元数据未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper optimizes low-NFE diffusion samplers over timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance weights, targeting the texture loss caused by teacher-regression distillation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for diffusion generation. It is relevant to multimodal generation and preference-based training, but it is not a text diffusion LM or LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: D2PO, or Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization, reformulates sampler optimization as preference alignment. It models the sampling policy as an energy-based model, turns preference comparisons into energy differences, and derives an energy formulation directly from the pretrained score network.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, base diffusion models, NFE budgets, metrics, or quantitative improvements. The stated baseline is the common student-teacher regression setup for low-NFE samplers that imitates high-NFE teachers.
summary_en.authors_note: Bohyung Han is a well-known computer vision researcher; affiliation details are not provided in the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 偏好优化迁移到 sampler 的角度可备查；若关心 LLM pretrain，只看 EBM-DPO 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for moving preference optimization into samplers; for LLM pretraining, only the EBM-DPO derivation is worth a look.

paper.title: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality generative modeling, while post-training is essential for adapting them to diverse downstream applications. However, post-training of large diffusion models is still challenging due to the prohibitive memory footprints and slow training speed, which existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods only partially address. To overcome these limitations, we propose FourTune, an efficient post-training framework for diffusion models b

summary.core_problem: 解决大规模 diffusion models 后训练时显存占用高、训练速度慢，以及现有 PEFT 方法不能充分降低反向传播开销的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是低比特训练工程与方法改进。它把 W4A4G4，即权重、激活、梯度均为 4-bit，推进到 diffusion 后训练场景，对低比特训练稳定性和带宽瓶颈有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FourTune，一个端到端 4-bit 后训练框架。核心是三分支混合 pipeline：在标准 LoRA 结构外加入 frozen numerical stabilizer，用来隔离量化敏感 outlier；同时采用 block-wise quantization 和定制 fused kernels，让量化反向传播更接近硬件友好实现。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖 diffusion model customization 和 reinforcement learning 等后训练场景，但给定信息未提供模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的是论文强调 native 4-bit computation 下的稳定训练、显存下降和带宽开销降低。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Song Han、Jun-Yan Zhu、Maneesh Agrawala、Lvmin Zhang 等，团队背景覆盖模型压缩、视觉生成和可控图像生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high memory footprint and slow training speed of post-training large diffusion models, where standard PEFT methods only reduce part of the cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly low-bit training methodology and systems engineering. Pushing W4A4G4 training—4-bit weights, activations, and gradients—into diffusion post-training is useful evidence for stability and bandwidth limits in low-precision adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: FourTune is an end-to-end 4-bit post-training framework. It augments LoRA with a triple-branch hybrid pipeline and a frozen numerical stabilizer that isolates quantization-sensitive outliers. It also uses block-wise quantization and custom fused kernels to make quantized backpropagation practical on hardware.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments across diffusion customization and reinforcement-learning-style post-training, but the provided text does not include model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The reported focus is stable native 4-bit computation with reduced memory and bandwidth overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Song Han, Jun-Yan Zhu, Maneesh Agrawala, and Lvmin Zhang, with prior work spanning model compression, visual generation, and controllable image synthesis.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 预训练不是主线；只需看 stabilizer 处理 outlier 的设计，判断能否迁移到低比特反传。
recommendation.en: Not central to LLM pretraining; read only the stabilizer design for outlier handling and assess whether it transfers to low-bit backprop.

paper.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an int

summary.core_problem: 扩散与流匹配模型的ODE采样需要数十到数百次神经函数评估(NFE)，现有加速方法多需重训练、蒸馏或轨迹重设计，无法直接用于已发布checkpoint。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次形式化端点可解码性(endpoint decodability)性质，提出完全免训练的采样加速范式，无需修改模型或训练流程即可落地。
summary.technical_approach: 证明标准仿射概率路径下，中间状态x_t与路径速度可得到最小MSE的干净样本x0估计（端点可解码性）；提出截断跳跃采样(TJS)：在ODE早停时刻t*直接解码得到x0，跳过后续迭代步骤。
summary.experiments: 在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo等图像扩散模型，以及音频、3D生成模型上验证；仅需4-8次NFE即可达到原采样器20-50次NFE的生成质量，无重训练、蒸馏或架构修改成本。

summary_en.core_problem: ODE samplers for diffusion and flow matching models require tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs); existing acceleration methods mostly need retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign, and cannot be directly applied to released checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first formalizes the endpoint decodability property, proposes a completely training-free sampling acceleration paradigm that can be deployed without model modification or training overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proves that under standard affine probability paths, the intermediate state x_t and path velocity yield the minimum-MSE estimate of clean sample x_0 (endpoint decodability); proposes Truncated Jump Sampling (TJS): stop ODE at early-exit time t* and directly decode x_0, skipping subsequent iteration steps.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on image diffusion models including SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, as well as audio and 3D generation models; achieves comparable generation quality to original samplers with 20-50 NFEs using only 4-8 NFEs, with no retraining, distillation, or architecture modification cost.

recommendation.zh: 端点可解码性的形式化结论可直接迁移到扩散语言模型的采样加速，仅看§3的证明和Fig 2的轨迹对比即可。
recommendation.en: The formal endpoint decodability conclusion is directly transferable to diffusion LM sampling acceleration; only read §3 proof and Fig 2 trajectory comparison.

paper.title: Benign Overfitting Does Not Occur in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Benign overfitting and double descent have come to shape our understanding of generalization in deep learning, establishing that overfitting is not only compatible with good generalization but can actively benefit it. Diffusion models share much of the machinery of standard deep learning, so it is natural to assume that they also exhibit these properties. In this work, we show that this assumption is largely incorrect. We first establish fundamental impossibility results showing that, unless the

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 diffusion model 的 score matching 训练是否存在类似监督学习中的 benign overfitting 和 double descent，并给出否定结论。
summary.importance: 它对新型生成建模和 diffusion LM 有间接但重要的提醒：不能把过参数化监督学习中的“插值后仍泛化”经验直接搬到 diffusion 训练。score network 拟合的是随噪声时间变化的条件去噪场，训练集记忆与总体分布泛化之间的张力更强。对预训练研究而言，启发点在于训练目标会改变泛化机制；模型越大并不自动带来 benign overfitting，过训练、低噪声段拟合、时间平滑性和 early stopping 可能比传统回归直觉更关键。对于离散 diffusion LM、masked diffusion LM 和跨模态 diffusion 预训练，这类结论提示需要重新看待数据规模、噪声日程、正则化和停止准则。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从三个层次展开。第一，给出与架构无关的负结果：在实际高维设定下，经验 score matching loss 和 population loss 很难同时很小；除非样本量随数据维度指数级增长，否则“训练损失很低且泛化很好”的 benign overfitting 条件无法同时满足。第二，分析一个线性 random feature score model，用可解模型展示模型复杂度、噪声尺度、过拟合之间的关系，并与经典回归设置对比。关键差别在于 score matching 的监督信号来自有限样本周围的去噪向量场，模型过强时会学习训练样本附近的局部结构，而不是稳定逼近总体 score。第三，讨论 score matching 中可充当隐式正则的因素，尤其是 score 在时间维度上的平滑性，以及 early stopping 对抑制记忆化的作用。它的核心不是提出新的 diffusion 架构，而是修正对 diffusion 泛化机制的默认理解。
summary.experiments: 实验分为简化模型和高维图像生成两类。在线性 random feature 设置中，随着网络宽度或复杂度增加，excess risk 呈经典 U-shaped 曲线，而不是监督学习中常见的 double descent：复杂度较小时欠拟合，中间区域泛化较好，继续增大后过拟合增强，风险上升或趋于不再改善。高维图像实验使用 U-Net 类扩散模型，展示 over-trained diffusion model 随 U-Net feature 数增加，会从低质量生成进入较好泛化区间，之后转向更明显的训练集记忆。文中强调的结果不是某个特定 architecture 的失败，而是 score matching 目标在高维有限样本下的结构性限制。提供的摘要与正文片段未给出具体 FID、样本量、维度、U-Net 宽度等数值，因此不应过度解读单个实验规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟；如果关注 diffusion LM 或统一生成模型，可以精读理论结论。优先看 Section 3 的 impossibility results，确认负结果依赖的维度、样本量和损失定义。再看 Section 4 的 random feature 分析，它最清楚地解释为什么 score matching 不沿用经典回归的 benign overfitting 直觉。Section 5 关于 time-smoothness 和 early stopping 的讨论值得和实际 diffusion 训练 recipe 对照。实验部分主要看 U-shaped risk 与 U-Net 宽度变化下的记忆化现象，不必只盯生成样例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether diffusion models exhibit benign overfitting and double descent in the same sense as overparameterized supervised models, and argues that they generally do not.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for foundation-model research is that generalization mechanisms depend strongly on the training objective. A score network is not just a regression model with a different data loader; it learns a denoising vector field indexed by noise time. In high-dimensional finite-data regimes, fitting that field too closely can move the model toward memorization rather than harmless interpolation. This matters for diffusion language models, masked diffusion pretraining, and multimodal AR-plus-diffusion systems: larger models and lower training loss should not be assumed to imply benign generalization. Noise schedules, time smoothness, regularization, and stopping criteria become part of the generalization story.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper combines architecture-independent theory, a solvable random-feature model, and image-generation experiments. The theoretical part establishes negative results showing that empirical and population score-matching losses cannot both be small in practical high-dimensional settings unless the sample size grows exponentially with dimension. This rules out the usual benign-overfitting picture for most relevant regimes. The simplified linear random-feature analysis then makes the mechanism explicit: as model complexity increases, the score estimator can fit the finite-sample denoising field around training points instead of approximating the population score. The authors contrast this with classical regression, where overparameterization can induce a form of self-regularization. They also identify sources of regularization that can help in diffusion training, especially smoothness across diffusion time and early stopping.
summary_en.experiments: In the random-feature experiments, excess risk follows a classical U-shaped curve as complexity increases rather than a double-descent curve. Small models underfit, intermediate models generalize better, and sufficiently expressive models move toward overfitting or stop improving. In high-dimensional image-generation experiments with U-Net-style diffusion models, increasing the number of U-Net features shows a similar qualitative transition: poor generation at low capacity, a generalization regime at intermediate capacity, and stronger training-set memorization when over-trained at higher capacity. The available text does not provide exact FID values, dataset sizes, feature counts, or dimensionalities, so the safe reading is qualitative: the result is about the shape of the generalization curve and the incompatibility between very low train loss and low population score-matching loss in high dimension.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate, with deeper reading if diffusion pretraining is relevant. Start with the impossibility results in Section 3 and check the assumptions behind the exponential sample-size requirement. Then read the random-feature analysis in Section 4, which is the clearest explanation of why the regression intuition breaks. Section 5 is useful for practitioners because it connects the theory to time smoothness and early stopping. For the empirical part, focus on the risk curves and the capacity-to-memorization transition rather than only on generated samples.

recommendation.zh: 理论上证明了扩散模型不存在良性过拟合，打破了深度学习的直觉，对理解 Diffusion LM 的训练动态有启发，值得看结论和机制解释。
recommendation.en: Theoretically proves the absence of benign overfitting in diffusion models, breaking deep learning intuition. Insightful for understanding the training dynamics of Diffusion LMs; worth reading the conclusions and mechanism explanations.

paper.title: A Mathematical Introduction to Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: These notes give a proof-oriented introduction to diffusion models from the viewpoint of sampling, tracing a single arc from classical sampling dynamics to modern diffusion samplers, their error analysis, and inference-time control. Throughout, the material is layered into core definitions and identities proved in full, representative estimates proved under simplifying assumptions, and research-level theorems stated with a proof roadmap. The intended audience is beginning graduate students with

summary.core_problem: 面向有概率基础但无随机微分方程、扩散模型背景的初学者，缺少从采样视角串联扩散模型核心原理、误差分析与推理控制的证明导向系统讲义。
summary.importance: 教学贡献，分层组织的数学导论填补了入门概念与研究级扩散理论之间的断层，适合系统性补全扩散模型的数学基础。
summary.technical_approach: 从采样视角切入，按难度分层组织内容：核心定义与恒等式给出完整证明，代表性估计在简化假设下证明，研究级定理给出证明路线图，覆盖经典采样动力学、现代扩散采样器、误差分析与推理时控制。
summary.experiments: 无实验，为理论综述类讲义。

summary_en.core_problem: There is a lack of proof-oriented systematic lecture notes that connect core principles, error analysis, and inference control of diffusion models from a sampling perspective for beginners with probability background but no SDE or diffusion model experience.
summary_en.importance: Educational contribution that fills the gap between introductory concepts and research-level diffusion theory with layered mathematical exposition, suitable for systematically building diffusion model mathematical foundations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organized by difficulty from a sampling viewpoint: full proofs for core definitions and identities, proofs under simplifying assumptions for representative estimates, and proof roadmaps for research-level theorems, covering classical sampling dynamics, modern diffusion samplers, error analysis, and inference-time control.
summary_en.experiments: No experiments; this is a theoretical review/lecture note.

recommendation.zh: 数学导向的扩散模型系统讲义，结构清晰，适合需要补理论基础的研究者按需查阅，作为参考资料备查即可。
recommendation.en: Proof-oriented mathematical lecture notes on diffusion models, well-structured reference for researchers needing theoretical background; consult relevant sections as needed.

paper.title: From SRA to Self-Flow: Data Augmentation or Self-Supervision?
paper.abstract: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion transformer training and improve generation quality. Recent self-alignment methods, such as SRA and Self-Flow, further remove the dependency on external pretrained encoders by constructing alignment within the diffusion model itself. However, the mechanism behind the improvement from SRA to Self-Flow, dual-time scheduling, remains under-examined: Self-Flow attributes its gain to interactions between tokens at different

summary.core_problem: Diffusion Transformer 自对齐方法（如 Self-Flow）的性能提升，究竟是来源于不同噪声水平 token 之间的交互，还是仅仅因为噪声维度的数据增强？
summary.importance: 通过解耦实验挑战了现有自对齐方法（Self-Flow）的机制解释，指出其收益主要来自数据增强而非跨噪声水平的注意力交互，为理解和优化 Diffusion 训练提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 引入“注意力分离”（Attention Separation）机制，保持与 Self-Flow 相同的双时间步输入，但阻断分配给不同噪声水平的 token 之间的注意力交互。通过对比实验，分离出跨噪声交互和数据增强的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要指出，移除跨噪声水平的注意力交互不仅没有降低性能，反而可能提升性能，暗示收益并非来自 Self-Flow 所声称的机制。
summary.authors_note: 百度（Jingdong Wang）等机构的研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Does the performance gain in Diffusion Transformer self-alignment methods (like Self-Flow) stem from interactions between tokens at different noise levels, or simply from data augmentation along the noise dimension?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the mechanistic explanation of existing self-alignment methods (Self-Flow) through decoupling experiments, pointing out that the gains primarily come from data augmentation rather than cross-noise-level attention interactions, providing a new perspective for understanding and optimizing Diffusion training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces 'Attention Separation', which maintains the same dual-timestep input as Self-Flow but blocks attention interactions between tokens assigned to different noise levels. Through comparative experiments, it disentangles the effects of cross-noise interaction and data augmentation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract notes that removing cross-noise-level attention interactions does not degrade performance and can even improve it, suggesting the gains are not from the mechanism claimed by Self-Flow.
summary_en.authors_note: Research from Baidu (Jingdong Wang) and others.

recommendation.zh: 对 Diffusion 训练机制的消融分析，指出 Self-Flow 的收益本质是数据增强而非跨步交互，对做生成模型训练的同学有一定启发，但非 LLM 核心。
recommendation.en: Ablation analysis on Diffusion training mechanisms, pointing out that Self-Flow's gains are essentially data augmentation rather than cross-step interaction; somewhat inspiring for generative model training, but not core to LLMs.

paper.title: Diffeomorphic Optimization
paper.abstract: Generative models learn data distributions that reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a higher-dimensional ambient space. Optimizing differentiable objectives on this manifold is challenging: the ambient loss landscape is high-dimensional, rugged, and non-convex. Direct gradient descent, blind to the manifold's geometry, quickly drifts off it. Diffeomorphic optimization starts from the observation that diffusion and flow models provide a map from the data manifold to a much simpler base sp

summary.core_problem: 解决在数据流形上优化可微目标时，直接梯度下降会偏离流形且损失景观崎岖非凸的问题。
summary.importance: 理论创新：提出微分同胚优化框架，将扩散/流模型的正向映射用于优化，从微分几何角度证明等价于黎曼梯度下降。
summary.technical_approach: 利用扩散/流模型提供的数据流形到简单基空间的映射，在基空间中执行梯度下降，通过微分几何证明这等价于数据流形上的黎曼梯度下降（误差O(λ²)），并将其扩展到SO(3)和SE(3)李群。
summary.experiments: 在蛋白质设计任务上验证，扩展到矩阵李群SO(3)和SE(3)，推导了兼容自动微分的SO(3)梯度和广义伴随状态方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Generate Biomedicines等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the problem that direct gradient descent on differentiable objectives defined on data manifolds drifts off the manifold and encounters a high-dimensional, rugged, non-convex loss landscape.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical innovation: proposes the diffeomorphic optimization framework that leverages the forward mapping of diffusion/flow models for optimization, with differential geometry proof of equivalence to Riemannian gradient descent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses the mapping from data manifold to simple base space provided by diffusion/flow models, performs gradient descent in the base space, and proves via differential geometry that this equals Riemannian gradient descent on the data manifold (with O(λ²) error), extending to SO(3) and SE(3) Lie groups.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on protein design tasks, extended to matrix Lie groups SO(3) and SE(3), deriving an autograd-compatible SO(3) gradient and a generalized adjoint-state method.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Generate Biomedicines and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 理论性很强的优化方法工作，将扩散模型视为流形映射用于优化，对研究扩散LM训练动态或流形优化的研究员有参考价值，重点看§3的理论推导。
recommendation.en: Highly theoretical optimization work framing diffusion models as manifold maps for optimization; reference value for researchers studying diffusion LM training dynamics or manifold optimization; focus on §3 theoretical derivation.

paper.title: Post-Training Pruning for Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated impressive performance in image generation but suffer from substantial computational overhead and resource consumption. Post-training pruning offers a promising solution; however, due to DiTs' unique architectural design and parameter distribution, traditional pruning methods are inapplicable, leading to significant performance degradation. Specifically, prior methods developed for LLMs, which derive metrics through a series of approximations, ampl

summary.core_problem: 扩散Transformer（DiT）计算开销大，传统后训练剪枝方法因DiT架构特性与参数分布差异导致性能显著下降。
summary.importance: 方法改进型工作，首次针对DiT设计定制化剪枝准则与粒度，属于扩散模型高效推理方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DiT-Pruning，从能量视角设计平衡权重与激活贡献的显著性度量，并采用适配DiT结构的剪枝粒度，缓解传统LLM剪枝方法在DiT上的性能退化。
summary.experiments: 未给出完整实验数据与基线对比，主要在图像生成DiT模型上验证剪枝效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have high computational overhead, and traditional post-training pruning methods suffer severe performance degradation due to DiT's unique architecture and parameter distribution.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in efficient inference for diffusion models, introducing customized pruning criteria and granularity tailored to DiTs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DiT-Pruning, which designs a novel saliency metric balancing weight and activation contributions from an energy-based perspective, and adopts pruning granularity adapted to DiT structures to mitigate performance drop.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details and baseline comparisons not provided; validated on image generation DiT models.

recommendation.zh: 针对DiT的后训练剪枝，属于扩散模型效率优化，对LLM预训练研究员参考有限，可作为背景了解。
recommendation.en: Post-training pruning for DiTs falls under diffusion model efficiency optimization, with limited reference value for LLM pretraining researchers; useful as background knowledge only.

paper.title: The Illusion of High Utility in Safety Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Safety alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models aims to suppress harmful generations while preserving utility on benign prompts. Recent methods often appear to deliver high safety with high utility, but this conclusion rests largely on coarse global utility metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore) that are insensitive to fine-grained semantic correctness, creating an illusion of high utility. We show that when utility is measured with structured evaluation, this illusion breaks: on TIFA (Text-to-

summary.core_problem: 研究文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐是否真的能在抑制有害生成的同时保留正常提示词上的语义生成能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与机制分析：指出常用的全局图像质量指标会高估安全对齐后的模型效用，细粒度语义一致性才暴露出真实损失。这对多模态生成模型的对齐评估有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 TIFA 这类结构化问答式图文一致性评估替代只看 FID、CLIPScore 的粗粒度指标，并分析文本编码器的 prompt embedding 空间。核心发现是安全对齐会造成 semantic collapse，即 embedding 分布收缩并扭曲不同 prompt 之间的相似性结构；论文还据此提出一个缓解策略，但摘要中方法名与细节被截断。
summary.experiments: 实验比较若干安全对齐后的 T2I diffusion 模型，在全局指标上看似保持较好效用，但在 TIFA 上出现明显语义保真度下降，错误集中在物体数量、属性和关系等细粒度维度。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: Mubarak Shah 是视觉领域知名研究者，长期在视频理解和计算机视觉方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether safety-aligned text-to-image diffusion models truly preserve benign-prompt utility while suppressing harmful generations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluative and diagnostic: coarse global metrics can make aligned T2I models look useful, while structured semantic evaluation reveals substantial utility loss. This is relevant to alignment evaluation for multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors replace reliance on FID and CLIPScore with structured TIFA-style question-answering evaluation for image-text faithfulness, then inspect the prompt embedding space of the text encoder. They identify semantic collapse: contracted embedding spread and distorted inter-prompt similarity structure. The abstract also mentions a mitigation method, but the provided text truncates its details.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare safety-aligned T2I diffusion models and show that global metrics can remain favorable while TIFA exposes semantic fidelity drops in object counts, attributes, and relations. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data details, or exact numerical deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: Mubarak Shah is a well-known computer vision researcher with long-running work in video understanding and visual recognition.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但“安全对齐压缩语义空间”这个诊断值得记；只看 TIFA 结果和 embedding collapse 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the semantic-collapse diagnosis is worth tracking; read the TIFA results and embedding-space analysis only.

paper.title: Introduction to Stochastic Differential Equations for Generative Machine Learning: A Variational Perspective
paper.abstract: The use of ordinary and stochastic differential equations has led to substantial progress in generative machine learning with applications to, for example, image, video and biomolecule generation. This paper provides a self-contained and informal introduction to the differential equations, the probabilistic framework for using them in generative modeling and the Fokker--Planck equation that governs the temporal evolution of the marginal distribution of the stochastic variables of the differentia

summary.core_problem: 这是一篇面向生成建模的 SDE/ODE 入门与统一推导，核心问题是把 diffusion、score matching、flow matching 等方法放进同一个变分概率框架中解释。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的直接贡献有限，但对研究 diffusion LM、flow matching LM、masked diffusion language model 这类非自回归建模范式有背景价值。它补齐的是数学接口：Fokker-Planck 方程、反向 SDE、ELBO、score/flow 目标之间的关系。对于已经在做离散 diffusion LM 或连续 latent LM 的研究者，价值在于帮助检查训练目标的概率含义，而不是提供新的大规模训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 内容从 Markov ODE/SDE 出发，写作形式刻意避免直接依赖 Itô calculus 和 Girsanov theorem，而是用有限差分、Taylor 展开和极限直觉推导核心公式。先定义 dx_t = f(x_t,t)dt + sigma(x_t,t)dW_t，再解释边缘分布随时间演化的 Fokker-Planck 方程。随后从生成模型的概率路径出发推导变分下界，把 SDE 训练目标作为统一起点，并说明 diffusion models、score matching、flow matching 可以看作这一目标的不同参数化。一个额外方向是构造解析可处理、但不局限于 Gaussian marginals 的 stochastic process，这对设计非标准噪声过程有参考意义。
summary.experiments: 没有大规模模型实验，也没有面向 LLM 的实证结果。实验部分主要是简单的一维密度建模例子，用来比较不同连续时间生成建模视角下的行为。结果更适合作为概念验证，不能据此判断方法在语言建模或高维多模态生成中的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 45-60 分钟。已有 diffusion/flow 基础的读者可以跳过 ODE/SDE 基础部分，重点看 Section 5 的 ELBO 推导、Section 6 的 SDE objective 参数化、Section 7 中 diffusion、score matching、flow matching 的统一关系。若关注 diffusion LM，可以额外看非 Gaussian marginals 的构造思路，但需要自行判断它如何迁移到离散 token 或 latent token 空间。

summary_en.core_problem: This is a self-contained primer on ODE/SDE-based generative modeling. It aims to derive diffusion models, score matching, and flow matching from a shared variational probabilistic framework.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on base LLM pretraining is modest, but it is useful background for non-autoregressive language modeling work such as diffusion LMs, flow-matching LMs, and continuous latent generative models. The paper clarifies the mathematical interface between the Fokker-Planck equation, reverse-time SDEs, ELBOs, and common score or flow objectives. The value is conceptual rather than recipe-level.
summary_en.technical_approach: The exposition starts from Markovian ODEs and SDEs of the form dx_t = f(x_t,t)dt + sigma(x_t,t)dW_t. Instead of relying heavily on Ito calculus or Girsanov’s theorem, it uses finite-difference reasoning, Taylor expansions, and informal limiting arguments to derive the Fokker-Planck equation and related probabilistic machinery. The training objective is then developed through a variational lower bound on log likelihood. Diffusion, score matching, and flow matching are presented as different parameterizations of this general objective. The paper also discusses how to construct analytically tractable processes beyond the usual Gaussian-marginal setting.
summary_en.experiments: There are no large-scale language or multimodal experiments. The empirical component is a simple one-dimensional density modeling comparison, mainly used to illustrate the derived objectives and their behavior. It should be read as a teaching example, not as evidence for performance in high-dimensional generative modeling.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 45-60 minute skim is appropriate. Readers already comfortable with SDE notation can move quickly through the early ODE/SDE sections and focus on the ELBO derivation, the SDE objective parameterization, and the section connecting diffusion, score matching, and flow matching. For diffusion-LM researchers, the discussion of non-Gaussian tractable processes is the part most worth checking, though adapting it to discrete tokens or latent token spaces remains a separate modeling problem.

recommendation.zh: 面向生成模型的SDE/变分基础导论，做diffusion/flow LM可读§2-§4梳理目标关系，纯AR方向可跳过。
recommendation.en: Introductory tutorial on SDE/variational foundations of generative models; read §2-§4 for objective connections if working on diffusion/flow LMs, skip if focused solely on AR.

paper.title: Notes on generative modeling: flow matching, diffusion, optimal transport and Schr{ö}dinger bridge
paper.abstract: These notes recapitulate the high level mathematical principles behind different techniques for generative modeling. I show the connections between optimal transport and standard techniques such as Schr{ö}dinger bridge and flow matching.

summary.core_problem: 梳理 flow matching、diffusion、optimal transport 与 Schrödinger bridge 几类生成建模方法的数学联系与统一视角
summary.importance: 综述/讲义性质，为理解连续时间生成模型（包括 flow matching LM、discrete diffusion 的连续对应）提供数学脉络；无新方法但理清了 OT 视角下的等价关系
summary.technical_approach: 以最优传输为核心脉络，回顾并串联 Schrödinger bridge、flow matching、diffusion SDE/ODE 在概率路径、速度场、得分匹配与桥接分布上的对应关系
summary.experiments: 纯理论讲义/综述，无模型实验与数值对比
summary.authors_note: 作者 Titouan Vayer，研究方向为 optimal transport 与生成建模；未标注具体机构

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a unified high-level mathematical account of flow matching, diffusion models, optimal transport, and Schrödinger bridges in generative modeling
summary_en.importance: Expository notes that clarify connections between OT, Schrödinger bridges, and flow matching; useful background for researchers working on continuous-time generative paradigms including flow-matching LMs
summary_en.technical_approach: Recasts diffusion, flow matching, and Schrödinger bridges through the lens of optimal transport, drawing explicit links between probability paths, velocity fields, score matching, and bridge distributions
summary_en.experiments: Theoretical survey with no empirical experiments or model comparisons
summary_en.authors_note: Single author Titouan Vayer, working on optimal transport and generative modeling; affiliation not stated in the paper

recommendation.zh: 做 flow-matching / discrete diffusion LM 的人适合当数学备忘，看 §2-§3 的 OT-FM 对应即可，无新实验结论
recommendation.en: Useful as a clean math refresher if you work on flow-matching or diffusion LMs; read §2–§3 for the OT–FM correspondence, but expect no new empirical results.

paper.title: Diffusion Fine-tuning with Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation
paper.abstract: Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning are the primary pillars of diffusion post-training. While traditionally studied in isolation, the interaction between these phases remains poorly understood, and in particular how fine-tuning impacts the generative quality of distilled models. We introduce Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD), a novel framework that simultaneously distills diffusion models and maximizes a reward function. RMMD preserves the high-fidelity ``naturaln

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型的两类核心后训练路径——蒸馏（压缩采样步数、提升推理速度）和奖励微调（对齐人类偏好或下游任务目标）——长期被独立研究，二者的结合存在本质矛盾：直接在蒸馏过程中加入奖励优化会使生成样本逐步偏移出教师模型的分布，导致蒸馏信号失效；先完成蒸馏再对少步模型做奖励微调，则需要通过多步采样链反传梯度，内存开销高，截断反传会引入梯度偏差，现有方法无法同时兼顾采样速度、生成样本自然度和奖励对齐效果。
summary.importance: 这是扩散模型后训练的框架性工作，其核心设计（将蒸馏目标复用为on-policy对齐阶段的分布正则项）可迁移到扩散语言模型（如MDLM、LLaDA等非AR建模范式）的加速与对齐流程中，对探索AR范式之外的大模型后训练路径有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出带奖励的矩匹配蒸馏（RMMD）两阶段框架：第一阶段采用标准矩匹配蒸馏（MMD）训练多步学生模型，使其匹配教师模型采样轨迹上的所有中间去噪分布，训练完成后冻结该学生模型作为稳定的分布参照；第二阶段采用单步on-policy梯度微调：对当前学生生成的样本加噪到随机中间时间步，执行单步去噪后计算奖励，避免多步反传的内存开销与梯度偏差；同时复用第一阶段的矩匹配损失作为正则项，约束微调过程中学生的中间去噪分布不偏离冻结的参照模型，通过单一正则权重即可显式权衡奖励提升与样本保真度，不需要额外的启发式惩罚项。
summary.experiments: ImageNet上的FID-奖励帕累托对比显示，RMMD的表现优于DRaFT、HyperNoise、DI++等现有联合蒸馏与对齐方法；在扩散天气预报模型GenCast上，RMMD将原模型59步的采样流程压缩到8步（7.5倍加速），同时93%的预报变量精度高于单独使用MMD蒸馏的模型，预报结果的分布离散度也更合理。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第二阶段将蒸馏损失复用为正则项的设计逻辑，以及单步on-policy梯度的构造方式，不需要深究图像生成与气象预测的具体实验细节，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The two core post-training pipelines for diffusion models — distillation (to reduce sampling steps and improve inference speed) and reward fine-tuning (to align outputs with preferences or task objectives) — have historically been developed in isolation. Naively combining them creates a fundamental conflict: adding reward optimization during distillation shifts generated samples out of the teacher distribution, invalidating distillation signals; fine-tuning a pre-distilled few-step model requires backpropagation through multi-step sampling chains, incurring high memory cost and biased gradients when backprop is truncated. No existing method reliably balances sampling speed, sample naturalness, and reward alignment.
summary_en.importance: This is a framework-level contribution to diffusion model post-training. Its core design choice — repurposing the distillation objective as a distributional regularizer for on-policy alignment — transfers directly to acceleration and alignment workflows for diffusion language models (e.g., MDLM, LLaDA and other non-AR language modeling paradigms), providing useful reference for post-training research beyond autoregressive LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD) uses a two-stage pipeline: 1) First train a multi-step student via standard Moment Matching Distillation (MMD), which matches all intermediate denoising distributions along the teacher's sampling trajectory, then freeze this student as a stable distributional reference. 2) Fine-tune the student with single-step on-policy gradients: corrupt samples from the current student to a random intermediate timestep, run one denoising step, and compute reward on the output, eliminating the memory cost and bias of multi-step backpropagation. The MMD loss from the first stage is reused as a principled regularizer during fine-tuning, penalizing drift between the student's intermediate denoising distributions and the frozen reference. A single regularization weight explicitly controls the tradeoff between reward gain and sample fidelity, with no need for ad-hoc heuristic penalties.
summary_en.experiments: On ImageNet, RMMD achieves a better FID-reward Pareto frontier than prior joint distillation-alignment methods including DRaFT, HyperNoise, and DI++ across multiple reward functions. Applied to the GenCast diffusion weather forecasting model, RMMD reduces sampling from 59 network evaluations to 8 (7.5x speedup), while delivering higher accuracy on 93% of forecast variables compared to MMD-only distillation, with better calibration of forecast distribution spread.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the two-stage training design and the regularizer reuse logic in Section 3. Skip image generation and weather forecasting experiment details unless working on applied diffusion modeling. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将扩散模型的蒸馏和 RL 对齐结合的漂亮工作，把蒸馏 loss 当作 KL 惩罚的思路对理解生成模型的后训练动态有启发。
recommendation.en: Elegant work combining distillation and RL alignment for diffusion models; repurposing distillation loss as a KL penalty offers insights into post-training dynamics of generative models.

paper.title: Concept Removal for Frontier Image Generative Models
paper.abstract: Image generative models are trained on massive, largely uncurated internet-scale datasets that contain undesirable visual concepts. Efficiently removing such concepts from the model generations without degrading the quality of output images remains challenging. We introduce a novel concept removal method for frontier diffusion and image autoregressive models, such as SD3.5, Flux, and Infinity. Our intervention replaces the internal bottleneck layer present in all these modern models with a trans

summary.core_problem: 解决前沿图像生成模型中不希望出现的视觉概念难以被持久移除、且现有方法常伴随画质退化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于生成模型安全/可控性与模型编辑。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“在不重训的情况下做持久概念擦除”这一参数内干预思路有一定参考价值，尤其对统一多模态模型的安全后处理有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把现代扩散或图像 AR 模型中的内部 bottleneck 层替换为一个可解释的 transcoder。该 transcoder 先拟合原层行为，再把激活组织成可分离特征，从而能关闭与目标概念相关的内部信号；因为修改发生在主干内部，而不是外挂过滤器，所以在白盒访问下仍然持续有效。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在 SD3.5、Flux、Infinity 等前沿扩散与图像自回归模型上达到概念移除的最好结果，同时尽量保持生成质量。未给出具体数据规模、训练成本和退化幅度，因此更适合作为方法点子而非立即采纳的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses persistent removal of undesirable visual concepts from frontier image generators without significantly degrading output quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-safety/model-editing contribution rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Still, the idea of persistent in-model concept erasure without full retraining is relevant to safety interventions in unified multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces an internal bottleneck layer in modern diffusion and image autoregressive models with a structured transcoder. The transcoder is trained to reproduce the original layer while disentangling activation features, enabling selective disabling of concept-specific signals inside the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims state-of-the-art concept removal on SD3.5, Flux, and Infinity while preserving image quality. It does not provide detailed scales, training cost, or exact trade-off numbers, so this is more of a method idea than a fully settled recipe.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练主线不直接相关，但“主干内可持续概念擦除”这个手法值得记住；只看方法图和消融，别花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not central to pretraining, but the persistent in-backbone concept erasure trick is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations only.

paper.title: The Geometry Behind Diffusion and Flow Matching: Gradient Flows and Geodesics in Wasserstein Space
paper.abstract: The space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathbb{R}^d$) of probability measures with finite second moment carries a natural geometry: the quadratic Wasserstein distance W_2 makes it a complete metric space and, following Otto, a (formal) Riemannian manifold whose geodesics are the optimal-transport interpolations. On this manifold, the gradient flow of the free energy F(rho) = KL(rho || π) is exactly the Fokker-Planck equation, and its implicit-Euler discretization is the JKO scheme. This is the geometry underl

summary.core_problem: 用 Wasserstein 空间的几何语言统一解释 diffusion model 与 flow matching 的生成机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏理论统一与概念澄清。它把 DDPM、DDIM、NCSN/SMLD、Energy Matching 和 Flow Matching 放到同一个最优传输/梯度流框架下，对研究 diffusion LM、flow-based LM 或跨模态统一生成目标有一定帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从二阶矩有限的概率测度空间出发，使用 W2 距离、Otto 几何、KL 自由能梯度流、Fokker-Planck 方程、JKO 隐式 Euler 离散和 Benamou-Brenier 动作最小化来解释扩散去噪与 flow matching。核心不是提出新模型，而是给出现有生成模型训练目标之间的几何等价关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示实证实验或模型规模信息，主要是数学推导和理论整合；没有报告训练数据、参数量或 benchmark 提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains diffusion models and flow matching through a unified geometric view in Wasserstein space.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a theoretical unification rather than a new training recipe. It may help researchers working on diffusion language models, flow-based language modeling, or unified multimodal generative objectives reason about apparently different objectives under one variational framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses the W2 geometry of probability measures, Otto calculus, KL free-energy gradient flows, the Fokker-Planck equation, the JKO implicit Euler scheme, and the Benamou-Brenier minimum-action formulation to connect denoising diffusion and flow matching. The contribution is conceptual consolidation, not a new architecture.
summary_en.experiments: No empirical setup is visible from the abstract. The work appears to be mathematical and expository, with no reported model sizes, datasets, baselines, or benchmark gains.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion/flow LM 可扫一眼几何映射；不是新 recipe，别把理论等价误读成训练等价。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick read for diffusion or flow LM work; it is a geometric map, not evidence that the training recipes are interchangeable.

paper.title: Catastrophic Compositional Generation: Why Vanilla Diffusion Models Fail to Extrapolate
paper.abstract: The task of compositional generation involves using a conditional generative model, trained only on a subset of the possible conditions, to produce samples from compositionally-defined target distributions such as a geometric combination of the source distributions. In this work, we argue that this task is often infeasible for vanilla conditional diffusion models: we conjecture that no inference-time technique can efficiently produce samples from the target distribution in certain well-motivated

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论条件 diffusion 模型在组合式外推中的失败原因：即使目标分布可以写成若干已观测源分布的几何组合，vanilla conditional diffusion 也不一定能在推理时高效采样出目标分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“分布层面的可识别性”和“模型层面的可采样性”明确区分开。很多跨条件、跨模态、跨任务的生成模型都依赖组合泛化假设，例如把已有条件的 score 线性组合，或在推理时做 correction。这篇论文指出，主要瓶颈可能不是推理算法近似误差，而是 learned score 在源分布低密度区域的估计误差。这个结论对 diffusion LM、masked generation、条件生成预训练都有参考意义：如果目标组合落在训练条件的低密度区域，单靠 inference-time guidance 或 particle correction 很难补上训练信号缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 compositional generation：给定扰动空间 A 和结果空间 X，只观测到一小部分条件下的分布 P^a，希望生成未观测条件 a* 对应的 P^{a*}。重点研究一种常见情形：目标密度可以表示为源分布密度的几何加权组合。这个设定在因果扰动、生物实验组合、概念组合生成中都自然出现。几何组合在干净分布上对应 score 的线性组合，因此已有方法常在 denoising 过程中直接线性组合各条件 score。论文指出，前向加噪会破坏这种线性关系，所以会产生 inference-time approximation error。Feynman-Kac Corrector 这类方法用粒子和重要性权重沿 denoising trajectory 做校正，可以缓解这类误差。但论文的核心判断是：在许多组合外推场景里，目标分布的典型样本位于源分布的低密度区域，训练得到的 score 在这些区域缺少统计约束，score estimation error 会成为主导误差。更麻烦的是，FKC 的权重修正可能放大这些错误 score，导致样本质量进一步退化。
summary.experiments: 实验设计的重点不是追求单一指标，而是拆开两类误差：一类是由于噪声下 score 组合关系不再精确带来的推理近似误差，另一类是模型学习到的 score 与真实 score 之间的估计误差。论文在合成数据和更接近真实的组合生成任务上验证：直接 score addition 在若干组合场景中失效；FKC 在 oracle score 或 score 估计足够可靠时可以降低推理近似误差；但当目标样本落入源分布低密度区域时，learned score 的误差占主导，FKC 不但不能修复问题，还可能强化错误权重和错误轨迹。给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的任务定义，确认几何组合、score 线性组合和因果扰动之间的关系；再看 Appendix B 中关于因果表示的连接。Section 4 是关键，重点看作者如何用可解析例子解释低密度区域中的 score 误差为什么不可避免。Section 5 的实验应关注误差拆解，而不是只看最终样本。最值得深挖的是 FKC 失败的条件：它不是简单的“correction 方法不好”，而是 correction 依赖的 learned score 已经在目标区域失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why conditional diffusion models can fail at compositional extrapolation: even when the target distribution is identifiable as a geometric combination of observed source distributions, a vanilla conditional diffusion model may not provide an efficient sampling procedure for that target.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson for pretraining research is the separation between distribution-level identifiability and model-level sampleability. Many generative pretraining setups rely on compositional assumptions, including score composition, classifier-free guidance variants, and inference-time correction. This work argues that the limiting factor can be learned-score error in low-density regions, not only approximation error from the sampler. That matters for diffusion language models, masked generative models, and multimodal conditional generation: if the composed target lives where the training conditions provide weak density support, inference-time tricks have little reliable signal to exploit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates compositional generation over a perturbation space A and an outcome space X. Only a subset of conditions is observed, and the goal is to sample from an unseen condition whose density can be written as a geometrically weighted product of source densities. At the clean-data level, such a geometric product corresponds to a linear combination of score functions, which explains the common heuristic of adding conditional scores during denoising. The paper then separates two error sources. The first is inference-time approximation error: after forward noising, the clean-distribution score identity no longer holds exactly. Particle-based methods such as Feynman-Kac Correctors attempt to reduce this error by tracking importance weights along the reverse process. The second is score estimation error: typical samples from the composed target may lie in low-density regions of each source distribution, where the learned score is poorly constrained. The main claim is that this second error often dominates, and FKC-style correction can amplify it rather than repair it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to disentangle approximation error from learned-score error. On synthetic and more realistic compositional-generation settings, naive score addition fails in distinct regimes. Feynman-Kac correction helps when the score estimates are reliable or close to oracle scores, showing that the approximation issue is real and correctable. But when the target distribution concentrates in low-density regions of the sources, score estimation error dominates. In that regime, correction can reinforce incorrect trajectories through its importance weights and degrade sample quality. The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete numerical tables, so exact effect sizes should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read Section 2 for the formal setup and the connection between geometric density composition and score addition. Check Appendix B for the causal-perturbation motivation. Section 4 is the most important part because it explains, through analytically tractable examples, why low-density score errors arise. Section 5 should be read for the error decomposition rather than only for final sample quality. The key point to inspect is when Feynman-Kac correction helps and when it amplifies the wrong learned score.

recommendation.zh: 对扩散组合外推的负面结论干净且有理论支撑，做多模态统一预训练或扩散LM的人应重点看 §3 的泛化论证与 Fig 4 的受控实验。
recommendation.en: The negative result on diffusion compositional extrapolation is clean and theory-backed; read §3 generalization arguments and Fig 4 controlled experiments if you work on multimodal pretraining or diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Cyclic Denoising Reveals Ultrastable Memories in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We introduce cyclic denoising -- repeated forward and reverse diffusion at controlled noise amplitudes -- as an extraction attack for image diffusion models. Inspired by random organization in disordered solids, cyclic denoising exposes regions of the learned distribution that are largely inaccessible to standard sampling. The dynamics drive samples toward attractors with a broad stability spectrum. The deepest attractors are ultrastable: they regenerate after near-total corruption and persist t

summary.core_problem: 揭示图像扩散模型中存在可以通过循环去噪稳定提取的记忆样本（含训练图像、水印、爬取伪影），无需梯度或对训练数据的先验知识。
summary.importance: 从无序固体物理的随机组织类比出发，提出一种新的数据提取/记忆化攻击视角，对理解扩散模型记忆化与训练数据泄露有方法论价值，并与离散扩散语言模型的记忆化问题形成类比。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 cyclic denoising：在控制噪声幅度下反复执行 forward noising 与 reverse denoising，使样本收敛到宽稳定性谱上的吸引子；最深的吸引子对近完全噪声鲁棒、可历经数千循环再生，且常对应被记住的训练数据。攻击仅需 sampler 级控制，不依赖梯度、权重检查、prompt、caption 或训练集先验。
summary.experiments: 在图像扩散模型上演示该攻击可提取库存照片、品牌水印、web-crawl 伪影等记忆样本，并与依赖大规模 prompt 生成+相似度/成员推断过滤的 generate-and-filter 攻击对比，说明其不依赖后验筛选的特性（摘要未给出具体模型规模/数据集数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Show that image diffusion models contain ultrastable memorized samples (training images, watermarks, crawl artifacts) that can be extracted by cyclic denoising without gradients or prior knowledge of training data.
summary_en.importance: Drawing an analogy to random organization in disordered solids, it offers a new attack/analysis angle on memorization and training-data leakage in diffusion models, with a conceptual analogy to memorization in discrete diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce cyclic denoising: repeatedly apply forward noising and reverse denoising at controlled noise amplitudes, driving samples toward attractors with a broad stability spectrum; the deepest attractors regenerate after near-total corruption and persist over thousands of cycles, often corresponding to memorized training images. The attack needs only sampler-level control—no gradients, weight inspection, prompts, captions, or prior knowledge of training data.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrated on image diffusion models by extracting stock photos, brand watermarks, and web-crawl artifacts, and contrasted with generate-and-filter attacks that rely on large-scale prompted generation plus post-hoc similarity or membership-inference filtering; no concrete model-scale or dataset numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型记忆化的漂亮动力学视角，结论对离散扩散/MDLM 类文本模型的记忆泄露问题有类比价值，但只看方法和攻击设定即可，不必深挖实验。
