recommendation.en: A neat dynamical-systems view of diffusion memorization with useful analogies for memorization in discrete diffusion / MDLM-style text models; read the method and attack setup, no need to dig into image experiments.

paper.title: Information-Theoretic Classifier-Free Guidance with Adaptive Schedule Optimization
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image, text-to-image, and video generation, where conditional generation is often controlled by classifier-free guidance (CFG). CFG improves condition consistency by increasing a guidance weight, but stronger guidance typically reduces diversity and distributional coverage. It remains unclear how this consistency-coverage trade-off should be controlled across the reverse trajectory, since the distribution induced by CFG is not simply the fixed

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型的无分类器引导（CFG）通常采用全局固定引导权重，无法在整个反向生成轨迹上最优平衡条件一致性与样本多样性，且缺少逐时间步引导调度的principled优化框架
summary.importance: 提出信息论视角的CFG自适应调度优化框架，实现轨迹级别的一致性-多样性权衡最优控制，为扩散模型引导采样设计提供新的理论视角
summary.technical_approach: 以去噪端点的干净数据分布作为参考，显式定义期望的一致性-多样性权衡目标，将引导采样轨迹诱导的分布向参考分布优化；推导无需显式密度估计的轨迹级目标估计子，仅需样本和分数模型输出即可计算梯度，自适应优化每个时间步的引导权重
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet类别条件图像生成任务上验证，相比固定权重CFG基线，在相同FID下提升了条件分类准确率，或在相同一致性水平下提升了生成样本的多样性与分布覆盖率

summary_en.core_problem: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) in diffusion models typically uses a fixed global guidance weight, which cannot optimally balance conditional consistency and sample diversity across the full reverse trajectory, and lacks a principled framework for per-timestep guidance schedule optimization.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes an information-theoretic framework for adaptive CFG schedule optimization, achieving trajectory-level optimal tradeoff between consistency and diversity, and provides a new theoretical perspective for guided diffusion sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The clean endpoint data distribution is used as reference to define the desired consistency-diversity tradeoff, and the distribution induced by guided sampling is optimized toward this reference; trajectory-level objective estimators are derived that avoid explicit density estimation, using only samples and score outputs to compute gradients for adaptive per-timestep weight optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on ImageNet class-conditional image generation, the method improves conditional classification accuracy at equal FID, or improves diversity and coverage at equal consistency, compared to fixed-weight CFG baselines.

recommendation.zh: 信息论框架下的扩散CFG自适应调度工作，仅在ImageNet图像生成上验证，做离散文本扩散的研究者扫一眼摘要即可，无需跟进细节
recommendation.en: Information-theoretic adaptive CFG schedule for diffusion, validated only on ImageNet; skip details unless you actively work on discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Diffusion-Driven State Space Models
paper.abstract: In many domains, practitioners seek models that produce accurate forecasts while faithfully capturing latent system dynamics. Existing approaches typically sacrifice one of these goals: deep state space models often assume Gaussian latent transitions, limiting fit and forecasting, while diffusion models are highly expressive but lack principled inference for the underlying dynamics. To combine the strengths of both, we introduce the Diffusion-Driven State Space Model (DDSSM), which replaces the

summary.core_problem: 深度状态空间模型（SSM）通常假设潜变量转移服从高斯分布，表达能力受限；而时序潜扩散模型普遍采用自编码器与扩散模型两阶段训练，会产生过正则化的潜空间，且缺乏联合训练的原则性方法，两者各自牺牲了表达能力或动力学可解释性。
summary.importance: 将扩散模型作为 SSM 的潜转移函数，提出了自编码器与扩散模型联合训练的时序潜扩散方案，为序列建模提供了兼具强表达能力与显式潜动力学结构的新范式；该思路对语音 LM、长序列建模、统一多模态时序表示等预训练方向有潜在借鉴价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diffusion-Driven State Space Model（DDSSM）：在经典 SSM 的生成框架下，保留观测由潜状态生成的发射结构，将原本参数化的高斯转移密度替换为扩散模型。具体而言，对每个时间步的潜状态 z_t 引入 K 步扩散加噪过程（z_t^1 到 z_t^K，z_t^K 近似标准高斯），通过边缘化中间扩散变量恢复任意形式的转移密度，支持多模态、非高斯的潜动力学。扩散模型以时间步索引 t、噪声水平 k 以及前序潜状态和协变量为条件，用单一网络参数化所有时间步与噪声水平的转移族；发射模型仍采用高斯形式以捕捉剩余不确定性。该结构天然支持端到端联合训练，解决了时序潜扩散两阶段训练导致的潜空间过正则化问题。
summary.experiments: 论文方法部分给出了生成模型的因子化分解、扩散转移的增广形式以及条件输入设计；实验结果在摘要中提及 DDSSM 在预测、潜动力学推断等任务上优于现有深度 SSM 与时序扩散基线，但全文提供的具体数值、数据集、模型规模与消融细节不完整。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 30 分钟。重点关注第 2 节方法中扩散模型如何嵌入 SSM 的转移密度、以及联合训练的目标构造；理解两阶段训练潜扩散的缺陷与 DDSSM 的对应改进逻辑；实验部分若后续补充完整可再核对具体指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Deep state space models typically assume Gaussian latent transitions, limiting expressivity, while latent diffusion models for time series usually rely on two-stage training of an autoencoder followed by a diffusion model — which leads to over-regularized latent spaces and lacks a principled joint training recipe. Each line of work sacrifices either expressive power or interpretable latent dynamics.
summary_en.importance: DDSSM uses a diffusion model as the latent transition kernel of an SSM and enables principled end-to-end joint training of the autoencoder and the diffusion model on sequential data. It offers a new sequence-modeling paradigm that combines strong expressive power with explicit latent dynamical structure, and has potential implications for pretraining directions such as audio LMs, long-sequence modeling, and unified multimodal temporal representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: DDSSM retains the standard SSM factorization where observations are emitted from latent states, but replaces the conventional parametric Gaussian transition density with a diffusion model. For each timestep latent state z_t, it introduces a K-step diffusion noising process producing intermediate states z_t^1 … z_t^K, with z_t^K approximately standard Gaussian. Marginalizing these intermediate variables recovers a highly flexible transition density capable of modeling multimodal and non-Gaussian latent dynamics. A single diffusion network parameterizes the full family of transition densities across all timesteps and noise levels, conditioned on the timestep index t, the noise level k, the preceding latent states, and any covariates. The emission model remains Gaussian to capture residual uncertainty. The architecture naturally supports end-to-end joint training and avoids the over-regularized latent space caused by two-stage latent diffusion training.
summary_en.experiments: The method section details the generative factorization, the augmented diffusion transition formulation, and the conditioning design. The abstract claims DDSSM outperforms existing deep SSM and temporal diffusion baselines on forecasting and latent dynamics inference, but the provided full text does not include complete numerical results, dataset specifications, model sizes, or ablation details.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 30 minutes. Focus on Section 2 to understand how the diffusion model is embedded as the SSM transition kernel and how the joint training objective is constructed; pay attention to why two-stage training fails for temporal latent diffusion and how DDSSM addresses it. Numerical results can be revisited if a complete version of the paper is released.

recommendation.zh: 将 Diffusion 引入 SSM 的转移分布，虽然针对时间序列，但这种结合连续动力学和生成模型的思路对探索新型序列建模范式有启发。
recommendation.en: Introduces Diffusion into the transition distribution of SSMs. Although targeted at time series, this idea of combining continuous dynamics and generative models is inspiring for exploring novel sequence modeling paradigms.

paper.title: Variance-Tilted Diffusion Models for Diverse Sampling
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are typically sampled independently, even when the downstream objective is to obtain a diverse set of candidates. We introduce a variance-weighted batch distribution that favours collections of samples with large empirical spread after a prescribed linear feature map. The target is specified explicitly, and the sampler is derived as the corresponding Doob $h$-transform of independent diffusion dynamics. The resulting correction has a compact form: an interaction term that repels

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型独立采样难以产出多样性候选集的问题，构造可解释的批量多样化采样器。
summary.importance: 属于采样策略的方法创新，首次通过Doob h变换将指定特征方差的批量分布目标严格融入扩散动力学。
summary.technical_approach: 定义方差加权批量分布作为目标，通过独立扩散过程的Doob h变换推导修正项，得到包含互斥相互作用项与曲率项的粒子交互采样器，避免启发式漂移。
summary.experiments: 理论推导为主，配合低维与标准生成任务演示采样多样性与目标分布一致性；未与大规模LLM/图像扩散SOTA直接对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Design a principled diffusion sampler that produces a diverse batch of samples under a prescribed linear feature map, rather than sampling independently.
summary_en.importance: A sampling-method innovation that rigorously encodes a batch-diversity objective into diffusion dynamics via the Doob h-transform, instead of heuristic repulsion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Specify a variance-weighted batch distribution as target; derive the sampler as the Doob h-transform of independent diffusion dynamics; obtain an interacting-particle update with a repulsion term between denoised means and a curvature term steering toward higher feature-variance regions.
summary_en.experiments: Theory-heavy; validated on low-dimensional and standard generative benchmarks to demonstrate improved diversity and target alignment; no direct comparison against large-scale LLMs or image-diffusion SOTA systems.

recommendation.zh: 扩散采样层面的小创新，若在做文本扩散或多样化解码可速览推导部分，否则不必深读。
recommendation.en: A modest sampling-level innovation on diffusion; only worth skimming the derivation if you work on diffusion LM or diverse decoding.

paper.title: Robust Diffusion Models via Divergence-Induced Weighted Denoising
paper.abstract: We show that replacing the standard MSE denoising loss in diffusion models with a nonlinear transformation induced by an f-divergence yields a simple robust training surrogate that empirically improves performance under data contamination, with small additional computational overhead. The theoretical foundation rests on a local divergence construction: under the Gaussian reverse-kernel structure of DDPM, each per-step likelihood ratio follows a lognormal distribution parameterized by a scalar mi

summary.core_problem: 解决标准扩散模型采用MSE去噪损失时对数据污染敏感、鲁棒性差的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于f散度的加权去噪训练框架，统一扩散训练目标，仅增加极小计算开销即可提升污染场景下的性能
summary.technical_approach: 基于DDPM高斯反向核的结构特性，证明每步似然比服从由标量失配参数化的对数正态分布，将每步条件f散度退化为去噪误差的一维函数；求和得到散度诱导的加权去噪目标，用散度导数作为残差空间的样本权重，采用有界散度（如Hellinger、负指数）抑制大误差异常样本的贡献
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量、数据集与量化提升幅度，仅经验验证该方法在数据污染场景下优于标准MSE损失，额外计算开销可忽略

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the poor robustness of standard diffusion models under data contamination caused by sensitivity of the standard MSE denoising loss
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an f-divergence induced weighted denoising framework that unifies diffusion training objectives, improving performance under contamination with negligible computational overhead
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the Gaussian reverse-kernel structure of DDPM to prove per-step likelihood ratios follow a lognormal distribution parameterized by scalar mismatch, reducing per-step conditional f-divergence to a 1D function of denoising error; sums local divergences to form a weighted denoising objective, using the divergence derivative as sample weight in residual space, with bounded divergences (Hellinger, negative exponential) suppressing high-error outlier samples
summary_en.experiments: No specific model parameter count, dataset, or quantitative improvement margin disclosed; empirically validated to outperform standard MSE loss under data contamination with negligible extra compute cost

recommendation.zh: 通用扩散的鲁棒损失设计，做扩散LM的可参考样本加权思路，仅看方法部分的散度推导即可
recommendation.en: Robust loss design for general diffusion; reference for sample weighting in diffusion LMs, only read the divergence derivation in the method section

paper.title: On the Redundancy of Timestep Embeddings in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models rely heavily on explicit timestep embeddings to modulate the denoising process across various noise scales. In this work, we challenge the necessity of these temporal signals by analyzing their impact on U-Net and Diffusion Transformer architectures. Beyond empirical evidence, we provide a theoretical framework demonstrating that, under certain conditions, the global minimizer of the diffusion training objective can be achieved without explicit timestep conditioning. Our finding

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型无论采用U-Net还是Diffusion Transformer（DiT）骨干，普遍依赖显式时间步嵌入调节不同噪声尺度的去噪过程，该设计被视为默认标准，但缺乏对其必要性的系统实证验证与理论分析。
summary.importance: 揭示了扩散、流匹配类生成架构的简化空间：移除时间步嵌入可减少参数量，消除条件信号注入的开销；同时明确了扩散训练目标的一项关键特性：模型可直接从带噪输入x_t中隐式推断噪声尺度，这一结论可为统一多模态生成（如AR+diffusion联合建模）的条件设计提供参考，减少冗余的显式条件；对损失函数全局最优解的条件分析，也可为扩散预训练的目标设计提供理论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先完成系统消融：在U-Net和DiT两种主流扩散骨干上完全移除所有显式时间步条件（包括U-Net的时间步位置编码、DiT的AdaIN时间调制模块），仅将带噪输入x_t作为模型唯一输入进行训练。随后构建理论框架：基于Tweedie公式与DDPM训练目标和噪声条件分数匹配的等价性，证明在数据分布正则、噪声尺度可从x_t的统计特性推断的条件下，扩散损失的全局最优解无需显式时间步条件，模型可从x_t本身隐式编码噪声尺度信息。
summary.experiments: 在CelebA和CIFAR-10数据集上完成消融实验：无显式时间步嵌入的时间无关扩散模型可保持高结构保真度，在部分主流评价指标上甚至优于带显式时间步条件的对应基线模型。该结论在U-Net和DiT两种架构上均成立，排除了架构特例的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读引言部分，理解该工作对扩散模型默认设计假设的挑战；再重点查看“损失函数中时间步的冗余性”章节的核心理论推导步骤，尤其是Tweedie公式的应用、隐式噪声尺度推断的成立条件；最后查看U-Net与DiT在两个数据集上的消融对比表格。预计阅读时间25-30分钟，无需深入琐碎的数学证明细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion models, regardless of using U-Net or Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbones, universally rely on explicit timestep embeddings to modulate denoising across different noise scales. This design is treated as a default standard, but lacks systematic empirical validation and theoretical analysis of its actual necessity.
summary_en.importance: It reveals a viable simplification path for diffusion and flow-matching based generative architectures: removing timestep embeddings reduces parameter count and eliminates the overhead of conditional signal injection. It also clarifies a key property of diffusion training objectives: models can implicitly infer noise scale directly from the corrupted input x_t, which informs conditional design for unified multimodal generation (e.g., joint AR-diffusion models) by cutting redundant explicit conditioning. The analysis of global minimizer conditions for the loss also provides theoretical references for diffusion pretraining objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, systematic ablations are conducted on two mainstream diffusion backbones (U-Net and DiT), where all explicit timestep conditioning (including positional encodings for U-Nets and AdaIN timestep modulation for DiTs) is completely removed, leaving only the noisy input x_t as the sole model input for training. Then a theoretical framework is constructed: based on Tweedie’s formula and the equivalence between the DDPM training objective and noise-conditional score matching, it proves that under conditions where the data distribution is regular and noise scale can be inferred from the statistical properties of x_t, the global minimizer of the diffusion loss can be achieved without explicit timestep conditioning, as the model can implicitly encode noise scale information from x_t itself.
summary_en.experiments: Ablations are carried out on CelebA and CIFAR-10 datasets. Time-agnostic diffusion models without explicit timestep embeddings retain high structural fidelity, and even outperform their timestep-conditioned baselines on several mainstream evaluation metrics. This finding holds for both U-Net and DiT architectures, ruling out architecture-specific confounding factors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction to understand the challenge to the default design assumption of diffusion models. Then focus on the core theoretical derivation steps in the "Redundancy of Timesteps in the Loss Function" section, especially the application of Tweedie’s formula and the valid conditions for implicit noise scale inference. Finally, review the ablation comparison tables for U-Net and DiT on both datasets. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes; no need to dive into trivial mathematical proof details.

recommendation.zh: 反常识结论直接冲击扩散模型设计的核心默认假设，做扩散LM（LLaDA/MDLM）的研究员应重点看§3理论推导与§4消融，验证是否可迁移到离散文本扩散。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding challenging a core default assumption of diffusion design; diffusion LM researchers should review §3 theory and §4 ablations to test transfer to discrete text diffusion.

paper.title: BindEdit: Taming Attention Leakage for Precise Multi-Object Image Editing
paper.abstract: Real image editing enables precise manipulation of visual content, yet existing methods often fail in complex multi-object scenarios, causing semantic blending, object duplication, or incomplete edits. We attribute these failures to attention leakage, where signals across spatial regions and text tokens become entangled during the denoising process. Specifically, we identify two distinct forms of leakage: Edit-Token Leakage, where ambiguous token-region alignment leads to object blending, and So

summary.core_problem: 解决真实图像多对象编辑中的语义混合、对象复制和编辑不完整问题，核心诊断是去噪过程中的 attention leakage。
summary.importance: 这是图像 diffusion 编辑方法贡献。对 LLM 基座研究的直接价值有限，但对理解 text-to-image diffusion 中 token-region binding、cross-attention/self-attention 约束有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: BindEdit 将泄漏分成两类：Edit-Token Leakage，即目标 token 与空间区域对齐不清导致对象混合；Source Dominance Leakage，即未编辑源对象 token 压制目标对象注意力。方法在单条 diffusion trajectory 内加入注意力级约束，同时正则 cross-attention 与 self-attention，使目标 token group 绑定到对应区域并保持实例分离。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于复杂多对象真实图像编辑，并与现有方法比较其编辑精度和泄漏抑制能力；但未给出模型 backbone、数据集规模、baseline 列表或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets failures in real-image multi-object editing, such as semantic blending, duplicated objects, and incomplete edits, attributing them to attention leakage during denoising.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an image diffusion editing method. It has limited direct value for LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to token-region binding and attention-control mechanisms in text-conditioned generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: BindEdit separates leakage into Edit-Token Leakage, caused by ambiguous token-region alignment, and Source Dominance Leakage, where unchanged source-object tokens dominate attention for target entities. It imposes attention-level constraints within a single diffusion trajectory, jointly regularizing cross- and self-attention to bind target token groups to their intended spatial regions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation on complex real-image multi-object editing and comparisons against existing methods, but does not specify the backbone, dataset size, baselines, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 不必读完整论文；若关心多模态生成里的 token binding，只看 attention leakage 的两类诊断。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; if you care about token binding in multimodal generation, inspect the two attention-leakage diagnoses.

paper.title: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are typically trained with objectives that focus on local denoising targets at individual time steps (or adjacent pairs), which do not enforce consistency between predictions along the denoising trajectory. This lack of cross-time consistency can degrade performance, especially for few-step samplers. We introduce a temporal difference (TD) objective that penalizes inconsistency of the model's multi-step progress along the denoising path. By reformulating the diffusion process as

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型传统训练目标仅关注单步或相邻步局部去噪，缺乏沿整条去噪轨迹的跨时间步一致性约束，导致少步采样时样本质量明显下降。
summary.importance: 范式创新：首次将强化学习中的时序差分 TD 思想引入扩散训练，统一适用于离散与连续时间扩散，为提升少步采样质量提供了新的训练目标维度。
summary.technical_approach: 将扩散过程建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，把去噪视为策略评估问题，推导出惩罚多步预测不一致性的 TD 目标；进一步提出基于采样的加权方法稳定训练，可与原有去噪损失联合优化。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成基准上评测，加入 TD 训练目标后 FID 显著下降，且采样步数越少收益越明显；在离散与连续时间扩散设置下均一致有效。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional diffusion training objectives only enforce local denoising consistency at individual or adjacent timesteps, lacking cross-timestep consistency along the full denoising trajectory and thus degrading sample quality under few-step sampling.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level innovation: the first work to import temporal-difference learning from RL into diffusion training in a unified formulation for both discrete- and continuous-time diffusion, opening a new training-objective axis for few-step sampling quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reformulates the diffusion process as a Markov reward process and denoising as policy evaluation, deriving a TD objective that penalizes inconsistency in the model's multi-step progress; a principled sample-based reweighting scheme stabilizes training and can be combined with standard denoising losses.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on image generation benchmarks; adding the TD objective significantly reduces FID, with larger gains as sampling steps decrease, and consistently benefits both discrete- and continuous-time diffusion formulations.

recommendation.zh: 把 TD 一致性引入扩散训练目标的思路可迁移到离散扩散/MDLM 等文本建模范式，重点读 §3 的目标推导与 §4 的加权方案。
recommendation.en: Injecting TD consistency into diffusion training objectives is transferable to discrete diffusion / MDLM text modeling; focus on §3 derivation and §4 reweighting scheme.

paper.title: Divide-and-Denoise: A Game-Theoretic Method for Fairly Composing Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: The abundance of pre-trained diffusion models provides an opportunity for composition. Combining several models, however, runs the risk of one model dominating or models disagreeing with each other. Here, we propose Divide-and-Denoise, a method for coordinating multiple pre-trained diffusion models during sampling. Much like managing a specialized workforce, our method creates a fair but efficient division of labor across models. Central to our method is the notion of an allocation which defines

summary.core_problem: 组合多个预训练 diffusion model 采样时，避免某个模型主导生成结果或多个模型在同一区域给出冲突 denoising 信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型采样组合方法。它不是语言模型预训练工作，但对“多个专家生成模型如何在一个样本上分工”这个问题给出可形式化方案，可作为 diffusion 组合和生成式 MoE 的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Divide-and-Denoise，在每个采样 timestep 同时更新样本和模型分工。核心变量是 allocation，定义每个模型对噪声样本不同区域的责任；先求解带公平约束的分配博弈，以最大化总 utility 并避免单模型垄断，再引导各模型只在被分配区域内 denoise，形成分配过程和去噪过程耦合的采样算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明作者评估了多预训练 diffusion model 的组合采样，但未给出数据集、模型类型、baseline 和具体数值。实验重点应是与简单模型组合、无公平约束组合或单模型采样相比的区域控制和生成质量。
summary.authors_note: Tommi Jaakkola 是机器学习和生成建模领域知名研究者；Samuel Kaski 长期从事概率机器学习和交互式 AI 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to compose multiple pretrained diffusion models during sampling without one model dominating or different models producing conflicting denoising signals.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling-time composition method for generative diffusion models. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the formal division-of-labor view is relevant to expert composition in generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Divide-and-Denoise introduces an allocation variable that assigns each model responsibility over regions of the noisy sample. At each timestep, it solves a fair-division game to maximize total utility under fairness constraints, then guides each model to denoise only its assigned regions, coupling allocation dynamics with denoising dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is evaluated for composing pretrained diffusion models, but does not provide datasets, model families, baselines, or numerical results. The likely comparisons are against naive composition, unconstrained composition, and single-model sampling.
summary_en.authors_note: Tommi Jaakkola is a well-known researcher in machine learning and generative modeling; Samuel Kaski is known for probabilistic machine learning and interactive AI.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 allocation 目标即可；对 LLM 预训练不直接，但分工式生成组合有类比价值。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and allocation objective only; not LLM-pretraining work, but useful as an expert-composition analogy.

paper.title: Exact Posterior Score Estimation for Solving Linear Inverse Problems
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models learn powerful data priors by training a denoiser to reverse Gaussian corruption. To use this prior to solve a linear inverse problem, one needs to sample from the posterior, but the score that the prior provides is the unconditional score, not the posterior score. Existing methods either steer a fixed pretrained denoiser with approximate measurement-matching corrections, or train a conditional restoration model that abandons the denoising structure of the prior.

summary.core_problem: 扩散/流模型求解线性逆问题时，训练得到的是无条件分数而非后验分数，现有方法只能近似修正或放弃去噪结构。
summary.importance: 理论推导贡献：首次给出一般高斯插值项下线性高斯逆问题精确后验分数的闭合形式。
summary.technical_approach: 推导了精确后验分数(EPS)的闭合形式，证明后验采样等价于算子依赖的平移枢轴处各向异性噪声协方差下的去噪问题；提出EPS训练目标，保留标准预训练的输入/输出结构，可从头训练或从预训练去噪模型微调。
summary.experiments: 摘要中未详述具体实验结果、基准和模型规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括Yee Whye Teh（Oxford/DeepMind）、James Matthew Rehg（Georgia Tech）。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion/flow-based models for linear inverse problems face a fundamental gap: the trained score is unconditional, not the posterior score needed for conditional sampling.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical contribution: first closed-form exact posterior score for linear Gaussian inverse problems under general Gaussian interpolants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives Exact Posterior Score (EPS) in closed form, showing posterior sampling reduces to denoising at an operator-dependent shifted pivot under anisotropic noise covariance. EPS training objective preserves the input/output structure of standard pretraining, allowing both scratch training and fine-tuning from a pretrained denoiser.
summary_en.experiments: Detailed experimental results, baselines, and model sizes not described in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Yee Whye Teh (Oxford/DeepMind) and James Matthew Rehg (Georgia Tech).

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型后验分数的精确理论推导有学术价值，对理解Diffusion/Flow Matching的数学基础有启发；但应用于图像逆问题，与LLM预训练无直接关联，仅作理论背景备查。
recommendation.en: Exact posterior score derivation for diffusion models is academically interesting for Diffusion/Flow Matching theory but applied to image inverse problems; no direct relevance to LLM pretraining, suitable as theoretical background only.

paper.title: Accelerating Speculative Diffusions via Block Verification
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM inference by using a draft model to generate tokens, with an acceptance-rejection scheme that ensures that the output matches the target distribution. Adapting this to continuous diffusions is difficult because speculative sampling requires drawing from a residual distribution. While straightforward in discrete spaces, efficiently sampling this residual in continuous space is non-trivial. Consequently, existing diffusion adaptations either use computationally i

summary.core_problem: 解决连续扩散模型中 speculative sampling 难以高效实现 residual distribution 采样、因此难以复用 LLM block verification 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率方法。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对“如何把 AR 侧成熟的 speculative decoding 思想迁移到非 AR 生成范式”有参考价值，尤其对统一生成系统和 AR+diffusion 混合 serving 有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种可在连续空间中高效实现原始 speculative sampling 机制的方案，使扩散模型也能进行 acceptance-rejection 校正并保持目标分布不变。在此基础上，把 LLM 中的 block verification 迁移到 diffusion，理论上提高 draft 接受率；同时形式化分析 Free Drafter 这一 self-speculative 启发式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和加速倍数。实验应围绕与现有 diffusion speculative 方法比较采样效率、接受率和分布保真度，并验证 block verification 与 Free Drafter 的收益。没有看到与 LLM 本体训练或语言建模直接相关的实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Arnaud Doucet、Valentin De Bortoli，偏概率建模与扩散方向，方法论较扎实。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of implementing speculative sampling in continuous diffusion models, where sampling from the residual distribution is non-trivial and prevents a clean transfer of LLM-style block verification.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its value for foundation-model researchers is mainly conceptual: how mature AR decoding ideas can be ported to non-AR generative paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a scheme that efficiently realizes the original speculative sampling mechanism in continuous diffusion spaces, preserving the target distribution through acceptance-rejection correction. This enables block verification for diffusion models, which is argued to improve draft acceptance rates. They also formalize and analyze the Free Drafter self-speculative heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or speedup numbers. The likely evaluation compares against prior diffusion speculative methods on sampling efficiency, acceptance rate, and fidelity to the target distribution. There is no direct LLM-training experiment here.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Arnaud Doucet and Valentin De Bortoli, both well known in probabilistic modeling and diffusion-related research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把 LLM speculative decoding 的 clean 机制搬到 diffusion 很工整；只看方法节和接受率分析，别指望它直接改你的训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly ports speculative-decoding machinery to diffusion; read the method and acceptance-rate analysis, not for training recipe changes.

paper.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models contain rich spatial priors. Synthesizing photorealistic, cluttered scenes requires an understanding of geometry, including perspective and relative scale. Prior works adapt T2I models to leverage this prior for depth prediction, but they require dense depth data and involve complex recipes. We propose Modality Forcing, a simple, scalable post-training recipe for joint image-depth generation using a single DiT trained on sparse depth data. Modality Forcing enables cond

summary.core_problem: 如何利用文本到图像（T2I）模型的空间先验，通过简单的后训练配方实现可扩展的图像和深度联合生成？
summary.importance: 提出Modality Forcing，一种简单且可扩展的后训练方法，仅需稀疏深度数据即可在单个DiT上实现图像和深度的联合生成，避免了以往方法对密集深度数据的依赖和复杂的训练流程。
summary.technical_approach: 通过为每种模态分配独立的噪声水平（Modality Forcing），实现图像和深度在任意排列下的条件和联合生成。使用每种模态的解码器，允许在稀疏的真实世界深度数据上进行训练。通过从头训练一系列T2I模型（370M到3.3B），验证了该方法继承了T2I预训练的可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 训练了370M到3.3B参数的模型，发现更大的模型在更多图像数据上训练能产生更准确的深度。最强模型在深度预测上具有竞争力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自CMU、Google DeepMind等，Deva Ramanan和Justin Johnson是计算机视觉领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to leverage the spatial priors of Text-to-Image (T2I) models for scalable joint image and depth generation using a simple post-training recipe?
summary_en.importance: Proposes Modality Forcing, a simple and scalable post-training method enabling joint image and depth generation on a single DiT using only sparse depth data, avoiding the reliance on dense depth data and complex pipelines of prior methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Enables conditional and joint generation of image and depth in any permutation by assigning separate noise levels per modality (Modality Forcing). Per-modality decoders allow training on sparse, real-world depth data. Validates that the method inherits T2I pre-training scalability by training a suite of T2I models from scratch (370M to 3.3B).
summary_en.experiments: Trained models from 370M to 3.3B parameters, finding larger models trained on more image data produce more accurate depth. The strongest model is competitive in depth prediction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from CMU, Google DeepMind, etc. Deva Ramanan and Justin Johnson are well-known scholars in computer vision.

recommendation.zh: 通过独立噪声调度实现多模态（图像+深度）联合生成的后训练方法，对多模态 Diffusion 建模有一定启发，但偏向 CV 任务。
recommendation.en: A post-training method achieving multimodal (image+depth) joint generation via independent noise scheduling, offering some inspiration for multimodal Diffusion modeling, but leans towards CV tasks.

paper.title: Towards More General Control of Diffusion Models Using Jeffrey Guidance
paper.abstract: A key strength of diffusion models lies in their flexibility, since their outputs can be controlled at sampling time through guidance. However, beyond simple cases such as conditional sampling, the target distribution is often left implicit, defined only through a sampling rule or a heuristic energy function. To address this, we propose Jeffrey guidance, a principled framework that extends diffusion-model control to applications beyond what standard guidance can express. It leverages Jeffrey's r

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型采样时的引导控制问题：标准引导方法难以表达超越简单条件采样的复杂目标分布(如指定嵌入分布、公平性约束)。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出Jeffrey引导框架，利用Jeffrey条件更新规则将边际分布推向指定目标，同时保持条件结构并最小化联合分布扰动。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Jeffrey条件更新规则，在保持条件结构的前提下更新边际分布至目标；通过目标嵌入分布(如Inception嵌入)实现扩散模型控制。
summary.experiments: 在CIFAR-10和FFHQ上以Inception嵌入为目标，FID显著降低；在CelebA-HQ上应用公平性约束，强制属性之间独立。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Jes Frellsen(哥本哈根大学，扩散模型知名研究者)，来自哥本哈根大学、蔚蓝海岸大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that standard diffusion model guidance cannot easily express complex target distributions beyond simple conditional sampling (e.g., prescribed embedding distributions, fairness constraints).
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes Jeffrey guidance, a principled framework leveraging Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to update marginals toward a prescribed target while preserving conditional structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to update marginal distributions toward target while preserving conditional structure and minimally perturbing the joint; enables diffusion control via target embedding distributions (e.g., Inception).
summary_en.experiments: Substantial FID reductions on CIFAR-10 and FFHQ using Inception embeddings as target; fairness application on CelebA-HQ enforcing independence between attributes.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Jes Frellsen (notable diffusion model researcher, University of Copenhagen); affiliations include University of Copenhagen, Université Côte d'Azur.

recommendation.zh: Jeffrey条件更新用于扩散引导是有趣的概率视角，但应用集中在图像生成，与文本扩散LM的映射需自行推演，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Jeffrey conditioning for diffusion guidance is an interesting probabilistic perspective, but applications are on image generation; mapping to diffusion LMs requires extrapolation; read abstract only.

paper.title: The Geometry of Phase Transitions in Generative Dynamics via Projection Caustics
paper.abstract: Continuous-state generative samplers, including diffusion and flow-matching models, evolve through continuous reverse-time dynamics, yet their samples often undergo abrupt qualitative changes: trajectories commit to modes, semantic alternatives collapse, and small perturbations in narrow time windows can produce large downstream effects. This paper develops a geometric account of such phase-transition-like behaviour. We view denoising as gradient descent on a free energy landscape and show that

summary.core_problem: 解释 diffusion 和 flow-matching 采样轨迹中为何会出现突然的模式承诺、语义分支坍缩和窄时间窗敏感性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成动力学的几何分析和诊断工具：它把连续反向采样中的突变现象联系到 projection caustics，并提出可定位敏感时间窗的 Critical Boundary Detector；对研究 diffusion LM 或统一 AR+diffusion 建模的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 denoising 看作自由能景观上的梯度下降，认为当到数据支撑集的最近点投影不再唯一时，会形成 projection caustics，从而产生相变式行为。基于这个几何视角，提出 CBD，用 score direction instability 作为实用诊断信号，定位 mode commitment 和可控干预窗口。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 toy models、标准 diffusion models 和 latent text-to-image diffusion models。结果显示 CBD 能定位模式承诺阶段、预测对干预敏感的时间窗，并支持在几何敏感区域进行 targeted control。摘要未给出具体模型规模或量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why continuous diffusion and flow-matching samplers can show abrupt mode commitment, semantic collapse, and narrow intervention-sensitive time windows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a geometric account of generative dynamics plus a diagnostic tool. It is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers interested in diffusion language models or hybrid AR-diffusion generation, but the experiments are mainly continuous and image-generation oriented.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors view denoising as gradient descent on a free-energy landscape and attribute sharp transitions to projection caustics, where nearest-point projection onto the data support becomes non-unique. They introduce the Critical Boundary Detector, which diagnoses score-direction instability and identifies sensitive regions along the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on toy settings, standard diffusion models, and latent text-to-image diffusion models. CBD localizes mode-commitment events, predicts intervention-sensitive windows, and supports targeted control in geometrically sensitive regions. The abstract does not provide model scale or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 diffusion dynamics 直觉材料看摘要和 CBD 图即可；离离散 LM 还有距离，不应直接外推到 MDLM/LLaDA。
recommendation.en: Use it as intuition for diffusion dynamics and skim the CBD figures; do not directly transfer the claims to MDLM or LLaDA-style discrete LMs.

paper.title: Learning to Solve Generative ODEs Beyond the Linear Span
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow generative models sample by integrating a learned ODE, but high quality still requires many sequential model evaluations. Solver learning reduces this cost by adapting scalar coefficients, timesteps, or both, while keeping the backbone model fixed. In this work, we identify a structural bottleneck in this update family: each step remains span-limited. Since the scalar-coefficient update lies in the span of buffered velocity evaluations, it can fit only the in-span component wh

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散和流生成模型中，学习求解器（solver learning）仅限于在缓冲速度评估的线性张成空间内更新，导致无法拟合张成空间外残差的问题。
summary.importance: 指出了现有 ODE 求解器学习方法的一个结构性瓶颈，并提出了一种轻量级的神经求解器 SpanLift 来突破这一限制，提升了生成质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpanLift，在标量系数更新的基础上增加了一个空间残差算子。它保持固定的基础求解器作为张成空间内的先验，并在状态和速度缓冲区上学习一个空间残差算子。该算子通过端点教师匹配进行训练，保留了预训练的主干网络，且不增加模型 NFE（网络函数评估次数）。
summary.experiments: 经验表明，学习到的校正可以跨模型转移。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation in solver learning for diffusion and flow models where updates are confined to the linear span of buffered velocity evaluations, leaving out-of-span residuals unreachable.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a structural bottleneck in existing ODE solver learning and proposes SpanLift, a lightweight neural solver to overcome this limitation and improve generation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SpanLift, which augments scalar-coefficient updates with a spatial residual operator. It keeps a fixed base solver as an in-span prior and learns a spatial residual operator over the state and velocity buffer. Trained via endpoint teacher matching, it preserves the pretrained backbone and adds no model NFEs.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically shows that the learned correction transfers across models.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion/Flow 模型的 ODE 求解器优化，指出了线性张成空间的局限并提出改进，对关注连续时间生成范式的研究员有一定参考价值，但非核心 LLM 预训练内容。
recommendation.en: Optimizes ODE solvers for Diffusion/Flow models by addressing linear span limitations; relevant for continuous-time generative modeling but peripheral to core LLM pretraining.

paper.title: WhiFlash: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Token-Level Cross-Paradigm Routing
paper.abstract: The autoregressive nature of large language models (LLMs) remains a significant bottleneck for inference, particularly in complex agentic workloads. While speculative decoding (SD) accelerates inference, current approaches rely on static drafting paradigms, utilising either autoregressive drafting models for reasoning or diffusion-based parallel drafting models for structured outputs. We empirically find that drafting accuracy fluctuates dramatically within a single sequence, leaving significant

summary.core_problem: 解决推测解码（Speculative Decoding）中单一静态草稿模型（自回归或基于扩散的并行模型）在不同序列片段中准确率波动大、导致加速效果受限的问题。
summary.importance: 首次提出跨范式（自回归与扩散并行）的 token 级别推测解码路由机制，打破了现有推测解码依赖单一草稿模型范式的局限，为推理加速提供了新的优化维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WhiFlash，一个在 token 级别统一自回归和基于扩散的并行草稿模型的控制器。采用细粒度路由机制，使用轻量级基于熵的策略或学习到的神经策略，在预期 token 增益和延迟之间进行可调平衡，以实现高频切换。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体加速比数字，但强调了其在处理复杂 agentic 工作负载时，通过动态切换草稿范式来应对草稿准确率剧烈波动的有效性。
summary.authors_note: Samsung AI Center Cambridge 团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the limitation in Speculative Decoding where a single static drafting paradigm (autoregressive or diffusion-based parallel) suffers from fluctuating accuracy across different sequence segments, limiting acceleration.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first cross-paradigm (autoregressive and diffusion parallel) token-level routing mechanism for speculative decoding, breaking the limitation of relying on a single drafting paradigm and offering a new optimization dimension for inference acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces WhiFlash, a token-level controller unifying autoregressive and diffusion-based parallel drafting models. It employs a fine-grained routing mechanism using either a lightweight entropy-based or a learned neural policy, parameterized to balance expected token gain and latency for high-frequency switching.
summary_en.experiments: Specific speedup numbers are not in the abstract, but it emphasizes effectiveness in handling complex agentic workloads by dynamically switching drafting paradigms to counter dramatic fluctuations in drafting accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by researchers at Samsung AI Center Cambridge.

recommendation.zh: 将 AR 和 Diffusion 草稿模型做 token-level 动态路由的想法很有新意，直击了不同生成阶段（推理 vs 结构化输出）对草稿模型能力需求不同的痛点，做推理加速的同学重点看其路由策略的 overhead 和实际端到端加速比。
recommendation.en: The idea of token-level dynamic routing between AR and Diffusion draft models is novel, directly addressing the varying capability needs of draft models across different generation phases (reasoning vs. structured output). Inference optimization researchers should focus on the routing overhead and actual end-to-end speedup.

paper.title: Mitigating the Contractivity Trap in Diffusion ODEs via Stein Stabilization
paper.abstract: A fundamental tension exists in the large-step inference of diffusion models via their deterministic probability flow ordinary differential equation (PF-ODE) trajectories, which we identify as the contractivity trap: efficient inference favors large step sizes, while aggressive steps and highly expressive denoisers can undermine contraction-based stability certificates for error suppression. To address this, we propose SteinDiff, a step-wise inference-time stabilization framework that employs St

summary.core_problem: 如何解决扩散模型在大步长推理时，由于高表达能力去噪器破坏收缩稳定性而导致的“收缩陷阱”问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需参考样本的推理时稳定框架，通过 Stein 修正来正则化大步长求解器更新，提高了扩散模型大步长推理的稳定性和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SteinDiff 框架，引入几何感知的残差修正机制。推导了用于逐步求解器调整的闭式 Stein 修正系数，实现对局部数据几何的无参考自适应。建立分布偏移下的分数控制扰动界限。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详细说明具体实验结果，主要强调了理论推导和方法提出。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the 'contractivity trap' in large-step inference of diffusion models, where highly expressive denoisers undermine contraction-based stability?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a reference-free inference-time stabilization framework that regularizes large-step solver updates via Stein corrections, improving the stability and efficiency of large-step inference in diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the SteinDiff framework with a geometry-aware residual correction mechanism. Derives a closed-form Stein correction coefficient for step-wise solver adjustment, enabling reference-free adaptation to local data geometry. Establishes a score-controlled perturbation bound under distributional shifts.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental results are not detailed in the abstract; the focus is on theoretical derivation and method proposal.

recommendation.zh: 从理论角度分析并缓解了扩散模型大步长推理的稳定性问题，对关注 Diffusion 采样效率和理论机制的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Analyzes and mitigates the stability issues of large-step inference in diffusion models from a theoretical perspective, valuable for researchers focusing on Diffusion sampling efficiency and theoretical mechanisms.

paper.title: Diffusion Models Observe Only Gradients: A Geometric Perspective on Score Matching Errors
paper.abstract: Score-based diffusion models are typically trained by minimizing the $L^2$ score matching error, and standard theoretical analyses rely on this quantity to bound the sampling discrepancy between the learned and target distributions. We show the $L^2$ score error is not the right intrinsic measure of marginal distributional quality: a learned diffusion model can incur arbitrarily large $L^2$ score error while perfectly matching the target distribution. By decomposing score errors into a gradient

summary.core_problem: 揭示L2 score matching误差并非衡量扩散模型边际分布质量的正确内在指标，并从几何角度解释其原因
summary.importance: 理论分析贡献，通过Helmholtz-Hodge分解将score误差分解为梯度分量和旋度分量，证明只有梯度分量影响边际Fokker-Planck动力学，旋度分量在结构上不可见
summary.technical_approach: 利用Helmholtz-Hodge分解将score误差场分解为无旋的梯度分量和无散的旋度分量；在修正几何基础上证明三个结果：L2 score误差的单调函数无法一致下界任何散度、去噪分数匹配目标不能控制旋度分量、可通过正则化控制边际误差
summary.experiments: 以理论分析和证明为主，无大规模实验验证；核心贡献是不可能性定理和几何分解

summary_en.core_problem: Reveal that L2 score matching error is not the correct intrinsic measure of marginal distribution quality in diffusion models, and explain why from a geometric perspective
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution; uses Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition to separate score errors into gradient (affects Fokker-Planck dynamics) and solenoidal (structurally invisible) components
summary_en.technical_approach: Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of score error field into irrotational gradient component and divergence-free solenoidal component; three main results: impossibility of L2 score error monotone function lower bounding any divergence, denoising score matching cannot control solenoidal component, regularization can control marginal error
summary_en.experiments: Primarily theoretical analysis and proofs; no large-scale experimental validation; core contribution is impossibility theorem and geometric decomposition
summary_en.authors_note: Richard E. Turner is a senior author known for work on generative models and probabilistic machine learning

recommendation.zh: score matching误差的几何分解有理论意义，对Diffusion LM目标函数设计有启发。但纯理论无实验验证，作为文献背景了解即可。
recommendation.en: Geometric decomposition of score matching errors is theoretically interesting and relevant to Diffusion LM objective design. Purely theoretical without experimental validation; worth knowing as background.

paper.title: Autoregressive Diffusion World Models for Off-Policy Evaluation of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents in multi-turn interactive environments is expensive and risky, as it requires online environment interaction. We propose ADWM (Autoregressive Diffusion World Model), an evaluation framework that estimates the performance of a new LLM agent policy purely from pre-collected trajectories. The core idea is to learn a latent diffusion world model that simulates how the environment responds to the evaluation policy, without ever executing it in the real env

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮交互式 LLM agent 在线评测昂贵且有风险的问题，用离线轨迹估计新 agent policy 的表现。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent off-policy evaluation 方法。它不是预训练工作，但触及一个真实痛点：agent policy 迭代不能总依赖在线环境交互，尤其在高成本或高风险场景中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ADWM，即 Autoregressive Diffusion World Model。方法学习 latent diffusion world model 来模拟环境对 agent 动作的响应；与一次性扩散整条 trajectory 的 OPE 不同，它按 transition 独立 denoise，并让 world model 与 LLM agent 在 rollout 中交替执行，以适配离散文本动作必须由 policy 观测后采样的约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 和数值提升。声称相较普通 autoregressive world model，ADWM 通过每步独立去噪降低 compounding error；相较 joint trajectory diffusion，更适配 LLM agent 的离散文本动作生成过程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses expensive and risky online evaluation of multi-turn LLM agents by estimating a new agent policy’s performance from pre-collected trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an off-policy evaluation method for agents. It is not a pretraining paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: agent policy iteration cannot always rely on live environment interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADWM learns a latent diffusion world model that simulates environment responses to agent actions. Unlike diffusion OPE methods that denoise full trajectories jointly, it denoises each transition independently and alternates between the world model and the LLM agent during rollout, which better matches discrete text actions sampled after observing the environment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete environments, model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims that per-transition denoising reduces compounding errors relative to standard autoregressive world models and handles LLM-agent text actions better than joint trajectory diffusion.

recommendation.zh: agent 离线评测方向值得知道，但摘要缺少实验锚点；先看 OPE setup，数值别急着信。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing for offline agent evaluation, but the abstract lacks experimental anchors; read the OPE setup before trusting the numbers.

paper.title: FontFusion: Enhancing Generative Text in Diffusion Models with Typographic Conditioning
paper.abstract: Typography generation in diffusion models faces a persistent trade-off: enabling precise font control typically degrades text legibility, while maintaining readability often sacrifices typographic fidelity. We present FontFusion, a plug-and-play conditioning framework for Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures that resolves this dilemma through three core innovations: (1) a hierarchical token representation establishing explicit text-font relationships at multiple granularities, (2) position-

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型中的字体生成面临精确字体控制与文本可读性之间的持久权衡。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出FontFusion，一个即插即用的DiT条件框架，通过三层创新解决字体控制与可读性的两难。
summary.technical_approach: 三个核心创新：(1)层次化token表示建立多粒度文本-字体关系；(2)位置感知嵌入建立排版与图像内容的空间绑定；(3)多级token丢弃策略提升计算效率和对未见字体的泛化能力。
summary.experiments: 系统评估显示双编码器(DeepFont+DINOv2)优于单编码器；在挑战性装饰字体上相对单编码器基线提升76%，字体一致性也有提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Typography generation in diffusion models faces a persistent trade-off: precise font control degrades text legibility, while readability sacrifices typographic fidelity.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: presents FontFusion, a plug-and-play conditioning framework for DiT architectures resolving the font-control vs readability dilemma through three core innovations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core innovations: (1) hierarchical token representation establishing explicit text-font relationships at multiple granularities; (2) position-aware embeddings creating spatial bindings between typography and image content; (3) multi-level token dropping strategy improving computational efficiency and generalization to unseen fonts.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation shows dual encoder (DeepFont+DINOv2) outperforms single encoders; 76% relative improvement on decorative fonts over single-encoder baselines, with font consistency gains.

recommendation.zh: CV字体生成方向，与LLM基座预训练无直接关联，仅作为多模态生成技术趋势备查。
recommendation.en: CV font generation direction, no direct relevance to LLM foundation pretraining; only worth noting as a multimodal generation technology trend reference.

paper.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
paper.abstract: Text-guided image editing has advanced rapidly with diffusion models and unified multimodal foundation models. However, most existing methods remain confined to single-turn settings, overlooking the more realistic scenario of multi-turn in-context editing, where users iteratively refine an image through a sequence of instructions. In this setting, a model must follow each new instruction while preserving accumulated session-level constraints, challenged by two coupled failure modes: long-context

summary.core_problem: 现有文本引导图像编辑方法多为单轮设计，无法解决多轮编辑场景下的长上下文约束稀释与前期错误累积污染问题
summary.importance: 多模态生成领域的增量方法创新，面向多轮图像编辑场景
summary.technical_approach: 提出Edit-R2强化学习后训练框架，每次编辑前重构会话意图，将分散的历史约束整合为显式推理轨迹，采用上下文感知的RL优化多轮编辑的一致性与指令遵循能力
summary.experiments: 论文摘要被截断，未完整披露实验设置、模型规模与量化效果，仅公开框架设计与问题分析
summary.authors_note: 作者包含商汤科技知名生成模型研究者Xintao Wang

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-guided image editing methods are mostly designed for single-turn settings, and cannot solve long-context constraint dilution and early error accumulation in multi-turn editing scenarios
summary_en.importance: Incremental methodological innovation in multimodal generation, targeting multi-turn image editing scenarios
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the Edit-R2 reinforcement learning post-training framework, which reconstructs session intent before each editing turn to consolidate scattered historical constraints into an explicit reasoning trace, and uses context-aware RL to optimize consistency and instruction following across turns
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no complete experimental setup, model scale or quantitative results are disclosed, only framework design and problem analysis are presented
summary_en.authors_note: Authored by Xintao Wang, a well-known generative model researcher from SenseTime

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成领域的增量工作，仅聚焦多轮图像编辑场景，对通用多模态基座预训练的直接启发有限，扫一眼摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental work in multimodal generation, only focuses on multi-turn image editing; limited direct insight for general multimodal foundation pretraining, just skim the abstract

paper.title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising. We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We ke

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作生成是否需要像图像生成那样进行多步迭代去噪？
summary.importance: 挑战了 VLA 模型中默认采用多步 Diffusion 的范式，证明了在动作生成这种低维目标任务中，简单的单步生成即可达到多步的效果。
summary.technical_approach: 指出 VLA 动作生成具有不同的条件-目标结构（条件丰富，目标低维）。无需复杂的单步生成方法（如蒸馏或辅助目标），仅保留标准的速度预测，并在训练时将时间步分布偏向高噪声状态。在 MNIST 网格到序列任务和机器人策略实验中验证。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 LIBERO-Pro 上，采用偏向高噪声调度训练的单步策略，其性能通常与相同 recipe 下的十步解码相当。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学邱锡鹏团队参与。

summary_en.core_problem: Does action generation in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models require multi-step iterative denoising like image generation?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the default multi-step diffusion paradigm in VLA models, demonstrating that simple one-step generation is sufficient for low-dimensional target tasks like action generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argues that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure (rich conditions, low-dimensional target). Avoids complex one-step methods (e.g., distillation or auxiliary objectives), keeping standard velocity prediction and biasing the training time distribution toward high-noise states. Validated on a MNIST grid-to-sequence task and robot policy experiments.
summary_en.experiments: Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: Involves Xipeng Qiu's team from Fudan University.

recommendation.zh: 对具身智能/VLA 动作生成范式的反思，指出低维动作预测不需要复杂的多步 diffusion，对做连续动作空间的 agent 有启发。
recommendation.en: A reflection on the action generation paradigm in embodied AI/VLA, pointing out that low-dimensional action prediction doesn't need complex multi-step diffusion. Insightful for agents with continuous action spaces.

paper.title: Are we really tilting? The mechanics of reward guidance in flow and diffusion models
paper.abstract: Reward guidance algorithms steer a learned generative process toward the reward-tilted measure at inference time. While empirically powerful, these methods are prone to reward hacking: the guided model over-optimizes the reward at the cost of fidelity to the learned distribution. Prior work has attributed this to the complexity of neural reward functions or implicit biases in diffusion training, but its fundamental origins remain poorly understood. We show that reward hacking arises from an appr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 reward-guided flow / diffusion 为什么没有真正采到 reward-tilted distribution，而是经常出现 reward hacking。核心结论是：问题不一定来自复杂 reward 模型或 diffusion 训练偏差，有限粒子的 Doob h-function plug-in 估计本身就会引入系统性偏差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在 LLM 训练 recipe，而在“用奖励信号改写生成分布”的机制理解。它把 reward guidance 中的 reward hacking 拆成可分析的统计误差问题，说明即使基础分布、reward、动力学都很简单，近似的 guidance 也会把样本推向错误区域。这对 diffusion LM、flow-based LM、RL-style generation、best-of-n sampling、test-time search 都有启发：奖励信号的使用方式可能比 reward 模型本身更早地产生偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 stochastic interpolants 和 Doob h-transform 出发。理想情况下，若已知 h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x]，就可以通过修改 drift，使终端分布精确变成 rho_1(x) exp(lambda r(x)) 归一化后的 reward tilt。实际方法通常无法计算这个条件期望，只能从 p(X_1 | X_t=x) 采 k 个粒子，用有限样本平均近似 h_t。论文分析的重点就是这个 plug-in estimator。作者在 Gaussian 和 Gaussian mixture 目标上做闭式分析，分离出两个失败模式：在单个 mode 内，有限粒子估计会导致过度集中和均值 overshoot；在多 mode 情况下，局部条件采样很难发现远处高 reward mode，因此 guidance 缺少正确重加权不同 mode 的机制。为缓解第一个问题，论文提出一个闭式的 damped reward schedule lambda_t，降低后期 guidance 的过强拉动；为处理 mode selection，论文解释 best-of-n 的作用不是修正 drift，而是通过多次采样增加命中高 reward mode 的机会。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gaussian mixture、二维 checkerboard 和 FLUX.1 文生图。Gaussian / Gaussian mixture 部分用于验证理论预测：普通 plug-in guidance 会在 mode 内过度优化 reward，并且不能可靠选择远距离高 reward mode；damped lambda_t 能减轻 within-mode reward hacking；best-of-n 更接近承担跨 mode 选择的角色。FLUX.1 实验用于展示这个机制在实际 text-to-image guidance 中也有可见影响：单纯增大 guidance scale 会提高 reward 指标但损伤 fidelity，而 damping 加 best-of-n 可以在 reward 和样本质量之间给出更稳的折中。提供的正文片段没有给出完整数值表，适合把实验作为机制验证而非最终性能比较来读。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 Background 中 Doob h-transform 和有限粒子 h-function 估计的定义，然后看 Gaussian 与 Gaussian mixture 的闭式推导。图 2 是理解整篇论文的入口：base target、analytic reward tilting、practical guidance、damping + best-of-n 的对比很清楚。实验部分优先看 Gaussian mixture 和 FLUX.1，关注 damping schedule 改的是什么、best-of-n 没有改什么。若关心 diffusion LM 或 RL-guided generation，可以深挖它对“奖励倾斜分布”和“实际采样分布”差距的刻画。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why reward-guided flow and diffusion models often fail to sample from the intended reward-tilted distribution and instead show reward hacking. Its main point is that the failure can arise from the finite-particle plug-in approximation of the Doob h-function, even in simple Gaussian settings.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model pretraining research is conceptual rather than recipe-level. It gives a clean mechanism for how reward signals distort a generative distribution when the guidance estimator is biased. This matters for diffusion language models, flow-based language models, RL-guided generation, best-of-n sampling, and test-time search: the approximation used to inject reward can introduce distributional errors before one even considers neural reward-model misspecification.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is built around stochastic interpolants and the Doob h-transform. If h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x] were available, modifying the drift by the corresponding h-transform would produce exact samples from the reward-tilted terminal law. Practical methods approximate h_t with k samples from the conditional endpoint distribution p(X_1 | X_t=x). The paper studies this plug-in estimator directly. In Gaussian targets, it derives how finite-particle estimation causes within-mode overconcentration and mean overshoot. In Gaussian mixtures, it shows that local conditional sampling has no reliable mechanism for reweighting distant high-reward modes. The proposed mitigation is a closed-form damped reward schedule lambda_t for reducing within-mode over-optimization, while best-of-n sampling is interpreted as a separate mechanism for mode selection rather than as a fix to the drift estimator.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section uses Gaussian mixtures, a 2D checkerboard distribution, and FLUX.1 text-to-image generation. The synthetic experiments validate the predicted failure modes: standard plug-in guidance over-optimizes reward within a mode and struggles to select far-away high-reward modes. The damped schedule reduces within-mode reward hacking, while best-of-n mainly improves the chance of finding a better mode. The FLUX.1 experiments show the same tradeoff in a realistic generator: increasing guidance can raise reward metrics while reducing fidelity, and damping plus best-of-n gives a more controlled tradeoff. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so the results are best read as mechanistic evidence rather than as a leaderboard-style comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the background on the Doob h-transform and the finite-particle h-function estimator. Then read the closed-form Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture analyses, since that is where the main contribution lies. Figure 2 is the fastest way to understand the contrast between analytic tilting, practical guidance, and the proposed damping plus best-of-n strategy. For readers working on diffusion LMs or reward-guided generation, the useful part is the gap between the ideal tilted law and the actual sampling law induced by estimator bias.

recommendation.zh: 核心结论清晰解释了奖励引导的reward hacking根源，阻尼策略可直接复现用于diffusion LM的推理引导消融实验
recommendation.en: Its core conclusions clearly explain the root of reward hacking in reward guidance; the damping schedule can be directly reproduced for diffusion LM inference guidance ablation experiments

paper.title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: 在 tree-based speculative decoding 里，如何在“覆盖更多候选（更高接受长度）”与“验证更贵（更慢）”之间做在线权衡：每一轮到底该用多大的 draft tree（node budget），以及节点该放在哪里，才能最大化真实吞吐（tokens/sec），而不是一个单调随预算增大的代理指标。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理侧，但对“训练—推理闭环”有两点直接启发：第一，把优化目标从 acceptance length 拉回到端到端吞吐，属于把系统代价显式写进目标函数的典型做法；第二，它给出了一个可操作的、无需额外训练的在线预算自适应机制，能减少 speculative decoding 在不同 prompt/不同阶段的手工调参。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：当推理侧能更稳定地榨干吞吐，训练侧做 recipe/架构改动时更容易把收益归因到模型本身，而不是 serving 配置。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把“树怎么长 + 树多大”统一成一个 throughput 最大化问题。
1) 现有 DDTree 类方法：用 block diffusion drafter 一次前向给出每个位置的 marginal q_i(v)，在 drafter 的因子化联合分布 Q 下计算每个节点（前缀）出现概率，从而得到期望接受长度的可加和代理目标 Φ(T)，然后在固定预算 n=|T| 下选节点。问题在于：Φ(T) 对预算是非减的，导致预算选择没有原则，离线选一个 n 只能靠网格搜索或经验。
2) CaDDTree：显式建模每轮耗时，把目标改为“单位时间期望提交 token 数”。一轮提交 1+α（含 bonus token），于是吞吐可写成 E[1+α] / (draft_cost(n)+verify_cost(n))（文中把 draft 与 verify 的代价函数化；对 block diffusion drafter，draft_cost 近似常数或弱依赖 n，而 verify_cost 随树节点数增长）。
3) 关键理论点：在一个温和的凸性条件下（验证代价随 n 的增长呈凸/边际成本递增），吞吐关于 n 呈单峰（unimodal）。这使得“预算搜索”从高维组合问题降为一维搜索：先按某个节点收益排序/贪心扩展树结构，同时用单峰性质做高效停止/回退，得到每轮的最优 n，并且能随上下文变化在线调整。
4) 实现层面：框架落在 block diffusion drafting（如 DFlash 这类一次出 L 个位置 logits 的 drafter）+ tree attention 验证上；不需要训练新模型，只改树构造与预算选择策略。
summary.experiments:
全文信息在给定内容里只出现了实验设置与结论性描述，缺少表格数字与具体超参：
- 模型：Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B（target），使用 block diffusion drafter（文中以 DFlash/同类为背景）。
- 任务：8 个 benchmark，覆盖 reasoning、coding、instruction-following。
- 结论：CaDDTree 在几乎所有任务上达到或超过“带 oracle 预算选择”的 DDTree；并且不需要离线预算搜索，能 per-round 自适应预算。
- 你在精读时需要重点核对：吞吐提升的绝对比例（tokens/sec 或 speedup）、不同任务/不同上下文长度下最优预算分布、以及 verify_cost 的拟合/测量方式是否稳定（是否受 batch size、tree attention 实现、KV cache 复用影响）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction：明确它反对“最大化接受长度”而主张“最大化吞吐”的动机，以及为什么预算选择是痛点。
- 重点看方法部分对 cost model 的定义：draft_cost/verify_cost 如何测量或近似，哪些项随 n 变化；这决定了单峰假设是否可信。
- 找到并细读“unimodality 条件与证明/推导”：这是把在线预算选择做成可实现算法的关键。
- 最后看实验里与 DDTree（含 oracle budget）对比的主表，以及预算自适应的可视化（如果有）：确认收益来自更好的 n 选择，而不是仅仅换了树形贪心。
- 如果你关心预训练侧启发：把它当作一个范式例子——把系统代价写进目标函数，并用可验证的结构性质（单峰/凸性）把搜索问题降维。

summary_en.core_problem: How to construct and size draft trees in tree-based speculative decoding so that the objective matches real throughput (expected committed tokens per unit time), including an online choice of the node budget per decoding round, instead of optimizing a surrogate (expected acceptance length) that is monotonic in budget and therefore cannot justify budget selection.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference paper, but it matters to foundation-model practitioners in two practical ways. (1) It is a clean example of making system cost part of the optimization target: acceptance-only objectives systematically push toward larger trees, while throughput exposes the true trade-off. (2) It provides an online, per-round budget adaptation mechanism without extra training, reducing the amount of offline tuning typically needed for speculative decoding. Indirectly, more stable inference speedups help pretraining researchers attribute gains to model/recipe changes rather than serving heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CaDDTree reframes draft-tree construction as throughput maximization.
- Setup: a block-diffusion drafter produces per-position marginals q_i in one forward pass (factorized joint Q), enabling tractable computation of node/prefix probabilities used by DDTree-style methods.
- Limitation of prior work: maximizing expected accepted length under Q (a surrogate for the target model) is non-decreasing in the node budget n=|T|, so it cannot determine the right budget; existing adaptive-shape methods still fix n offline.
- Key change: define a per-round throughput objective, roughly E[1+α(T)] / (draft_cost(n)+verify_cost(n)), where α is the number of accepted tokens and costs are explicit functions of tree size.
- Main theoretical lever: under a mild convexity assumption on verification cost (increasing marginal cost with n), throughput as a function of n becomes unimodal. This reduces budget selection to an efficient 1D search/greedy procedure that jointly grows the tree and decides when to stop, enabling per-round budget adaptation.
- Instantiation: the framework is implemented on top of block diffusion drafting plus tree-attention verification; no additional model training is required.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, only high-level experimental descriptors are available (tables/numbers are not included):
- Targets: Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B.
- Evaluation: 8 benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction following.
- Reported outcome: CaDDTree matches or exceeds DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks, while avoiding offline budget tuning.
For a careful read, the critical missing details to verify in the paper are: absolute throughput gains (tokens/s or speedup), sensitivity to context length and batch size, how verify_cost is measured/fitted for tree attention, and whether improvements come mainly from better budget choice or from different node selection.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction to internalize the misalignment argument (acceptance length vs throughput) and why budget selection is the core gap.
- Focus on the cost model section: what exactly scales with n in verification, and what is assumed constant for block diffusion drafting.
- Read the unimodality condition and its derivation/proof; this is the technical hinge that makes online budget adaptation feasible.
- Check the main comparison against DDTree (including the oracle-budget variant) and any plots showing per-round chosen budgets.
- If you care about pretraining-adjacent lessons: treat it as a template for “objective alignment with real cost” plus “structure (convexity/unimodality) to make search tractable.”

recommendation.zh: 将扩散机制引入推测解码的草稿树构建，并显式建模 cost，对关注推理加速和 Speculative Decoding 优化的工程师有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Introduces diffusion mechanisms into draft tree construction for speculative decoding and explicitly models cost; valuable for engineers focused on inference acceleration and Speculative Decoding optimization.

paper.title: Initialization is Half the Battle: Generating Diverse Images from a Guidance Potential Posterior
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable fidelity of generative models, they frequently suffer from mode collapse. Existing strategies for enhancing diversity predominantly focus on intervening during the generation trajectory. We identify a critical oversight that the standard Gaussian initialization often causes trajectories to collapse into dominant modes because it is agnostic to the guidance potential landscape. In this work, we formulate selecting the initial noise from a guidance potential posterior, which

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型和 flow matching 模型在采样时容易落入主导模式、生成多样性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型推理阶段的多样性控制方法：把初始化噪声视为可优化对象，而不是只在去噪轨迹中调 guidance；对文本 LLM 预训练无直接作用，但对多模态生成的采样机制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diversity-inducing Initialization，核心假设是标准 Gaussian 初始化与 guidance potential landscape 无关，会把轨迹送入高概率但低多样性的吸引域。方法将初始噪声采样表述为 guidance potential posterior，并用 Langevin dynamics 在初始化空间中移动噪声，使其远离 collapse 区域，同时通过先验约束保持在有效数据流形附近。方法是 inference-time 插件，可用于 diffusion 和 flow matching。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在扩散模型和 flow matching 模型上做了广泛实验，显示多样性提升，同时保持生成质量；未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles mode collapse and insufficient sample diversity in diffusion and flow-matching generative models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time diversity mechanism that treats initialization as a controllable variable, rather than only intervening along the denoising trajectory. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to sampling behavior in multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Diversity-inducing Initialization, argues that standard Gaussian initialization is blind to the guidance potential landscape and can route trajectories into dominant modes. It formulates initial noise selection as sampling from a guidance-potential posterior and uses Langevin dynamics to move initial noise away from collapsing regions while keeping it anchored to the valid data manifold. It is designed as a plug-in inference-time method for both diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments across diffusion and flow-matching models, with improved diversity while preserving fidelity. It does not provide concrete model scale, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 想做生成采样的人看方法定义即可；对 LLM pretrain 不改 prior，但“初始化分布也会决定 mode coverage”这个点值得记住。
recommendation.en: Read the method definition if you work on generative sampling; it does not change LLM-pretraining priors, but the initialization-versus-mode-coverage point is worth noting.

paper.title: Unlearning in Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework with KL Divergence and Likelihood Constraints
paper.abstract: Unlearning in diffusion models aims to remove undesirable data or concepts while preserving the utility of pretrained models -- two fundamentally conflicting objectives. We propose a principled constrained optimization framework that formulates unlearning as minimizing the deviation from a pretrained model, subject to explicit separation constraints from the unlearning distributions. Specifically, we formulate three constrained optimization problems based on reverse and forward KL divergences, a

summary.core_problem: 为扩散模型中的数据或概念遗忘建立统一的约束优化表述，在删除目标分布的同时尽量保持预训练模型能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型 unlearning 的理论框架和算法。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对扩散生成模型的安全、版权、数据删除和保留-遗忘权衡有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把 unlearning 写成约束优化：目标是最小化与原预训练模型的偏离，同时加入与待遗忘分布分离的显式约束。论文给出三类问题：基于 reverse KL、forward KL，以及 likelihood constraint 的形式；其中前两者统一已有 concept/data unlearning 方法，第三种是新的自然表述。虽然 KL 约束非凸，作者声称三类问题都满足强对偶，并据此刻画最优 unlearning target，设计 primal-dual 算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明 KL-constrained 方法优于已有方法，但未提供扩散模型类型、数据集、baseline 名称、评价指标和数值提升。需要读正文确认实验是否是概念移除、样本遗忘，还是二者都有。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formulates unlearning in diffusion models as a unified constrained optimization problem that removes target data or concepts while preserving the pretrained model's utility.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical and algorithmic framework for generative-model unlearning. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to safety, copyright, data deletion, and the retention-forgetting trade-off in diffusion-based generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Unlearning is posed as minimizing deviation from the pretrained model subject to explicit separation constraints from the unlearning distribution. The paper studies three formulations based on reverse KL, forward KL, and likelihood constraints. The first two generalize existing concept and data unlearning methods, while the likelihood-constrained version is presented as a new formulation. Despite nonconvex KL constraints, the authors claim strong duality for all three problems and derive primal-dual algorithms from the characterized optimal targets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the KL-constrained approach outperforms existing methods, but does not specify the diffusion model, datasets, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The full paper is needed to determine whether the experiments cover concept unlearning, data unlearning, or both.

recommendation.zh: 理论表述比实验更值得看；若关心生成模型安全，读优化形式和 dual target，LLM 预训练方向不必深读。
recommendation.en: The optimization formulation is more useful than the experiments; read the dual targets if you track generative-model safety, not as LLM pretraining material.

paper.title: Diffusion Models Preferentially Memorize Prototypical Examples or: Why Does My Diffusion Model Love Slop?
paper.abstract: Generative models have a persistent limitation: their tendency to memorize training data can create legal liabilities and erode creative diversity. Understanding which samples are memorized in whole or in part, and under what conditions, therefore remains an important open problem. Here we answer the question "Are atypical or rare samples memorized first?" in the negative. We train diffusion models on strings generated according to the production rules of the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fi

summary.core_problem: 生成模型的记忆化是一个持久问题——模型倾向于记住训练数据，带来法律风险并降低创造性多样性。核心问题是：哪些样本会被优先记忆？现有文献中存在竞争假设：一种观点认为非典型/稀有样本会被优先记住（因为它们主导剩余训练损失），另一种观点认为常见特征的样本更容易被记住。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于数据记忆机制的理解：研究发现与直觉相反，由常见子串组成的典型样本被优先记忆。这意味着仅在数据点级别去重并不能提供有效的隐私保证，因为即使是唯一的样本如果包含常见子特征也会被优先记忆。这对预训练数据处理（去重策略）和隐私保护有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Random Hierarchy Model (RHM) 生成的显式层级组合式合成字符串数据训练扩散模型。RHM 的扩展版本将数据生成规则与幂律概率分布耦合，可以通过控制幂律进入的抽象层次来精细地控制样本的典型性。这使得研究者能够区分泛化、部分记忆和完全记忆，并系统地研究样本稀有度与记忆顺序之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 在 RHM 生成的合成字符串数据上训练扩散模型。关键发现：由常见子串组成的样本被优先记忆。即使在训练数据完全唯一（无重复样本）的情况下，这一结论仍然成立——说明样本级别的去重不能提供有意义的隐私保证。进一步的分析预测并证实了在扩散模型中典型样本的记忆优先性（与经典分类模型中非典型样本主导损失的情况不同）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中对三种竞争假设的梳理（图 1 第一行）和实验部分（核心发现段落）。建议关注实验设计中如何利用 RHM 控制样本典型性以及完全唯一数据的实验。预计阅读时间：25-35 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 论文未提供作者信息，从 arXiv ID 2605.30642 查询为近期提交。

summary_en.core_problem: Memorization in generative models is a persistent limitation—models tend to reproduce training data, creating legal liabilities and reducing creative diversity. The core question is: which samples get memorized first? Competing hypotheses exist in the literature: one view claims atypical/rare samples are memorized first (because they dominate remaining training loss), another argues samples with common features are easier to memorize.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research lies in understanding data memorization mechanisms: the study finds, counterintuitively, that prototypical samples composed of common substrings are preferentially memorized. This implies deduplication at the data point level alone does not provide meaningful privacy guarantees—even unique samples can be preferentially memorized if they contain common sub-features. This has direct implications for pretraining data processing (deduplication strategies) and privacy protection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains diffusion models on explicitly hierarchical, compositional synthetic string data generated by the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM). An extended version of RHM couples data generation rules to a power-law probability distribution, allowing fine control over sample typicality by manipulating the abstraction level at which the power-law enters. This setup enables distinguishing generalization, partial memorization, and full memorization, and systematically studying the relationship between sample rarity and memorization order.
summary_en.experiments: Diffusion models trained on RHM-generated synthetic string data. Key finding: samples composed of common substrings are preferentially memorized. This holds even when training data consists of entirely unique samples (no duplicates)—demonstrating that sample-level deduplication does not provide meaningful privacy guarantees. Further analysis predicts and confirms the preferential memorization of prototypical examples in diffusion models (contrasting with the behavior in classification models where atypical samples dominate loss).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the introduction's mapping of three competing hypotheses (Figure 1, first row) and the experimental section where core findings are presented. Pay attention to how RHM controls sample typicality and the experiments on entirely unique data. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not provided in the available content; arXiv ID 2605.30642 is a recent submission.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim：结论把记忆风险从样本重复移到子结构频率，读实验设计和长尾对记忆时序的分析即可。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming: it moves the memorization prior from duplicate examples to frequent substructures; focus on the setup and the fat-tail timing analysis.

paper.title: Spectral Guidance for Flexible and Efficient Control of Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We introduce Spectral Guidance, a framework for controlling diffusion models by leveraging the intrinsic geometry of the generative process. As data is progressively corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control. We characterize them as the singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and show that they can be learned via a self-supervised objective. Once recovered, this basis enables the projection of arbitrary guidance signals, such as labels, C

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion model 在不重训、不对 denoiser 做反向传播的条件下，如何稳定、灵活地接受 label、CLIP embedding、mask 等控制信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型控制方法。它从 diffusion 采样过程的内在几何出发，提出一种训练后可复用的 guidance 表示，目标是在控制精度、采样速度和图像质量之间取得更好的折中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Spectral Guidance。核心假设是数据逐步加噪后，只有少量特征仍对控制有信息量；这些特征可表示为 conditional expectation operator 的 singular functions。作者用 self-supervised objective 学习这组 basis，再把任意 guidance signal 投影到采样轨迹上，从而支持 label、CLIP 和 mask-based spatial control。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10 上，相比最强 training-free baseline，conditional accuracy 提升 37 个百分点，并报告约 4 倍采样加速。摘要还称同一组表示可支持 label guidance、CLIP guidance 和 mask guidance，无需额外辅助模型或 sampling-time denoiser backpropagation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to control diffusion models with labels, CLIP embeddings, or masks without retraining the denoiser or backpropagating through it at sampling time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative-model control method. It uses the intrinsic geometry of the diffusion process to derive reusable guidance representations, aiming for a better trade-off between controllability, fidelity, and sampling cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Spectral Guidance assumes that as data is corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control. These features are characterized as singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and learned with a self-supervised objective. Arbitrary guidance signals are then projected onto the sampling trajectory.
