summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-10, the method improves conditional accuracy by 37 percentage points over the strongest training-free baseline and reports 4× faster sampling. The same learned representations are claimed to support label guidance, CLIP guidance, and mask-based spatial control without auxiliary models.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练距离较远；若关心 unified diffusion control，看 operator/basis 形式即可。
recommendation.en: Far from LLM pretraining; if you care about unified diffusion control, skim the operator-and-basis formulation only.

paper.title: Parallel Tempering Initial Sampling in Inference-Time Reward Alignment
paper.abstract: Inference-time reward alignment steers pretrained diffusion and flow-based generative models to satisfy user-specified rewards without retraining. Recently, Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has emerged as a powerful framework for this task by iteratively filtering and propagating multiple particles. However, we show that standard SMC-based methods often suffer from poor performance because they initialize particles from a standard prior, whereas high-reward regions in complex reward landscapes are e

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion 和 flow 生成模型在 inference-time reward alignment 中，SMC 粒子初始化难以覆盖稀有高奖励区域的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型推理期对齐的采样方法创新。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对 test-time optimization、reward-guided sampling、多模态生成对齐有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: PATHS 将 parallel tempering 引入 SMC 初始化。方法维护一组 reward-tempered chains，形成不同奖励温度的链梯度，并周期性执行 Metropolis swaps，使粒子能在低温高奖励搜索和高温全局探索之间交换状态，从而降低陷入局部模态的概率。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明标准 SMC 因从标准 prior 初始化而表现不佳，已有 reward-aware 初始化也容易被多模态奖励景观困住；PATHS 在复杂奖励采样中改善初始化质量。给定信息未提供具体生成模型、奖励函数、数据集、样本数和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses poor particle initialization in inference-time reward alignment for diffusion and flow-based generative models, where high-reward regions are rare.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling method for inference-time alignment of generative models. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time optimization, reward-guided sampling, and multimodal generation alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: PATHS introduces parallel tempering into SMC initialization. It maintains a ladder of reward-tempered chains and periodically performs Metropolis swaps, allowing particles to move between high-temperature global exploration and low-temperature high-reward refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that standard SMC suffers from prior-based initialization and that recent reward-aware initializers can get trapped in local modes under multimodal reward landscapes. The provided metadata does not include model names, reward functions, datasets, particle counts, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 reward-guided sampling 的弱信号；只看初始化失败案例和 tempering 设计，别外推到文本 RL。
recommendation.en: A useful weak signal for reward-guided sampling; read the initialization failure cases and tempering design, but do not over-map it to text RL.

paper.title: Destruction is a General Strategy to Learn Generation; Diffusion's Strength is to Take it Seriously; Exploration is the Future
paper.abstract: I present diffusion models as part of a family of machine learning techniques that withhold information from a model's input and train it to guess the withheld information. I argue that diffusion's destroying approach to withholding is more flexible than typical hand-crafted information withholding techniques, providing a rich training playground that could be advantageous in some settings, notably data-scarce ones. I then address subtle issues that may arise when porting reinforcement learning

summary.core_problem: 现有对扩散模型的理解多局限于噪声注入的具体实现，未从信息论的通用视角建立其与其他生成式建模范式的统一框架，也未明确扩散范式在数据稀缺场景的优势来源和未解决的探索问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM预训练范式对比提供了新的信息论视角：将扩散、自回归、掩码语言建模统一归为“隐藏信息+预测被隐藏内容”的家族，明确了扩散范式的差异化优势来自结构化、可调节的破坏过程，而非单纯的噪声注入，为低数据场景下的生成式建模、扩散-强化学习融合方向提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach: 重新定义生成式扩散模型：不限制破坏过程为噪声注入，而是任意可逐步销毁样本信息的预设过程；将扩散模型与监督学习、自回归LM、BERT、去噪自编码器等范式归为同一类“信息隐藏-预测”技术；从训练目标密度、数据增强、任意顺序建模三个角度解释扩散在低数据场景的性能优势；提出将强化学习的探索技术迁移到扩散范式时存在的适配问题，以及扩散原生探索方法的可能研究方向。此外还引入了生成交换图这一新型概率图模型，用于直观解释扩散过程的概率关系。
summary.experiments: 本文为观点类博客论文，无原创实验，主要引用已有的扩散语言模型与自回归模型的对比结果：低数据场景下扩散语言模型可通过训练更多epoch持续超过自回归模型，该交叉点随数据质量/数量提升后移，随模型规模增大前移。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章的观点部分，第1.1节的统一框架和第1.2节的低数据优势分析是核心内容；第2章的教程适合非扩散领域研究者快速建立认知，扩散领域研究者可快速浏览其中的生成交换图部分；预计阅读时间30分钟，纯预训练研究者可跳过教程后半部分的数学推导。
summary.authors_note: ServiceNow AI Research, Pierre-André Noël

summary_en.core_problem: Existing understandings of diffusion models are mostly limited to the specific implementation of noise injection, failing to establish a unified framework with other generative modeling paradigms from a general information-theoretic perspective, nor clarifying the source of diffusion paradigm's advantages in data-scarce scenarios and unsolved exploration problems.
summary_en.importance: It provides a new information-theoretic perspective for comparing LLM pre-training paradigms: unifying diffusion, autoregressive, and masked language modeling into the family of 'withholding information + predicting withheld content', and clarifies that the differentiated advantage of the diffusion paradigm comes from a structured, adjustable destruction process rather than simple noise injection, providing inspiration for generative modeling in low-data scenarios and the fusion direction of diffusion and reinforcement learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generative diffusion models are redefined: the destruction process is not limited to noise injection, but any preset process that can gradually destroy the information of samples; diffusion models are classified into the same 'information withholding-prediction' technology category as supervised learning, autoregressive LM, BERT, denoising autoencoders, etc.; the performance advantages of diffusion in low-data scenarios are explained from three perspectives: training target density, data augmentation, and any-order modeling; adaptation problems when migrating reinforcement learning exploration techniques to the diffusion paradigm are proposed, as well as possible research directions for diffusion-native exploration methods. In addition, a new type of probabilistic graphical model called generative commutative diagram is introduced to intuitively explain the probabilistic relationships of the diffusion process.
summary_en.experiments: This paper is an opinion blog post with no original experiments. It mainly cites existing comparison results between diffusion language models and autoregressive models: diffusion language models can consistently outperform autoregressive models by training for more epochs in low-data scenarios. This crossover point shifts later with improved data quality/quantity and earlier with larger model size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the opinion part of Chapter 1. The unified framework in Section 1.1 and the low-data advantage analysis in Section 1.2 are the core content. The tutorial in Chapter 2 is suitable for non-diffusion researchers to quickly establish cognition, and diffusion researchers can quickly browse the generative commutative diagram part. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes. Pure pre-training researchers can skip the mathematical derivation in the latter half of the tutorial.
summary_en.authors_note: ServiceNow AI Research, Pierre-André Noël

recommendation.zh: 一篇 conceptual 的文章，将 Diffusion 视为比 Masking 更 general 的信息隐藏/重建机制，对思考 next-token 之外的预训练范式（如 Diffusion LM）有启发。
recommendation.en: A conceptual paper viewing Diffusion as a more general information withholding/reconstruction mechanism than Masking, inspiring for thinking about pretraining paradigms beyond next-token (e.g., Diffusion LM).

paper.title: Diffusion Models Are Statistically Optimal for Learning Low-Dimensional Multi-Modal Distributions
paper.abstract: Score-based diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in learning high-dimensional distributions, particularly those exhibiting low-dimensional and multi-modal structures. However, theoretical understanding of their statistical efficiency remains limited. Existing theories typically rely on strong regularity assumptions, such as uniformly bounded densities or globally smooth score functions, which fail to capture such intrinsic structures. In this work, we study the sample

summary.core_problem: 从理论上证明扩散模型在学习具有低维多模态结构的高维分布时，其样本复杂度是统计最优的。
summary.importance: 打破了现有理论对强正则化假设（如有界密度或全局平滑得分函数）的依赖，为扩散模型在低维流形数据上的高效性提供了坚实的理论基础。
summary.technical_approach: 假设数据分布支持在低维子空间的并集上，且每个子空间内的数据分布是亚高斯的。通过分析 1-Wasserstein 距离下的误差，推导出样本复杂度的上界。
summary.experiments: 纯理论推导，证明了达到 $\varepsilon$ 误差所需的样本数最多为 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-k \vee 2})$，其中 $k$ 是内在维度，该收敛率仅依赖于内在维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Theoretically proving that diffusion models are statistically optimal for learning high-dimensional distributions with low-dimensional, multi-modal structures.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the reliance of existing theories on strong regularity assumptions (e.g., bounded densities or globally smooth score functions), providing a solid theoretical foundation for the efficiency of diffusion models on low-dimensional manifold data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Assumes the data distribution is supported on a union of low-dimensional subspaces, with subgaussian distributions within each subspace. Derives an upper bound on sample complexity by analyzing the error in 1-Wasserstein distance.
summary_en.experiments: Purely theoretical derivation, proving that the number of samples required to achieve $\varepsilon$ error is at most $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-k \vee 2})$, where $k$ is the intrinsic dimension. This convergence rate depends only on the intrinsic dimension.

recommendation.zh: 纯理论工作，证明了 Diffusion Model 在低维流形上的样本复杂度仅依赖于内在维度，对理解 Diffusion 范式的有效性有理论价值，但不涉及具体训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Purely theoretical work proving that the sample complexity of Diffusion Models on low-dimensional manifolds depends only on the intrinsic dimension; theoretically valuable for understanding the efficacy of the diffusion paradigm, but does not involve specific training recipes.

paper.title: Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning
paper.abstract: We propose Kan Extension Transformers (KETs) as a unifying categorical framework for a diverse group of Transformer implementations. The core claim is that a Transformer layer can be viewed as a weighted structured extension operator: standard attention is the singleton-neighborhood case, Geometric Transformer style incidence mixing is a sparse edge-restricted case, and KET is the higher-order simplicial case. This lens also clarifies a bridge to diffusion-style completion. When the extension op

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图用 Kan extension 的范畴论语言统一几类 Transformer 变体：标准 attention、基于几何邻域的 incidence mixing、以及更高阶的 simplicial aggregation。它还处理一个语言建模中的实际问题：如果模型使用非因果邻域，直接聚合 teacher-forced hidden states 会泄露未来 token；predict-detach 通过聚合由因果前缀预测出来并停止梯度的 carrier，试图在不泄露 gold future tokens 的情况下利用更丰富的非因果结构。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 architecture / modeling paradigm，而不是常规预训练 recipe。对 LLM 基座研究的实用启发主要在 predict-detach：它给了一种把非因果结构引入自回归训练的边界条件，即聚合对象不能是含有真实未来信息的 hidden state，而应是由因果状态产生的预测代理。这个想法和 masked LM、any-order LM、diffusion-style completion 以及 self-conditioning 有连接。相比之下，Kan extension 的范畴论统一框架更偏表述层，是否能带来可扩展的大模型收益，还需要更大规模实验支持。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 Transformer 更新写成一个 weighted structured extension operator。标准 self-attention 是 token-level singleton neighborhood 的特例；TopoCoend 类方法是在 latent space 中学习几何邻域，再按邻接关系做聚合；KET 把 source objects 从 token 扩展到 simplicial objects，例如 token、edge、face 或更高阶 motif，并用相应权重把这些对象的信息扩展到目标 token。核心公式是对邻域系统中的 source objects 做加权聚合，区别只在于邻域对象和权重来源。另一个关键设计是 predict-detach self-conditioning：先由 causal prefix state 产生预测 carrier，并 detach；随后即使用非因果或更高阶邻域聚合，也不会直接接触 teacher-forced future hidden states。这和普通非因果 hidden-state mixing 的区别在于信息边界更干净。
summary.experiments: 论文声称比较了 12 种 Transformer 实现，覆盖 PTB、WikiText-2 和 WikiText-103 三个语言建模数据集。给出的主要结论是：strict-causal quadratic KET 在两个较大语料上有竞争力并表现最好；但实验中更主要的效果来自 predict-detach regime，而不是 simplicial KET 结构本身。已给出的内容没有包含 perplexity、参数量、训练预算、上下文长度和完整消融表，因此目前只能确认实验设计方向和作者给出的定性结论，不能独立判断收益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–40 分钟。优先读 Neighborhood Systems and Kan-Style Aggregation，特别是 Figure 1 和 Eq. (1)–(3)，确认 attention、TopoCoend、KET 在计算图上到底差在哪里。然后看 predict-detach 的信息流分析，重点判断它是否真的阻断了 teacher-forced future leakage。实验部分只需先看 12 个模型的主表、predict-detach 消融和 strict-causal quadratic KET 的结果。范畴论附录适合在需要理解作者形式化语言时再读，不是判断方法有效性的优先部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a categorical view of Transformer layers as weighted extension operators. Under this view, standard attention, geometric incidence mixing, and higher-order simplicial aggregation become instances of the same template. A more practical problem is also addressed: noncausal neighborhoods can leak future gold-token information when they aggregate teacher-forced hidden states. The proposed predict-detach regime aims to use richer noncausal structure while keeping the training signal causally valid.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant as an architecture and modeling-paradigm paper, not as a pretraining recipe. The most useful idea for language-model research is the causal boundary introduced by predict-detach: noncausal aggregation is safer when the transported values are detached predictive carriers produced from causal prefix states, rather than hidden states that already encode future tokens. This connects to self-conditioning, masked or any-order language modeling, and diffusion-style completion. The categorical formulation may be a clean unifying language, but its large-scale value is not established by the provided evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The common computational form is a weighted aggregation over a neighborhood system. Standard self-attention aggregates over token objects. TopoCoend keeps token-level objects but learns geometric neighborhoods in a latent space. KET changes the source objects themselves by adding simplices such as edges, faces, and higher-order motifs, then aggregates from those objects into target token positions. The framework can instantiate global or quadratic variants where tokens aggregate over a broad set of simplices. The second key component is predict-detach self-conditioning: predictive carriers are computed from causal prefix states and detached before being used as transported values. This preserves a cleaner information boundary than mixing teacher-forced future hidden states.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments over 12 Transformer implementations on Penn Treebank, WikiText-2, and WikiText-103. The stated empirical conclusion is that strict-causal quadratic KET is competitive and strongest on the two larger corpora, while the dominant improvement comes from the predict-detach regime itself. The supplied text does not include exact perplexities, parameter counts, training budgets, context lengths, or full ablation tables. Those details are needed before drawing a strong conclusion about scaling behavior or compute-normalized gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–40 minute skim should focus on the computational definitions rather than the categorical exposition. Read the neighborhood-system section, Figure 1, and equations (1)–(3) to understand how attention, TopoCoend, and KET differ operationally. Then inspect the predict-detach information-regime analysis to check how future-token leakage is avoided. In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, the predict-detach ablations, and the strict-causal quadratic KET results. The category-theory appendix can be deferred unless the formal unification itself is the main interest.

recommendation.zh: 用范畴论统一 Attention 和 Diffusion 的视角很新颖，特别是 predict-detach 自条件机制对非自回归/扩散语言建模有启发，值得看其数学构造。
recommendation.en: The categorical unification of Attention and Diffusion is novel; the predict-detach self-conditioning mechanism is particularly inspiring for non-autoregressive/diffusion LM design.

paper.title: Sampling Data with Chains of Forward-Backward Diffusion Steps
paper.abstract: Sampling from learned high-dimensional distributions is a foundational computational problem. We introduce U-turn chains: Markov chains obtained by iterating short forward-backward steps of a diffusion model, in which each step proposes a move that remains on the learned data manifold and, paired with a Metropolis-Hastings correction, samples from energy-modified targets. For synthetic languages, we show that minimal U-turn dynamics undergoes an ergodicity-breaking phase transition driven by fra

summary.core_problem: 从学习到的高维分布中采样的基础问题——现有扩散模型采样方法在数据流形上的遍历性和特征松弛顺序问题
summary.importance: 提出U-turn链（U-turn chains）采样方法，在合成语言和自然语言/图像上分析了遍历性破缺相变和特征松弛顺序，对理解扩散采样的基础机制有贡献
summary.technical_approach: 引入U-turn链：通过迭代扩散模型的短前向-后向步骤构建马尔可夫链，每次步骤提出保持在学习数据流形上的移动，并结合Metropolis-Hastings校正。发现最小U-turn动力学存在遍历性破缺相变，低层级特征比高层级特征松弛更快，仅在足够大的U-turn幅度时顺序反转
summary.experiments: 在合成语言、自然语言（LLM深度表示近似高层特征）和自然图像（CNN深度表示）上进行实验，验证了遍历性破缺和松弛顺序反转现象
summary.authors_note: Matthieu Wyart为瑞士联邦理工学院（EPFL）知名理论ML研究者，研究方向为深度学习理论和统计力学

summary_en.core_problem: Foundational problem of sampling from learned high-dimensional distributions — ergodicity and feature relaxation ordering issues in existing diffusion model sampling on the data manifold
summary_en.importance: Proposes U-turn chains sampling method, analyzing ergodicity-breaking phase transitions and feature relaxation ordering in synthetic language, natural language, and images — contributes to understanding fundamental mechanisms of diffusion sampling
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces U-turn chains: Markov chains built by iterating short forward-backward diffusion steps, proposing moves that stay on the learned data manifold with Metropolis-Hastings correction. Discovers that minimal U-turn dynamics undergoes ergodicity-breaking phase transition; low-level features relax faster than high-level ones, with ordering inversion only at sufficiently large U-turn magnitude
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on synthetic languages, natural language (high-level features approximated by deep LLM representations), and natural images (CNN deep representations), verifying ergodicity breaking and relaxation ordering inversion
summary_en.authors_note: Matthieu Wyart is a prominent theoretical ML researcher at EPFL, working on deep learning theory and statistical mechanics

recommendation.zh: 扩散采样的理论工作，遍历性破缺和特征松弛顺序的发现对扩散LM采样策略设计有一定参考，但实验主要在合成数据上，实际LLM应用价值有限，看摘要和Fig 2即可
recommendation.en: Theoretical work on diffusion sampling; ergodicity breaking and feature relaxation ordering findings have some reference for diffusion LM sampling strategy design, but experiments are mostly on synthetic data with limited practical LLM application value — read abstract and Fig 2 only

paper.title: Beyond Pairwise Preferences: Listwise Reward-Aware Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as an efficient alternative to online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning text-to-image diffusion models. However, existing methods largely reduce supervision to binary pairwise comparisons. This pairwise reduction is limiting when training data naturally contains multiple candidate images for the same prompt, and when continuous reward scores can provide richer information than a single winner-loser label. To address these limitatio

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型偏好优化方法局限于二元成对比较，无法利用多候选图像的连续奖励分数提供的丰富信息。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出列表级奖励感知的扩散模型对齐范式，超越二元偏好框架。对文本RLHF从二元转向列表级有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR将同一prompt下多候选图像的奖励分数转换为中心化优势权重，优化优势加权的隐式奖励回归目标，并通过二次惩罚正则化隐式奖励的幅度。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上验证，相比二元偏好方法在多个维度（美学、人类偏好匹配）上取得更好的对齐效果。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学，Stefano Ermon（生成模型领域知名学者，diffusion alignment方向核心研究者）、Yisong Yue（ML知名学者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion model preference optimization is limited to binary pairwise comparisons, wasting richer information from continuous reward scores across multiple candidate images per prompt.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes listwise reward-aware alignment paradigm for diffusion models, analogous to moving beyond binary preferences in text RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR converts reward scores across multiple candidates into centered advantage weights, optimizing an advantage-weighted regression objective on implicit reward with quadratic penalty regularization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-image generation, outperforming binary preference methods across multiple dimensions including aesthetics and human preference alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University; Stefano Ermon (leading researcher in generative models and diffusion alignment), Yisong Yue (prominent ML researcher)

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型的列表级偏好对齐，核心insight（二元→列表级）对RLHF方法论有一定类比启发，但实验仅在文生图上验证，对LLM pretrain研究者看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Listwise preference alignment for diffusion models; the binary→listwise insight has some analogical relevance to RLHF methodology, but experiments are purely text-to-image — read only the abstract.

paper.title: Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models via Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo
paper.abstract: We study inference-time alignment for diffusion-based generative models, aiming to steer a base model toward high-reward outputs without updating its weights. Recent Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC)-based steering methods approximate reward-tilted target distributions in a principled way, but their proposals remain largely tied to the base sampler. Since reward information is mainly used after propagation through particle reweighting and resampling, these methods can require large particle budgets a

summary.core_problem: 在不更新扩散模型权重的前提下，如何用奖励信号在推理时把采样分布导向高奖励输出，同时避免 SMC 粒子退化和高方差估计。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时对齐方法。它把 reward-tilted distribution、Sequential Monte Carlo 和 learnable twisting 结合起来，试图给扩散模型提供比简单重加权更有前瞻性的采样引导。对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对“固定基座模型 + 推理时奖励控制”的建模接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo。核心思路是迭代学习 twisting function，让粒子传播时提前感知终端奖励，而不是等采样后再重加权；同时用 trust-region 约束稳定更新，缓解高维扩散状态、噪声奖励和黑盒奖励下 twisting 学习不稳定的问题。
summary.experiments: 给出的摘要片段没有报告具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的实验目标应是比较普通 SMC steering、基于 base sampler 的 proposal，以及带 trust-region twisting 的粒子效率、权重退化和奖励提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to align diffusion samplers at inference time toward high-reward samples without updating model weights, while avoiding particle degeneracy and high-variance SMC estimates.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time alignment contribution. It combines reward-tilted target distributions, Sequential Monte Carlo, and learnable twisting functions. It is not a direct LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the broader interface between frozen generative models and reward-guided test-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo. It learns look-ahead twisting functions iteratively so that reward information can affect proposals before final reweighting, and it constrains updates with a trust region to improve stability under high-dimensional diffusion states, noisy terminal rewards, and black-box rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract fragment does not include concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to compare standard SMC steering, base-sampler-tied proposals, and trust-region twisted proposals in terms of particle efficiency, weight degeneracy, and achieved reward.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；只需看方法里的 trust-region twisting，作为推理时 reward steering 的数学备选。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the trust-region twisting setup only as a mathematical option for inference-time reward steering.

paper.title: Concept Unlearning via Cross-Attention Activation Projection for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Concept unlearning aims to erase a target concept from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without retraining. Closed-form methods are attractive in this setting because they apply a single deterministic edit to the cross-attention weights and add no inference-time cost. Existing closed-form methods, however, represent the target concept through the text encoder's response to a few short anchor prompts that name it, and paraphrased prompts that evoke the concept without naming it consiste

summary.core_problem: 在不重新训练、且不增加推理成本的条件下，从预训练文本到图像扩散模型中删除目标概念，并提升对改写提示词的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型安全与模型编辑方法。它对 LLM 预训练不是主线，但“在激活空间定义要遗忘的概念”这个判断对语言模型 unlearning、表示编辑和安全后处理有一定旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PURE，即 Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure。区别于只用少量显式 anchor prompt 的文本编码器响应来表示目标概念，PURE 从每层 cross-attention activation 中构建 forget basis 和 retain basis，再对 U-Net 的 cross-attention 权重做一次闭式投影编辑。核心假设是 cross-attention activation 更接近模型将要渲染的内容，因此比文本 embedding 更能覆盖不直接命名目标概念的 paraphrase。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、底座模型、数据集、baseline 或具体数值。实验重点应是目标概念删除率、保留概念的损伤、对显式命名提示与 paraphrased prompt 的鲁棒性，以及无额外推理开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper removes a target concept from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without retraining or adding inference-time cost, while improving robustness to paraphrased prompts.
summary_en.importance: This is a model editing and safety method for generative diffusion models. It is peripheral to LLM pretraining, but the idea of defining what to forget in activation space rather than input-embedding space is relevant to unlearning and representation editing more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, PURE, stands for Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure. Instead of representing the target concept using text-encoder responses to a few anchor prompts, it builds forget and retain bases from per-layer cross-attention activations and applies a closed-form projection edit to U-Net cross-attention weights. The key assumption is that cross-attention activations better describe what the model is about to render than text embeddings do.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, base models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains. The relevant evaluation should measure concept removal, damage to retained concepts, robustness to explicit and paraphrased prompts, and the absence of inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 paraphrase 实验；激活空间 unlearning 的 prior 可借鉴，但不要外推到 LLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and paraphrase tests; activation-space unlearning is a useful prior, but do not over-transfer it to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: DRM: Diffusion-based Reward Model With Step-wise Guidance
paper.abstract: Current mainstream methods of aligning diffusion models with human preferences typically employ VLM-based reward models. However, these reward models, pre-trained for semantic alignment, struggle to capture the essential perceptual qualities-such as aesthetics, composition, and visual harmony. In this work, we argue that a model capable of high-fidelity generation must possess a profound understanding of these visual attributes. Based on this insight, we introduce the Diffusion-based Reward Mode

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散图像模型偏好对齐中，VLM 奖励模型偏语义、难以准确评价美学、构图和视觉和谐度的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把预训练扩散模型改造成 reward backbone，并利用中间 noisy latent 做逐步奖励；这对生成模型 RL 的 credit assignment 有参考价值，但主要局限在图像扩散模型后训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diffusion-based Reward Model，将预训练 diffusion model 用作评估器，不只评价最终图像，也评价生成过程中的中间 latent；进一步提出 Step-wise GRPO，用每一步的 dense reward 缓解只在最终样本打分带来的信用分配不精确。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度；可确认的实验重点应是与 VLM-based reward model 和常规 GRPO/最终图像奖励方案比较偏好对齐效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets preference alignment for diffusion image models, where VLM-based reward models often overemphasize semantics and under-score aesthetics, composition, and visual harmony.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is to turn a pretrained diffusion model into a reward backbone and use intermediate noisy latents for step-wise feedback. This is useful for thinking about credit assignment in generative-model RL, but the scope is mostly image diffusion post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Diffusion-based Reward Model evaluates both final images and noisy intermediate latents during generation. Step-wise GRPO then supplies dense per-step rewards instead of relying only on a terminal image-level score.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baseline names, or quantitative gains. The likely comparisons are against VLM-based reward models and standard GRPO-style final-reward optimization.

recommendation.zh: 想看 dense reward 如何落到生成轨迹上可读方法部分；视觉 reward 假设较重，不必按 LLM RL 结论外推。
recommendation.en: Read the method if you care about dense rewards over generation trajectories; the visual-reward assumptions are too specific to transfer directly to LLM RL.

paper.title: PIU: Proximity-guided Identity Unlearning in ID-Conditioned Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Identity-conditioned diffusion models enable high-quality and identity-consistent face generation, but they also raise severe privacy concerns, as models may continue to synthesize individuals despite their right to be forgotten. While machine unlearning has been extensively studied for concept and data removal, identity unlearning remains largely unexplored, particularly in models conditioned directly on identity embeddings rather than text prompts. In this work, we study identity unlearning in

summary.core_problem: 身份条件人脸生成扩散模型可能合成受“被遗忘权”保护的个体，现有机器遗忘方法很少针对身份条件扩散场景设计
summary.importance: 首次系统研究身份条件扩散模型的身份遗忘问题，提出了锚点引导的遗忘框架，属于领域内方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出PIU框架，将身份移除建模为身份替换目标，把源身份在嵌入空间中重映射到选定的锚点身份，结合ArcFace表示的几何特性设计proximity锚点选择策略
summary.experiments: 在SOTA身份条件扩散模型Arc2Face上验证，原摘要未给出完整量化遗忘效果与生成质量平衡数据

summary_en.core_problem: Identity-conditioned face generation diffusion models may synthesize individuals protected by the 'right to be forgotten', and existing machine unlearning methods are rarely designed for identity-conditioned diffusion scenarios
summary_en.importance: First systematic study of identity unlearning in identity-conditioned diffusion models, proposes an anchor-guided unlearning framework, which is a method innovation in the field
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the PIU framework, formulate identity removal as an identity replacement objective, remap the source identity to a selected anchor identity in the embedding space, and design a proximity-based anchor selection strategy based on the geometric properties of ArcFace representations
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Arc2Face, the state-of-the-art identity-conditioned diffusion model, full quantitative data on unlearning effect and generation quality trade-off not provided in truncated abstract

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型身份遗忘的问题定义有参考性，仅作为领域进展备查，无需阅读正文。
recommendation.en: The problem definition of identity unlearning in diffusion models is referenceable; keep as literature backup, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Hierarchical Variational Policies for Reward-Guided Diffusion
paper.abstract: Adapting pretrained diffusion models to downstream objectives such as inverse problems often requires expensive test-time guidance or optimization. We propose a principled framework for generating high-quality reward-aligned samples at substantially reduced inference cost. Our approach formulates test-time adaptation as a hierarchical variational model, where control is amortized into a lightweight yet expressive stochastic policy. This formulation naturally supports few-step diffusion sampling:

summary.core_problem: 降低 reward-guided diffusion 在逆问题和下游目标适配中的测试时引导成本，同时保持生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成模型的采样与适配方法。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对“把昂贵测试时优化摊销成可学习控制策略”这个思路有参考价值，尤其适用于图像生成、超分和 reward-aligned sampling。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把测试时适配形式化为 hierarchical variational model，并学习一个轻量随机 policy，在扩散采样每一步提供结构化控制。这样可以支持 few-step diffusion：用更大的步长减少采样步数，同时用 learned policy 补偿质量损失。方法属于对已有 reward-guided diffusion/test-time scaling 的摊销式改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 4x super-resolution 结果：相较最佳 test-time scaling baseline，感知质量更好且推理速度超过 5 倍。摘要未列出使用的 diffusion backbone、训练数据规模、policy 参数量或完整 benchmark 数值。
summary.authors_note: University of California Irvine；Stephan Mandt 课题组长期做生成建模、变分推断和高效采样相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the test-time cost of reward-guided diffusion for inverse problems and downstream objectives while preserving sample quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a generative-model sampling and adaptation contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the idea of amortizing expensive test-time control into a learned policy is relevant to broader questions around inference-time optimization and reward-aligned generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method frames test-time adaptation as a hierarchical variational model and learns a lightweight stochastic policy that provides structured per-step control during diffusion sampling. This enables few-step diffusion with larger step sizes, where the learned policy compensates for the quality loss that would otherwise come from aggressive discretization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports results on 4x super-resolution, where the method achieves better perceptual quality and more than 5x faster inference than the strongest test-time scaling baseline. The abstract does not specify the diffusion backbone, training-data scale, policy size, or full benchmark table.
summary_en.authors_note: University of California Irvine; Stephan Mandt's group is known for work on generative modeling, variational inference, and efficient sampling.

recommendation.zh: 作为 diffusion alignment 的备查即可；核心可读点是把测试时 guidance 摊销成 policy，和 LLM pretrain 距离较远。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a diffusion-alignment reference; the useful idea is amortizing test-time guidance into a policy, not anything LLM-pretraining-specific.

paper.title: Live Music Diffusion Models: Efficient Fine-Tuning and Post-Training of Interactive Diffusion Music Generators
paper.abstract: Interactive streaming music generation promises the use of generative models for live performance and co-creation that is impossible with offline models. However, SOTA models exist in the discrete-AR regime, requiring industrial levels of compute for both training and inference. In this work, we investigate whether audio diffusion models, with their wide support in the open-source community but non-streaming bidirectional nature, can be repurposed efficiently into interactive models accessible o

summary.core_problem: 交互式流式音乐生成目前SOTA模型在离散AR领域，训练和推理都需要工业级算力；开源扩散模型虽有社区支持但本质是非流式双向的，能否高效改造为交互式模型不明确
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次将块式KV缓存引入音频扩散模型，使扩散模型在推理复杂度上追上并超越离散AR模型
summary.technical_approach: Live Music Diffusion Models (LMDMs)通过对扩散生成过程的简单修改，利用块式KV缓存恢复并超越离散Live Music Models (LMMs)的推理复杂度
summary.experiments: （摘要被截断）对比了块式outpainting diffusion流水线与离散AR模型的推理效率，LMDM在消费级硬件上实现交互式音乐生成
summary.authors_note: UC San Diego，Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick团队（语音/音频生成方向）

summary_en.core_problem: Interactive streaming music generation SOTA lives in discrete-AR regime requiring industrial compute; open-source audio diffusion models, while widely supported, are inherently non-streaming and bidirectional
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first application of block-wise KV caching to audio diffusion models, enabling diffusion to match and exceed discrete AR inference efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Live Music Diffusion Models (LMDMs) modify the generative diffusion process with block-wise KV caching to recover and surpass the inference complexity of discrete Live Music Models (LMMs)
summary_en.experiments: (Abstract truncated) Compared block-wise outpainting diffusion pipeline efficiency against discrete AR models; LMDM achieves interactive music generation on consumer hardware
summary_en.authors_note: UC San Diego, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick's group (speech/audio generation)

recommendation.zh: 音频扩散生成领域工作，块式KV缓存对扩散模型的改造思路对扩散LM效率优化有微弱参考，摘要速读即可
recommendation.en: Audio diffusion generation work; block-wise KV caching modification has marginal relevance for diffusion LM efficiency optimization; abstract suffices

paper.title: Noise Schedule Design for Diffusion Models: An Optimal Control Perspective
paper.abstract: We develop a principled framework for analyzing and designing noise schedules in diffusion models. We show that one can recast this design problem as an optimal control problem, whose state is the Fisher information of the diffusion process which evolves according to an ODE and the control input is the noise schedule. The objective of the optimal control problem is a functional involving the Fisher information, which is shown to be an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler sampling error. By solvin

summary.core_problem: 研究扩散模型中 noise schedule 如何设计，目标是在有限离散步数下控制采样误差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析和方法框架：把 noise schedule 设计转化为最优控制问题，并用 Fisher information 的演化来刻画采样误差上界。对图像/连续扩散模型更直接，对 diffusion LM 研究是间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将扩散过程的 Fisher information 作为状态变量，noise schedule 作为控制输入，构造一个以 KL sampling error 上界为目标的最优控制问题。通过求解该问题，给出达到约 O(d/n) 采样误差的充分条件，其中 d 是数据维度，n 是离散化步数。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要报告理论结果，没有给出模型规模、训练数据或大规模生成实验。关键结果是：相比已有理论只覆盖特定 schedule，本文试图覆盖更接近实践中使用的 schedule，并给出 O(d/n) 级别采样误差条件。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 和 Carnegie Mellon University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to design noise schedules for diffusion models so that sampling error remains controlled under a finite number of discretization steps.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly theoretical: it formulates noise schedule design as an optimal control problem and analyzes sampling error through the Fisher information dynamics. The direct target is continuous diffusion models, with only indirect relevance to diffusion language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Fisher information of the diffusion process is treated as the state, while the noise schedule is treated as the control input. The objective is a functional that upper-bounds KL sampling error. Solving this control problem yields sufficient schedule conditions for achieving roughly O(d/n) sampling error, where d is data dimension and n is the number of discretization steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical guarantees rather than empirical model runs. The main stated result is that the framework can cover schedules closer to practical use, while prior bounds were limited to specific schedules.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Carnegie Mellon University.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 可扫 abstract 和定理条件；它不改语言建模 prior，但 schedule 设计的控制视角可借用。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick scan if you work on diffusion LMs; it will not change LM priors, but the control view of schedule design is reusable.

paper.title: Broken Memories: Detecting and Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models with Degraded Generations
paper.abstract: While diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images, their tendency to memorize training data poses significant privacy and copyright risks. In this work, we for the first time identify that memorization induces internal numerical instability, often manifesting as visually ``broken'' artifacts. Inspired by stability analysis in numerical methods, we introduce empirical stability regions based on latent update norms to quantitatively characterize stable behavior during generation. Leve

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型记忆化检测与缓解方法大多需要检测后重启生成，或依赖启发式的静态参数调整，会增加推理延迟、损害生成内容的语义保真度，也无法自适应处理不同程度的记忆化问题。
summary.importance: 建立了扩散模型记忆化行为与采样过程数值稳定性的关联，无需修改prompt或引导参数即可在线检测和缓解记忆化，对生成式模型的版权、隐私风险防控有实际应用价值，也为扩散模型训练动态的异常检测提供了新的观测维度。
summary.technical_approach: 首先观察到记忆化生成时，扩散采样的潜变量每步更新幅度会偏离正常生成对应的经验稳定区间：首先用少量正常prompt的生成数据计算得到潜变量更新的经验稳定区域；之后逐采样步检测当前潜变量更新幅度是否偏离稳定区间，判断生成轨迹是否出现记忆化趋势；针对检测到的记忆化分程度自适应缓解：轻度记忆化通过潜变量幅值约束做早期正则，重度记忆化对潜变量和更新幅度同时施加联合约束。整个过程在线完成，无需修改prompt、引导尺度，也不需要重启生成。
summary.experiments: 在Stable Diffusion 1.4上验证，记忆化检测AUC超过0.999，可完全消除记忆化生成（记忆化率为0.0%），同时保留高图像质量和语义保真度，单张图像的额外计算开销仅约0.01秒。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Introduction部分的记忆化与数值稳定性关联的核心观察，以及检测与缓解框架的整体设计，可跳过具体SDE公式推导细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing memorization detection and mitigation methods for diffusion models require restarting generation after detection, or rely on heuristic static parameter adjustments, which increase inference latency, damage semantic fidelity of generated content, and cannot adaptively handle memorization of different severity levels.
summary_en.importance: It establishes the correlation between diffusion model memorization behavior and numerical stability during sampling. It supports on-the-fly memorization detection and mitigation without modifying prompts or guidance parameters, which has practical application value for copyright and privacy risk prevention of generative models, and also provides a new observation dimension for anomaly detection of diffusion model training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the core observation is confirmed: during memorized generation, the per-step latent update magnitude of diffusion sampling deviates from the empirical stability region corresponding to normal generation. The empirical stability region of latent updates is first calculated using generation data from a small set of normal prompts. Then, per-step detection is performed to check whether the current latent update magnitude deviates from the stability region, to judge whether the generation trajectory has a memorization trend. Adaptive mitigation is applied according to detected memorization severity: mild memorization is regularized early via latent magnitude constraints, while severe memorization applies joint constraints on both latent values and update magnitudes. The whole process runs on the fly, with no need to modify prompts, guidance scales, or restart generation.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Stable Diffusion 1.4, the memorization detection AUC exceeds 0.999, and memorized generations are completely eliminated (0.0% memorization rate), while high image quality and semantic fidelity are preserved. The extra computational overhead per image is only ~0.01s.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core observation of correlation between memorization and numerical stability in the Introduction section, as well as the overall design of the detection and mitigation framework. Specific SDE formula derivation details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 Diffusion 的 Memorization 与数值不稳定性（latent update norm 异常）挂钩是一个有趣的机制发现，对研究生成模型的泛化与记忆边界有启发。
recommendation.en: Linking memorization in Diffusion to numerical instability (anomalous latent update norms) is an intriguing mechanistic finding, inspiring research on the generalization and memorization boundaries of generative models.

institutions: East China University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Variance Reduction for Expectations with Diffusion Teachers
paper.abstract: Pretrained diffusion models serve as frozen teachers feeding downstream pipelines such as text-to-3D, single-step distillation, and data attribution. The teacher gradients these pipelines consume are Monte Carlo (MC) expectations over noise levels and Gaussian noise samples; their estimator variance dominates compute cost because each draw requires expensive upstream work (rendering, simulation, encoding). We introduce CARV, a compute-aware variance-accounting framework that motivates a hierarch

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：当扩散模型不再作为被训练对象，而是作为冻结 teacher 给下游优化过程提供梯度时，梯度本身是对噪声时刻 t 和高斯噪声 ε 的 Monte Carlo 期望。此时真正昂贵的往往不是一次 denoise，而是上游链路里的渲染、仿真、编码或生成器前向。若仍沿用训练 diffusion 时常见的朴素采样，估计器方差会直接吞掉算力预算。论文要解决的不是改 teacher，也不是改下游目标，而是在不引入偏差的前提下，重新设计 frozen diffusion teacher 梯度的估计器，使单位计算量下的方差尽可能低。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在“训练一个更好的 diffusion model”，而在“如何把一个已训练好的生成模型当作上游训练信号源来高效使用”。这类问题和 today 的 pretrain-posttrain 接口很接近：大模型越来越常被当作 teacher、reward source、synthetic signal source，真正的瓶颈常常变成信号估计的方差与成本，而不是模型表达能力本身。论文的贡献量级偏方法工程与统计效率，不是范式级变化，但它把一个分散在 SDS、蒸馏、归因等任务里的经验问题整理成了统一的 compute-aware variance accounting 框架，并给出无偏、可落地、可组合的降方差手段。对做 diffusion teacher distillation、score distillation、teacher-guided optimization 的人有实际参考价值；对更广义的预训练研究者，启发在于：当训练信号来自昂贵外环时，最该优化的往往是估计器设计，而不是继续堆样本数。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CARV。它先把 frozen-teacher gradient 的随机性拆成不同来源，再把每一类随机性的成本显式计入，最后据此设计更合适的 Monte Carlo 估计器。

第一部分是层次化 Monte Carlo。作者观察到一次样本贡献通常包含两层随机性：外层是昂贵的上游状态构造，例如 renderer / encoder / generator forward；内层是便宜的 diffusion noising 与 teacher denoising。如果每次都把两层一起重采样，会把大量预算浪费在外层。于是他们提出 amortized resampling：缓存昂贵上游结果，只对便宜的 diffusion noise 重采样。这样做保持无偏，但能在固定预算下显著增加内层样本数。论文把这种收益用 ECM（effective compute multiplier）来量化，本质是在比较“达到同等方差需要多少额外算力”。

第二部分是 timestep importance sampling。扩散 teacher 的目标里本来就有显式 timestep weight，作者不是沿用 teacher 训练时继承下来的时间分布，而是针对下游梯度估计重新选 proposal q(t)。理论上最优 proposal 与条件二阶矩有关，实际不可得，于是他们用任务相关的可计算 proxy 来近似，并给出一个很直接的 drop-in 选择 q∝p·w。这里的关键判断是：下游要估计的是 teacher-induced gradient，不是 teacher training loss，所以最优采样分布应围绕梯度贡献而不是训练损失本身。

第三部分是 stratified inverse-CDF sampling。单纯 importance sampling 仍会受有限样本波动影响，尤其在 timestep 贡献高度不均时。作者把 stratification 和 importance sampling 结合，用 inverse-CDF 构造分层采样，使每个 batch 对时间轴覆盖更均匀，同时保留重要区域的高采样密度。文中把它描述为在无偏分配里接近最优的方案。

第四部分是 compute-aware variance accounting。论文没有停在“某个 trick 有效”，而是系统测量不同随机源、不同成本项、不同采样策略对总方差的贡献。这个框架的价值在于，它解释了为什么某些直觉上常见的做法收益有限：如果主导方差的是 timestep 和 noise，而主导成本的是 renderer/encoder，那么继续增加完全独立样本并不划算，应该优先做分层与重用。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三类场景：text-to-3D 的 diffusion-teacher-guided optimization、one-step distillation、以及 data attribution。

最核心的结果是有效算力倍率。论文报告 CARV 在 text-to-3D distillation 和 attribution 中带来约 2–3× 的 effective compute multiplier，也就是在达到相近方差时，只需原来约 1/3 到 1/2 的成本。这个结论和引言中的主张一致，也是全文最重要的实证点。

在 timestep 采样上，使用显式 teacher weight 的 importance proposal，相比 uniform timestep sampling，在单次迭代成本相同的情况下大约再带来 1.2× 的方差下降。作者还用 toy analysis 展示 oracle proposal 相当于 3–4× uniform compute，而一个高斯峰值近似也接近 2×，说明时间分布选择本身就有不小空间。

层次化重采样是主要收益来源。文中多处强调，缓存昂贵上游计算、重复采样便宜 diffusion noise，是 ECM 提升的 dominant lever。换句话说，真正决定收益的不是某个复杂控制变量，而是把“昂贵外层、便宜内层”的结构利用起来。

值得注意的是，one-step distillation 场景里虽然方差/算力比改善明显，但没有带来下游 FID 提升。这个负结果很重要，说明估计器更高效不自动等于最终生成质量更好；可能是该任务已受别的误差源限制，或者训练目标与 FID 的耦合较弱。对读者来说，这比单纯报正结果更有信息量。

从全文可见，作者更强调 variance-per-compute 和 estimator quality，而不是把最终任务指标包装成统一收益。这种实验组织方式是合理的，因为论文研究对象本来就是梯度估计器。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。

第一，看方法图和问题设定，尤其是介绍两层随机性与成本拆分的部分。若只看结果表，很容易误以为这只是“多采样几次噪声”；真正关键是哪些随机变量值得重采样，哪些中间结果值得缓存。

第二，看 Sec. 3.2 的 variance accounting 和 ECM 定义，再配合 Fig. 5。这里决定了整篇论文的评价标准。若不接受这个 compute-aware 视角，就很难理解为什么某些策略在 wall-clock 或最终指标上不一定同步体现收益。

第三，看 timestep proposal 与 stratified inverse-CDF 的推导和实验，尤其 Table 2、Fig. 1、Fig. 2、Fig. 4。这里能看清作者不是在做 heuristic schedule tuning，而是在把 importance sampling、stratification 和 diffusion objective 的权重结构接起来。

如果只打算花 20–30 分钟，建议读 Introduction、方法总览、Sec. 3.2、text-to-3D 结果和 one-step distillation 的负结果。若要深挖，重点看附录里关于 oracle proposal、近似 proposal、以及 unbiased allocation 的推导。对做 teacher-guided optimization 的人，最值得复用的是分析框架，不只是具体采样公式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but under-formalized issue: when a pretrained diffusion model is used as a frozen teacher, downstream pipelines consume gradients that are Monte Carlo expectations over timesteps and Gaussian noise. In many such pipelines, the expensive part is not the denoiser call itself, but upstream work such as rendering, simulation, encoding, or generator forward passes. Under this cost structure, naive sampling leads to high estimator variance per unit compute. The paper asks how to redesign the teacher-gradient estimator so that it remains unbiased while achieving much lower variance under a fixed compute budget.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense of improving diffusion training, but it is highly relevant to the broader pretrain-to-posttrain interface: once a large generative model becomes a teacher, reward source, or optimization oracle, the bottleneck often shifts from model quality to signal estimation efficiency. The contribution is methodological rather than paradigm-shifting, but it is useful because it turns a scattered engineering pain point into a clean compute-aware variance-reduction framework. For researchers working on score distillation, diffusion-guided optimization, or teacher-based distillation, the paper offers directly deployable tools. For pretraining researchers more broadly, the main lesson is that when supervision comes through an expensive outer loop, estimator design can matter more than simply increasing sample count.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is CARV, a compute-aware variance-accounting framework for gradients induced by frozen diffusion teachers. The framework decomposes randomness sources, attaches explicit cost to each source, and then derives estimator choices that improve variance per unit compute.

The first component is hierarchical Monte Carlo with amortized resampling. A typical sample contribution contains an expensive outer random component, such as rendering, encoding, or generator forward computation, and a cheaper inner random component from diffusion noising and denoising. Resampling both layers independently wastes budget on the expensive outer layer. CARV instead caches the expensive upstream computation and resamples only the cheap diffusion noise. This keeps the estimator unbiased while increasing the number of effective inner samples under the same budget. The paper quantifies the gain using ECM, the effective compute multiplier.

The second component is timestep importance sampling. Rather than inheriting the teacher’s original timestep distribution, the paper chooses a proposal distribution q(t) tailored to the downstream gradient estimator. The theoretical optimum depends on a conditional second moment and is not directly available, so the authors use tractable proxies. A simple drop-in proposal q proportional to p times the explicit teacher weight already gives measurable gains. The important conceptual point is that the right proposal should target downstream gradient contribution, not the original diffusion training loss.

The third component is stratified inverse-CDF sampling over timesteps. Importance sampling alone still suffers from finite-sample fluctuation, especially when contribution mass is concentrated in a narrow timestep region. The paper combines stratification with inverse-CDF construction so that each batch covers the timestep axis more evenly while still allocating more samples to important regions. The authors argue this is close to optimal among unbiased allocations.

The fourth component is the variance-accounting framework itself. Instead of presenting isolated tricks, the paper measures how different randomness sources and cost terms contribute to total variance. This explains why some common heuristics underperform: if variance is dominated by timestep and noise randomness while cost is dominated by rendering or encoding, then fully independent samples are a poor use of budget compared with reuse plus structured sampling.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover three settings: diffusion-teacher-guided text-to-3D optimization, one-step distillation, and data attribution.

The headline result is a roughly 2–3× effective compute multiplier in text-to-3D distillation and attribution. In practical terms, CARV reaches comparable variance at about one-third to one-half of the original cost. This is the main empirical claim of the paper and the most important number to retain.

For timestep sampling, the explicit-weight importance proposal improves variance by about 1.2× over uniform timestep sampling at equal per-iteration cost. The paper also includes a toy analysis showing that the oracle proposal is variance-equivalent to roughly 3–4× uniform compute, while a Gaussian-around-the-peak approximation is worth about 2×. This indicates that timestep allocation alone has meaningful headroom.

Hierarchical resampling is presented as the dominant source of gain. Reusing expensive upstream computation and resampling only cheap diffusion noise drives most of the ECM improvement. That is an important practical takeaway: the main benefit does not come from an elaborate control-variate construction, but from exploiting the nested cost structure correctly.

A notable negative result appears in one-step distillation: variance-per-compute improves, but downstream FID does not. This is informative rather than disappointing. It suggests that better gradient estimation does not automatically translate into better end metrics when other error sources dominate or when the training objective is only weakly aligned with FID.

Overall, the experimental design is consistent with the paper’s goal. The focus is on estimator quality and variance-per-compute, not on forcing every task metric to improve.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem setup and the figures that separate the two randomness layers and their costs. Without that, the method can look like a generic “sample more noise” trick, which misses the point.

Then read the variance-accounting section, especially the definition of ECM and the associated measurements. That is the conceptual center of the paper. The method only makes full sense once the evaluation target is variance under a compute budget rather than raw iteration count.

After that, focus on the timestep proposal and stratified inverse-CDF construction, together with the corresponding figures and tables. Those sections show that the method is not heuristic schedule tuning; it is a principled combination of importance sampling, stratification, and the weighting structure already present in diffusion objectives.

For a 20–30 minute skim, read the introduction, the method overview, the variance-accounting section, the text-to-3D results, and the one-step distillation negative result. For a deeper read, spend time on the appendix derivations for the oracle proposal, practical approximations, and unbiased allocation. The most reusable part is the analysis framework, not just the specific sampling formula.

recommendation.zh: 扩散教师梯度计算的通用效率优化方案，做模型蒸馏、扩散LM训练的研究员可重点看§3的分层估计设计
recommendation.en: General efficiency optimization for diffusion teacher gradient computation, researchers working on model distillation or diffusion LM training should focus on the hierarchical estimator design in §3.

paper.title: Linear-DPO: Linear Direct Preference Optimization for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Generative Models
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is successful for alignment in LLMs but still faces challenges in text-to-image generation. Existing studies are confined to denoising diffusion models while overlooking flow-matching, and suffer from an objective mismatch when applying discrete NLP-based DPO to regression-based generative tasks.\ In this paper, we derive a generalized DPO objective that covers both diffusion and flow-matching via a unified reverse-time SDE framework, and point out from a gra

summary.core_problem: 解决 DPO 直接迁移到文本到图像 diffusion / flow-matching 模型时的目标错配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是偏好优化方法改造。它把 LLM 中常用的 DPO 对齐思想重新推导到连续回归式生成模型上，尤其补上了 flow-matching 模型这一支，对多模态生成模型的偏好训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在统一 reverse-time SDE 框架下推导 diffusion 与 flow-matching 的广义 DPO 目标，并从梯度角度指出标准 sigmoid 型 DPO utility 对图像生成过于激进。Linear-DPO 用线性 utility 替代 sigmoid utility，使偏好梯度更持续，同时引入 EMA 更新的 reference model 稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SD1.5、SDXL 等 denoising diffusion 模型，以及 SD3-Medium 这类 flow-matching 模型。论文报告定性和定量指标均优于已有 diffusion preference optimization baseline，但摘要未给出具体数据规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the objective mismatch that appears when DPO is directly applied to text-to-image diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for continuous generative models. It re-derives DPO-style alignment outside discrete autoregressive language modeling and explicitly includes flow-matching models, which makes it relevant to multimodal generation training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors derive a generalized DPO objective under a unified reverse-time SDE formulation for both diffusion and flow matching. They argue from the gradient form that the standard sigmoid-based DPO utility is too aggressive for regression-based image generation, then propose Linear-DPO with a sustained linear utility and an EMA-updated reference model.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on SD1.5, SDXL, and SD3-Medium. The paper claims qualitative and quantitative gains over existing baselines, but the abstract does not provide exact dataset sizes or improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Harbin Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标推导和梯度分析即可；它对连续生成模型的 DPO 迁移有用，但离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the objective derivation and gradient analysis; useful for DPO in continuous generators, but peripheral to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: RaPD: Resolution-Agnostic Pixel Diffusion via Semantics-Enriched Implicit Representations
paper.abstract: Natural images are continuous, yet most generative models synthesize them on discrete grids, limiting resolution-flexible generation. Continuous neural fields enable resolution-free rendering, but prior methods introduce continuity only at the decoding stage as an interpolation module, leaving the generative latent space discretized and reconstruction-oriented. We propose RaPD (Resolution-agnostic Pixel Diffusion), which performs diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field (NIF) latent space. R

summary.core_problem: 现有生成模型在离散网格上合成图像，限制了分辨率灵活生成；连续神经场方法仅在解码阶段引入连续性，隐空间仍是离散化且面向重建。
summary.importance: 首次将扩散过程置于连续神经图像场（NIF）隐空间中，实现单次去噪隐变量可渲染任意分辨率图像，扩散成本固定。
summary.technical_approach: RaPD通过语义表示指导（Semantic Representation Guidance）实现生成感知的隐空间学习，配合坐标查询注意力渲染器（Coordinate-Queried Attention Renderer）实现坐标条件的尺度感知渲染。
summary.experiments: 实验证明在生成质量和分辨率可扩展性上优于现有方法，未详述具体模型规模和量化指标。
summary.authors_note: 南京大学，无知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing generative models synthesize images on discrete grids, limiting resolution-flexible generation; continuous neural field methods introduce continuity only at the decoding stage, leaving the generative latent space discretized and reconstruction-oriented.
summary_en.importance: First approach that performs diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field (NIF) latent space, enabling a single denoised latent to be rendered at arbitrary resolutions with fixed diffusion cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: RaPD bridges the reconstruction-generation gap with Semantic Representation Guidance for generation-aware latent learning and a Coordinate-Queried Attention Renderer for coordinate-conditioned, scale-aware rendering.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments demonstrate superior generation quality and resolution scalability over existing methods; specific model sizes and quantitative metrics not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Nanjing University; no notable authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 图像生成方向将扩散与连续神经场结合的尝试，对扩散LM研究有微弱的方法类比价值，但总体属于图像生成领域，了解即可。
recommendation.en: An interesting combination of diffusion with continuous neural fields for image generation. Minor analogical value for diffusion LM research, but overall belongs to image generation domain—high-level understanding suffices.

paper.title: Do Less, Achieve More: Do We Need Every-Step Optimization for RL Fine-tuning of Diffusion Models?
paper.abstract: Despite strong image-generation performance, diffusion models' reconstruction objectives limit alignment with human preferences. RL enables such alignment through explicit rewards. However, most studies apply RL to the full denoising trajectory, making it computationally costly and weakening preference alignment, i.e., doing more but achieving less. We observe that the impact of RL fine-tuning varies significantly across denoising stages. In the early stage, image structures are unstable and dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论扩散模型做 RL 对齐时是否需要优化完整去噪轨迹。核心问题是：最终图像奖励被回填到所有去噪步，会造成早期动作和最终奖励弱相关，晚期更新收益饱和且更容易放大奖励黑客，同时带来不必要的计算开销。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接贡献有限，但对“生成模型 + RL 信号”的训练接口有参考价值。它把扩散模型的去噪过程看成分阶段决策过程，强调不同时间步的奖励可归因性和训练价值不同。这一点对 AR+diffusion 统一建模、视觉生成模型对齐、以及多模态后训练中的 reward assignment 都有启发：不是所有中间状态都应被同等优化，训练信号需要和状态语义成熟度匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 AdaScope，是一个可插入现有扩散 RL 微调方法的阶段筛选模块。它不再对完整 denoising trajectory 做等频 RL 更新，而是自适应选择 RL 介入区间。起点由“semantic maturity”决定：早期图像结构尚未形成，噪声占主导，最终奖励很难正确归因到当前动作，因此跳过这段更新。终点由“denoising completeness”和 reward-gain trend 联合决定：当去噪基本收敛、奖励增益趋于饱和时停止更新，避免继续优化局部细节导致 reward hacking。论文还用相邻中间去噪结果的相关性分析来支持阶段划分：早期状态变化大，晚期状态高度稳定，中间区间更适合承接奖励优化。
summary.experiments: 论文称将 AdaScope 集成到 4 种不同 RL 微调方法中，在 6 个指标上优于对应基线，同时训练计算成本降到完整轨迹优化的 59%。关键实验结论不是单纯省算力，而是省掉的阶段本身也可能带来负贡献：早期更新增加 policy gradient 方差，晚期更新更容易过拟合奖励模型偏好或局部纹理。由于给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表格，具体指标名称、数据集、模型规模和每个基线的数值差异需要读实验章节确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，Introduction 中对 early-stage temporal misalignment 和 late-stage reward hacking 的问题定义；第二，Method 中 AdaScope 如何定义 semantic maturity、denoising completeness 和 reward-gain saturation，这决定方法是否只是经验阈值；第三，实验中的 ablation，尤其是固定起止点、只跳过早期、只提前终止晚期和完整 AdaScope 的对比。若关注多模态统一预训练，可重点思考这种阶段选择能否迁移到 diffusion head、image tokenizer 生成阶段或混合 AR/diffusion 训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether RL fine-tuning of diffusion models really needs to optimize every denoising step. The core issue is reward assignment: the final image reward is commonly backfilled to the whole trajectory, but early denoising states are weakly tied to the final reward, while late states often have saturated reward gains and are more prone to reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited, but the training-signal argument is useful for generative foundation models. The paper treats diffusion sampling as a stage-dependent decision process and shows that different denoising regions have different credit-assignment quality. This is relevant to AR-diffusion unified models, visual generation alignment, and reward-driven multimodal post-training, where intermediate states should not necessarily receive uniform optimization pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaScope is proposed as a plug-in stage selector for RL fine-tuning of diffusion models. Instead of applying RL updates to the full denoising trajectory, it identifies an effective intervention window. The start point is determined by semantic maturity: highly noisy early states are skipped because image structure is unstable and the final reward is poorly attributable to those actions. The stop point is determined by denoising completeness together with reward-gain trends: once generation has nearly converged and marginal reward improvement saturates, updates are stopped to reduce low-return optimization and reward hacking. The paper supports this design with an analysis of correlations between adjacent intermediate denoising states, arguing that the middle region has a better balance between semantic stability and useful reward gradients.
summary_en.experiments: The authors report integration with four RL fine-tuning methods. Across six metrics, AdaScope improves generation quality while reducing the computational cost to 59% of full-trajectory RL optimization. The main experimental claim is that skipped steps are not merely redundant; early-step RL increases gradient variance due to action-reward mismatch, and late-step RL can overfit local visual details or reward-model artifacts. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete tables, so the exact datasets, metric names, model sizes, and per-baseline gains should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Focus on three parts: the problem formulation in the introduction, especially early-stage temporal misalignment and late-stage reward hacking; the method section defining semantic maturity, denoising completeness, and reward-gain saturation; and the ablations comparing fixed windows, early-step skipping, late-step stopping, and full AdaScope. For multimodal pretraining readers, the useful question is whether similar stage selection can be applied to diffusion heads, visual token generation, or hybrid AR/diffusion training.

recommendation.zh: 分阶段RL微调的思路可迁移到LLM后训练，只需看阶段收益分析的实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: The stage-wise RL fine-tuning idea can be transferred to LLM post-training, only read the experimental section on stage gain analysis.

paper.title: Asymmetric Flow Models
paper.abstract: Flow-based generation in high-dimensional spaces is difficult because velocity prediction requires modeling high-dimensional noise, even when data has strong low-rank structure. We present Asymmetric Flow Modeling (AsymFlow), a rank-asymmetric velocity parameterization that restricts noise prediction to a low-rank subspace while keeping data prediction full-dimensional. From this asymmetric prediction, AsymFlow analytically recovers the full-dimensional velocity without changing the network arch

summary.core_problem: 高维空间下基于流的生成方法需要建模高维噪声，即使数据存在强低秩结构也会导致建模难度大、性能受限
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出秩非对称的速度参数化范式，首次实现预训练隐空间流模型到像素空间模型的无缝微调迁移
summary.technical_approach: 提出AsymFlow，将噪声预测限制在低秩子空间、数据预测保持全维，通过解析方式恢复全维速度，无需改动原有网络架构和训练采样流程；通过对齐低秩像素子空间与隐空间，实现隐空间流模型到像素空间的无缝初始化微调
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet 256×256数据集上取得1.57 FID，大幅优于此前DiT/JiT类像素扩散模型；验证了隐空间流模型微调转像素空间模型的可行性，微调可保留原模型高层语义与结构
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学团队，作者包括Gordon Wetzstein、Leonidas Guibas，团队在生成建模、3D视觉领域有大量代表性工作

summary_en.core_problem: Flow-based generation in high-dimensional spaces suffers from high complexity, as velocity prediction requires modeling high-dimensional noise even when data has strong low-rank structure
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes rank-asymmetric velocity parameterization and enables the first seamless finetuning of pretrained latent flow models to pixel-space models
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AsymFlow, which restricts noise prediction to a low-rank subspace while keeping data prediction full-dimensional, recovers full-dimensional velocity analytically without modifying network architecture or training/sampling pipelines; enables seamless latent-to-pixel initialization by aligning low-rank pixel subspace with latent space
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 1.57 FID on ImageNet 256×256, outperforming prior DiT/JiT-like pixel diffusion models by a large margin; validates latent-to-pixel finetuning preserves high-level semantics and structure of the original model
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University team including Gordon Wetzstein and Leonidas Guibas, who have extensive representative work in generative modeling and 3D vision

recommendation.zh: 生成建模基础方法的增量改进，低秩参数化思路对统一多模态生成预训练有参考价值，仅看核心方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to generative modeling fundamentals, low-rank parameterization is useful for unified multimodal generative pretraining, only read the core method section

paper.title: The Diffusion Encoder
paper.abstract: We construct a new kind of encoder, leveraging the expressive power of diffusion models. In a traditional variational autoencoder, the encoder and decoder jointly negotiate a latent representation of the input. This is made possible by the reparameterization trick, which simplifies training at the cost of restricting the encoder to a simple family of distributions. Replacing this encoder with a diffusion model requires rethinking how the decoder pressure can be transmitted back to the encoder, g

summary.core_problem: 研究如何用 diffusion model 充当 encoder，使 autoencoder 的 latent posterior 不再受传统 VAE 简单分布族和 reparameterization trick 限制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型和表示学习方法创新；它不直接是语言建模，但对视觉 tokenizer、latent generative pretraining 和统一模态建模有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 传统 VAE 通过 reparameterization trick 让 encoder 和 decoder 联合训练，但 encoder 分布通常被限制为简单可重参数化形式。论文尝试用 diffusion model 替代 encoder，并指出 encoder 与 decoder 对 latent 的内部估计更新方向可能相反，导致 decoder pressure 难以回传；解决方案是借鉴 EM 的 alternating training scheme，使 encoder 和 decoder 更可靠同步，同时保留标准 diffusion objective 的简单训练形式。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要没有提供数据集、模型规模、图像或其他模态实验、重建质量、生成质量或与 VAE/diffusion autoencoder baseline 的定量比较。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California San Diego 和 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to use a diffusion model as an encoder, so that autoencoder latent posteriors are not restricted to the simple distribution families typically used in VAEs.
summary_en.importance: This is a generative-modeling and representation-learning contribution. It is not language modeling, but it may be indirectly relevant to visual tokenizers, latent generative pretraining, and unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: A standard VAE relies on the reparameterization trick to jointly train encoder and decoder, but this usually restricts the encoder to simple tractable distributions. The paper replaces the encoder with a diffusion model and identifies a synchronization issue: the encoder and decoder may update their latent estimates in opposing directions, making decoder pressure hard to transmit. It proposes an EM-inspired alternating training scheme to synchronize them while keeping the standard diffusion objective simple.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, modalities, reconstruction quality, generation quality, or quantitative comparisons against VAE or diffusion-autoencoder baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of California San Diego and an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法部分；若你在做视觉 tokenizer 或 latent LM，EM 式同步思路值得记下，缺实验数字前别高估。
recommendation.en: Skim the method if you work on visual tokenizers or latent LMs; the EM-style synchronization idea is worth noting, but do not overrate it without experiments.

paper.title: Normalizing Trajectory Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based models decompose sampling into many small Gaussian denoising steps -- an assumption that breaks down when generation is compressed to a few coarse transitions. Existing few-step methods address this through distillation, consistency training, or adversarial objectives, but sacrifice the likelihood framework in the process. We introduce Normalizing Trajectory Models (NTM), which models each reverse step as an expressive conditional normalizing flow with exact likelihood training.

summary.core_problem: 扩散类模型的单高斯反向转移假设在少步采样时失效，现有少步生成方法包括蒸馏、一致性模型、对抗训练都牺牲了精确似然框架，无法同时实现少步高质量生成和可解释的精确似然训练。
summary.importance: 实现了少步生成下的精确轨迹似然建模，打通了自监督表示学习和概率生成建模的边界，为扩散类模型的效率优化和统一建模范式提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将反向转移p(x_s|x_t)建模为条件归一化流，通过可逆传输层学习隐空间，让反向条件在隐空间中可被高斯预测器拟合，维度保持的可逆性支持通过变量替换公式实现精确对数似然训练。架构上每步内使用浅可逆块，跨轨迹使用深并行预测器，可从零开始训练，也可从预训练流匹配模型初始化。利用精确轨迹似然实现自蒸馏，可将生成步骤压缩到4步。
summary.experiments: 在类别条件和文本到图像生成任务上，从零训练的4步采样NTM在GenEval上达到0.82，明显优于此前归一化流模型STARFlow的0.56（需要256步自回归采样），性能匹配或超过现有少步基线，同时是唯一保留生成轨迹精确似然的方法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第1章引言中少步扩散的假设瓶颈分析，第3章NTM的可逆传输层和似然计算设计，第4章自蒸馏少步生成的实现逻辑，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The single-Gaussian reverse transition assumption of diffusion-based models breaks down under few-step sampling. Existing few-step generation methods, including distillation, consistency models, and adversarial training, all abandon the exact likelihood framework, making it impossible to achieve both high-quality few-step generation and interpretable exact likelihood training simultaneously.
summary_en.importance: Realizes exact trajectory likelihood modeling for few-step generation, bridging the gap between self-supervised representation learning and probabilistic generative modeling, providing a new path for efficiency optimization and unified modeling paradigms for diffusion-like models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models the reverse transition p(x_s|x_t) as a conditional normalizing flow. It learns a latent space via an invertible transporter, where the reverse conditional is simple enough to be fit by a Gaussian predictor. The dimensionality-preserving invertibility enables exact log-likelihood training via the change-of-variables formula. Architecturally, it combines shallow invertible blocks per step with a deep parallel predictor across the trajectory. It can be trained from scratch or initialized from pretrained flow-matching models. The exact trajectory likelihood supports self-distillation to compress generation to as few as 4 steps.
summary_en.experiments: On class-conditional and text-to-image generation tasks, a scratch-trained NTM with 4 sampling steps achieves 0.82 on GenEval, outperforming the prior normalizing flow model STARFlow which scores 0.56 with 256 autoregressive steps. Its performance matches or exceeds strong few-step baselines, while it is the only method that retains exact likelihood over the generative trajectory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 (analysis of the assumption bottleneck of few-step diffusion), Section 3 (design of the invertible transporter and likelihood calculation of NTM), and Section 4 (implementation logic of self-distilled few-step generation). Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散+归一化流的混合建模范式，对考虑扩散LM或flow-based语言建模的研究者有参考价值，重点看架构设计（浅可逆块+并行预测器）
recommendation.en: A hybrid diffusion-normalizing flow paradigm worth examining for researchers considering diffusion LM or flow-based language modeling; focus on the architecture design

paper.title: Why DDIM Hallucinates More than DDPM: A Theoretical Analysis of Reverse Dynamics
paper.abstract: We theoretically study the hallucination phenomena in two canonical diffusion samplers: the stochastic Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) and the deterministic Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM). We analyze the reverse ODE (DDIM) and SDE (DDPM) for a Gaussian mixture target, proving that after a critical time $τ$, (a) DDIM can become stuck on the segment connecting the two nearest modes and (b) DDPM *stochasticity* helps it become unstuck from this region, thus avoiding halluc

summary.core_problem: 尽管 DDIM 和 DDPM 训练方式相同，但在采样时 DDIM（确定性 ODE）比 DDPM（随机 SDE）更容易产生幻觉（如生成不符合数据分布的样本）。现有研究多从经验角度或网络近似误差角度解释，缺乏对逆向扩散过程机制的严格理论刻画。
summary.importance: 从理论上严格证明了 DDIM 幻觉率高于 DDPM 的根本原因在于逆向过程的动力学差异，排除了数值离散化误差或网络近似误差作为主因的假设，为设计更鲁棒的扩散采样器提供了理论依据。
summary.technical_approach: 在 N 模态高斯混合目标分布下，分析了 DDIM（逆向 PF ODE）和 DDPM（逆向 VP SDE）的轨迹。证明了采样过程分为两个阶段：早期收敛到两个最近模态之间的连线，后期沿连线运动。关键发现是，在后期阶段，DDIM 轨迹容易停滞在连线中点附近（即发生模式插值/幻觉），而 DDPM 的随机噪声项能够帮助轨迹逃离该停滞区域，从而避免幻觉。
summary.experiments: 理论推导在零数值误差和精确分数函数下进行。实证验证表明，即使在相同的离散化步数下，DDIM 和 DDPM 的幻觉率差距依然存在，排除了步数跳跃（step skipping）导致幻觉的假设。此外，实验展示了在 DDIM 轨迹进入停滞区域后，增加少量 DDPM 随机步可以有效帮助轨迹逃离，降低幻觉率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读引言中的图 1 及问题设定，理解两阶段收敛的物理图像。理论推导部分可关注后期阶段（late convergence phase）中确定性漂移与随机扩散项在逃离中点停滞区时的不同作用机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Although DDIM and DDPM are trained identically, DDIM (deterministic ODE) is more prone to hallucinations (e.g., generating samples outside the data distribution) than DDPM (stochastic SDE) during sampling. Existing studies mostly explain this empirically or through network approximation errors, lacking a rigorous theoretical characterization of the reverse diffusion mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Provides a rigorous theoretical proof that the fundamental reason for DDIM's higher hallucination rate compared to DDPM lies in the dynamical differences of the reverse process, ruling out numerical discretization errors or network approximation errors as the primary causes, and offering a theoretical basis for designing more robust diffusion samplers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes the trajectories of DDIM (reverse PF ODE) and DDPM (reverse VP SDE) under an N-mode Gaussian mixture target distribution. Proves that the sampling process consists of two phases: early convergence to the line segment connecting the two nearest modes, and late convergence moving along this line. The key finding is that during the late phase, DDIM trajectories can get stuck near the midpoint of the line (i.e., mode interpolation/hallucination), whereas the stochastic noise term in DDPM helps the trajectory escape this stagnation region, thereby avoiding hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: Theoretical derivations are conducted under zero numerical error and exact score functions. Empirical validation shows that the hallucination rate gap between DDIM and DDPM persists even under the same discretization steps, ruling out step skipping as the cause. Furthermore, experiments demonstrate that adding a few DDPM stochastic steps after a DDIM trajectory enters the stagnation region can effectively help it escape, lowering the hallucination rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Figure 1 and the problem setting in the Introduction to understand the physical picture of the two-phase convergence. For the theoretical part, pay attention to the different roles of the deterministic drift and stochastic diffusion terms in escaping the midpoint stagnation region during the late convergence phase.

recommendation.zh: 对 diffusion LM 研究者可作采样动力学备忘；重点看临界时间后的模态连线 trapping 证明，别把图像幻觉结论直接外推到文本。
recommendation.en: Useful as sampler-dynamics background for diffusion-LM work; read the post-critical-time trapping proof, but do not directly port image hallucination claims to text.

paper.title: Conditional Diffusion Under Linear Constraints: Langevin Mixing and Information-Theoretic Guarantees
paper.abstract: We study zero-shot conditional sampling with pretrained diffusion models for linear inverse problems, including inpainting and super-resolution. In these problems, the observation determines only part of the unknown signal. The remaining degrees of freedom must be sampled according to the correct conditional data distribution. Existing projection-based samplers enforce measurement consistency by correcting the observed component during reverse diffusion. However, measurement consistency alone do

summary.core_problem: 研究预训练 diffusion model 在带线性约束的逆问题中如何做无监督条件采样，并避免只满足测量一致性却采样分布有偏。
summary.importance: 贡献是 diffusion 条件采样的理论分析：指出投影式 sampler 只保证观测方向一致，不能保证可行集合切向方向上的条件分布正确。对图像 inverse problem 和 diffusion sampler 设计有参考价值，但不是语言建模工作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 score 分解为 normal 方向和 tangent 方向。在线性观测和 Gaussian noising 下，观测方向 score 可由 measurement 精确决定，未知部分集中在 tangent conditional score。作者证明用 unconditional tangent score 替代 conditional tangent score 的误差可由维度无关的 conditional mutual information 上界控制，并讨论 Langevin mixing 条件。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论保证，任务包括 inpainting 和 super-resolution 等线性逆问题。未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 或数值提升；实验细节需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Michigan。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies zero-shot conditional sampling with pretrained diffusion models under linear constraints, aiming to avoid biased samples that merely satisfy the measurements.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is theoretical: projection-based inverse-problem samplers enforce consistency in observed directions but do not determine the correct conditional distribution along the feasible set. This is relevant to diffusion sampling theory, but not directly to language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The score is decomposed into normal and tangent components. Under Gaussian noising, the observed-direction score is exactly specified by the measurement, while the tangent conditional score remains unknown.
