The paper bounds the error of replacing it with the unconditional tangent score using a dimension-free conditional mutual information term and analyzes Langevin mixing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames applications such as inpainting and super-resolution, but primarily reports theory. It does not specify model checkpoints, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Michigan.

recommendation.zh: 只看 score normal/tangent 分解即可；它提醒 diffusion 条件采样不能把约束满足误当分布正确。
recommendation.en: Skim the normal/tangent score decomposition; it is a clean reminder that measurement consistency is not distributional correctness.

paper.title: Towards General Preference Alignment: Diffusion Models at Nash Equilibrium
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has been popular for aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences. As a mainstream branch of RLHF, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) offers a computationally efficient alternative that avoids explicit reward modeling and has been widely adopted in diffusion alignment. However, existing preference-based methods for diffusion alignment still rely on reward-induced preference signals and typically assume that human prefere

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图扩散模型偏好对齐方法依赖Bradley-Terry偏好假设，无法完整捕捉复杂人类偏好
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次从博弈论纳什均衡视角建模扩散模型偏好对齐，规避BT模型假设限制
summary.technical_approach: 提出Diffusion Nash Preference Optimization（Diff-NPO），让当前策略自博弈达到纳什均衡实现偏好对齐，无需显式奖励建模，不依赖BT偏好假设
summary.experiments: 在文生图基准上验证对齐效果优于现有DPO类扩散对齐方法
summary.authors_note: 波士顿大学、宾州州立大学团队，无公开知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing preference alignment methods for text-to-image diffusion models rely on Bradley-Terry assumption, which fails to capture full complexity of human preferences
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first to model diffusion preference alignment from game-theoretic Nash equilibrium perspective, bypassing limitations of BT model assumptions
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Diffusion Nash Preference Optimization (Diff-NPO), which lets current policy play against itself to reach Nash equilibrium for preference alignment, no explicit reward modeling required, no dependency on BT preference assumptions
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms existing DPO-based diffusion alignment methods on text-to-image benchmarks
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Boston University and Penn State University, no well-known authors identified

recommendation.zh: 偏好对齐的博弈论视角可作为DPO改进的弱参考，仅读摘要即可
recommendation.en: The game-theoretic perspective for preference alignment serves as weak reference for DPO improvement, only read the abstract

paper.title: Local Intrinsic Dimension Unveils Hallucinations in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are prone to generating structural hallucinations - samples that match the statistical properties of the training data yet defy underlying structural rules, resulting in anomalies like hands with more than five fingers. Recent research studied this failure mode from several viewpoints, offering partial explanations to their occurrence, such as mode interpolation. In this work, we propose a complementary perspective that treats hallucinations as instabilities on the model-induced

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解扩散模型中的结构性幻觉，尤其是样本外观统计合理但结构规则错误的生成失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏机制分析与诊断：把 hallucination 解释为模型流形上的不稳定性，并提出可操作的校正机制。对做新型语言建模范式、尤其 diffusion LM/生成稳定性的研究员有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造基于 instability 的 hallucination 过滤器，再追踪不稳定性的来源，提出局部内在维度（LID）是主要驱动因素。基于这一判断，作者提出 Intrinsic Quenching（IQ），直接压低局部内在维度以减少幻觉。方法核心不是换 backbone，而是引入一个几何诊断量并把它变成干预信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 IQ 在多种 benchmark 和现有 hallucination reduction baseline 上持续更优，并且基于 instability 的过滤器达到或超过近期 temporal 方法。但摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体数据集和提升幅度，因此证据强度需要看正文中的定量表格再判断。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Warsaw University of Technology、University of Warsaw、Massachusetts General Hospital、Harvard Medical School。更像一篇生成模型机制分析工作，而非大规模基础模型训练报告。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to explain and mitigate structural hallucinations in diffusion models, where samples match training statistics but violate structural rules.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic: it frames hallucinations as instabilities on the model-induced manifold and turns that view into a corrective method. This is indirectly relevant to researchers working on alternative language modeling paradigms, especially diffusion-style generation stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first builds an instability-based hallucination filter, then traces the source of those instabilities and argues that local intrinsic dimension (LID) is the main driver. Based on that, it proposes Intrinsic Quenching (IQ), which directly suppresses local intrinsic dimension to reduce hallucinations. The key idea is not a new backbone but a geometric diagnostic turned into an intervention signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that IQ consistently beats standard hallucination-reduction baselines across multiple benchmarks, and that the instability-based filter matches or exceeds a recent temporal baseline. However, the abstract does not report model sizes, data scales, datasets, or effect sizes, so the strength of evidence depends on the full paper tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Warsaw University of Technology, University of Warsaw, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School. This reads as a generative-model mechanism paper rather than a large-scale foundation-model training report.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 diffusion LM 或生成稳定性，只读 LID 假说和 IQ 实验段落；机制视角有意思，但离基座预训练主线仍偏远，先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: If you care about diffusion LM or generation stability, read the LID hypothesis and IQ experiments only; the mechanism angle is interesting, but it is still peripheral to core pretraining.

institutions: Centre for Credible AI, Warsaw University of Technology

paper.title: A Few-Step Generative Model on Cumulative Flow Maps
paper.abstract: We propose a unified, few-step generative modeling framework based on \emph{cumulative flow maps} for long-range transport in probability space, inspired by flow-map techniques for physical transport and dynamics. At its core is a cumulative-flow abstraction that connects local, instantaneous updates with finite-time transport, enabling generative models to reason about global state transitions. This perspective yields a unified few-step framework built on cumulative transport and \revise{cumula

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion 和 flow-based 生成模型多步采样成本高、少步采样容易损失质量的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成建模方法创新。它提出 cumulative flow maps，把瞬时更新和有限时间传输统一起来，目标是在不增加模型容量的情况下支持少步甚至一步生成。对做 AR+diffusion 统一建模的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法借鉴物理输运和动力系统中的 flow-map 思路，用 cumulative-flow abstraction 表示概率空间中的长程传输；在参数化和训练目标上做轻量调整，使框架可嵌入已有 diffusion 与 flow 模型，而不绑定具体 prediction target。
summary.experiments: 摘要称实验覆盖图像生成、几何分布建模、joint prediction 等任务，并展示少步和一步生成下能保持合成质量；未提供模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 细节或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Institute of Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the high sampling cost of diffusion and flow-based generative models, where reducing the number of steps often hurts sample quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a generative modeling method contribution. It introduces cumulative flow maps to connect instantaneous updates with finite-time transport, aiming for few-step or even one-step generation without increasing model capacity. It is indirectly relevant to AR-plus-diffusion multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method borrows the flow-map view from physical transport and dynamics. It represents long-range probability transport through a cumulative-flow abstraction and modifies parameterization, time embeddings, and training objectives lightly so that the idea can be applied to existing diffusion and flow models without committing to one prediction target.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on image generation, geometric distribution modeling, and joint prediction, showing quality preservation under few-step and one-step generation. It does not provide model sizes, dataset names, baseline details, or quantitative gains in the supplied text.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和少步采样实验；它可能迁移到多模态 diffusion 分支，但目前不是语言建模证据。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and few-step sampling results; it may transfer to multimodal diffusion branches, but it is not language-modeling evidence.
